articles.title: Rethinking Video Autoencoders for Interactive World Models
articles.content: Video world models predict future frames from past frames and actions. They serve as simulators in which agents train, plan or are evaluated, and that humans can control interactively. They generate in the latent space of a video autoencoder, whose compression sets their cost per frame and how long each action waits to take effect. Yet world models often reuse the autoencoders of text-to-video generators, built for offline generation with no agent waiting and, without their training data and code, not retrainable at another compression. We therefore ask how, where and how much a world model should compress. We build CADRE, an open family of causal diffusion representation autoencoders spanning multiple spatio-temporal compressions. Its members differ only in a small bottleneck on frozen features and share a diffusion decoder self-distilled to one or a few steps. We train the same world model on each autoencoder in two domains, manipulation and navigation, with two environments each. CADRE forms most of the latency-quality frontier, especially with a moving camera. Our study also leads to four findings. At strong compression, a diffusion decoder is sharper than perceptual regression. In robot manipulation, temporal compression is more effective in the autoencoder than in the world model. Manipulation and navigation call for opposite compressions: temporal compression costs little when the camera is still, and spatial compression when it moves. Surprisingly, with a still camera, coarser spatial tokens hurt motion far more than image quality. Code, models and a live demo are at https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-10-21-cadre

articles.title_zh: 反思互动世界模型的视频自动编码器
articles.content_zh: 视频世界模型从过去的帧和动作中预测出未来的帧. 它们充当模拟器,使特工在其中训练,计划或评价,人类可以交互控制. 它们在一个视频自动编码器的潜在空间中产生,其压缩确定了每个帧的成本,以及每个动作等待生效的时间。 然而,世界模型往往重复使用文本到视频生成器的自动编码器,这是为离线生成而建造的,没有代理等待,没有其培训数据和代码,就无法在另一次压缩时重新培训。 因此,我们问世界模式应如何、在何处和多少压缩。 我们建立了CADRE,一个开放的家族,由因果传播代表自动编码器组成,跨越了多个时空压缩. 其成员只在冰冻特征上的小瓶颈上存在差异,并共享可扩散解码器自分解到一或几个步骤. 我们在每个自动编码器上,在操纵和导航两个领域训练同样的世界模型,每个领域有两个环境。 CADRE构成了大多数耐久质量的前沿,尤其是带有移动相机. 我们的研究还得出了四项结论。 在强压缩时,扩散解码器比能感回还尖. 在机器人操纵中,时间压缩在自编码器中比在世界模型中更有效. 操纵和导航需要相反的压缩:相机静时时间压缩成本很小,移动时空间压缩成本很小. 出人意料的是,用一台静相机,相近的空间符号会伤害运动,远超过图像质量. 代码、模型和现场演示见https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-10-21-cadre。

articles.title: VoxProg: 3D Spatial Reasoning through Voxel Programming
articles.content: Language models' abilities to interpret tasks and generate programs offer a promising basis for 3D spatial reasoning. Yet following spatial instructions in 3D scenes requires programs to construct geometric references that language leaves implicit. In this work, we introduce VoxProg, which formulates 3D object placement through voxel programming: a language model translates task interpretations into executable programs over local voxel views of scene surfaces. Because these views index surface geometry on regular grids with explicit coordinates and neighborhood relations, an evidence program can isolate task-relevant regions and boundaries directly from scene meshes, and a downstream pose program can measure the resulting geometry to compute a target $SE(3)$ pose. Visual and numerical feedback from execution lets the model inspect intermediate selections and candidate placements to iteratively revise its code. To evaluate open-ended placement across functional use, geometric fit, and contextual arrangements, we introduce the 71-task VoxProg-Bench benchmark along with an evaluation suite pairing perceptual Intent Alignment and 3D Physical Validity. Across VoxProg-Bench and external benchmarks, VoxProg consistently outperforms relation-based, keypoint-based, and mesh-based baselines.

articles.title_zh: VoxProg:通过Voxel编程实现三维空间理性
articles.content_zh: 语言模型解释任务和生成程序的能力为3D空间推理提供了有希望的基础. 然而在3D场景中遵循空间指令需要程序构建语言所隐含的几何引用. 在这部作品中,我们引入了VoxProg,它通过voxel编程来制定3D对象放置:一种语言模型将任务解释翻译为可执行的程序,凌驾于场景表面的局部voxel视图上. 由于这些视图在有明确坐标和相邻关系的正格上索引了地表几何,一个证据程序可以直接从场景网中分离出与任务相关的区域和边界,而下游的姿势程序可以测量由此产生的几何来计算一个目标$SE(3)$的姿势. 执行的视觉和数字反馈让模型检查中间选择和候选人职位安排,以反复修改其代码. 为了评价各种功能用途、几何相配和背景安排的开放式安放,我们采用了71任务VoxProg-Bench基准,以及一套评价套件对接感知性对接和3D物理有效性。 在整个VoxProg-Bench和外部基准中,VoxProg的业绩始终高于基于关系、关键点和网点的基线。

articles.title: PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration for World Models
articles.content: Existing world models typically perceive a scene through current visual frame or a narrow history window. However, these observations may not reveal the physics properties that determine transition dynamics, such as an object's mass distribution, joint damping, or surface friction. Without calibrating these physics factors for world models, predictions tend to regress toward an empirical prior and induce severe drift in novel test scenes. To this end, we propose PhysiCalWorld, which calibrates action-conditioned world models to the instance-specific dynamics via in-context prompting, without fine-tuning or analytical physics modeling. Our method encodes an exploratory interaction clip collected within the test scene into a compact physics descriptor token, which grounds subsequent predictions in the scene's actual physical behavior. PhysiCalWorld is trained end-to-end with the latent prediction loss alone, without physics labels. At inference time, the descriptor token is extracted once and can be reused across rollouts with negligible compute overhead. We evaluate PhysiCalWorld across four environments covering diverse physics variations and show that it substantially improves rollout prediction accuracy and visual planning success rate. The learned descriptors also form a physically structured latent space and generalize beyond the physics ranges seen during training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PhysiCalWorld:世界模型的连文物理校正
articles.content_zh: 现有的世界模型一般通过目前的视觉框架或狭窄的历史窗口来感知一幕. 然而,这些观测可能不会揭示决定过渡动力学的物理性质,如物体的质量分布,联合起坝,或表面摩擦等. 在不校正这些物理因素的世界模型的情况下,预测往往会倒退到经验前,并诱发新实验场景的严重漂移. 为此,我们提出PhysiCalWorld,它通过内在的提示,将具有行动条件的世界模型校正到具体实例的动态,而无需微调或分析物理模型。 我们的方法将一个在试验场所收集的探索性交互片段编码成一个紧凑的物理描述符,以此来证明随后在现场的实际物理行为上的预测. PhysiCalWorld被训练出只有潜在预测损失的端到端,没有物理标签. 在推论时间,描述符符被提取一次,可以重复使用可忽略不计的计算机顶. 我们评价PhysiCalWorld涉及各种物理学变异的四种环境,并表明它大大地提高了推出预测的准确性和视觉规划的成功率。 所学的描述符还形成了一个物理结构的潜在空间并概括到训练期间所看到的物理范围以外。

articles.title: ALPS: Visual State Encoders for World Models
articles.content: World models turn visual representations into predictions and actions. We argue that their visual foundation should combine physical-state information, native language alignment, and pixel reconstruction, so that a single representation can support prediction, instruction, and inspection. However, existing encoders typically specialize in only one or two of these capabilities; we therefore introduce ALPS, a pretrained visual state encoder that unifies all three in a single set of patch tokens. Using only still images and text, we pretrain a ViT-B/16 from scratch with language, reconstruction, and spatial correspondence objectives, and then refine it via cross-view self-distillation. In a unified evaluation across fifteen public encoders, ALPS achieves the lowest aggregate LIBERO state-probe error among ViT-B models (matching the 3.5x larger V-JEPA 2-L) while maintaining strong language alignment and accurate pixel reconstruction. Downstream, frozen ALPS tokens reach the highest mean policy success on LIBERO (85.5%) when paired with our native text tower, match or exceed leading encoders on world-model planning across PushT, Wall, and Granular, and allow predicted future tokens to be decoded directly into pixels for visual inspection. We hope this work helps establish visual pretraining as a shared foundation for understanding, prediction, and action in world models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ALPS:世界模型视觉状态编码器
articles.content_zh: 世界模型将视觉表现转化为预测和行动. 我们主张他们的视觉基础应该结合物理状态信息,本土语言相接,和像素重建,这样一个单一的表述可以支持预测,指示和检查. 然而,现有的编码器一般只专门使用一到两种这种能力;因此我们引入了ALPS,一种预先训练的视觉状态编码器,将所有三种编码统一在一整套补丁符号中. 我们只使用静态的图像和文字,从零开始从语言,重建,空间对应目标中预演一个VIT-B/16,然后通过交叉视图自沉来完善. 在对15个公共编码器的统一评价中,ALPS在VIT-B模型中实现了LIBERO状态-探测最小的差错(匹配3.5x更大的V-JEPA 2-L),同时保持了强大的语言对接和准确的像素重建. 下游被冻结的ALPS标志在LIBERO(85.5%)上达到了最高的中间政策成功度, 与我们本土的文本塔对齐, 匹配或超过世界模型规划的主要编码器, 跨越PushT, Wall, 和 Granular, 并允许预测的未来标志被直接解码为像素, 用于视觉检查. 我们希望这项工作有助于建立视觉预训,作为世界模型中理解、预测和行动的共同基础。

articles.title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
articles.content: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多式联运 代理:从计算机使用到机器人使用的统一能力中心视角
articles.content_zh: 多式联运代理通过推理、内存、工具和反馈来维持互动,最明显的是作为计算机使用代理,而机器人系统则在物理动态下进行夫妇感知和激活。 我们把多式联运实体定义为目标导向的系统,将多式联运任务推理与实际行动结合起来,并修订由此产生的反馈中的决定。 这就提出了一个中心问题:当一个多式联运代理人从计算机使用转向机器人使用时,有什么变化? 我们提出PAPAV,这是一个由五个经常性职能组成的以能力为中心的统一框架: 了解现状、预期行动效果、规划可行的课程、通过界面或机构采取行动并核实结果。 按照函数而不是结构定义,这些能力使PAPAV能够确定所有三种共享的内容,然后将MMEAs与MMAs和RSs进行比较. 五个实际限制,从部分可观察性到无法核实的结果,留下较少的事先固定选择,更没有回溯错误的余地. 在64个基准中,明确的评估中心是《法案》;只有5个评估 " 期望 " ,3个评估 " 核查 " ,两者在很大程度上都隐藏在任务成功之后。 这些制约因素还构成我们确定的公开挑战。 因此,PAPAV为设计可靠的物理物剂和衡量所有五个能力的进展提供了共同的基础,而不仅仅是任务的成功。

articles.title: AtomicRL: Atomic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
articles.content: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise in robotic manipulation, but imitation learning (IL) alone often struggles to master complex long-horizon skills. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers an effective avenue for further improving VLA policies. However, existing VLA-RL methods typically suffer from delayed and biased credit assignment due to trajectory-level sparse rewards, while imbalanced subtask mastery creates bottlenecks that limit overall performance. To address these challenges, we propose AtomicRL, an RL post-training framework that leverages atomic task structures for reliable credit assignment and adaptive exploration. AtomicRL introduces Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses semantic-aware gating to constrain TD residuals from failed atomic subtasks from propagating across task boundaries, mitigating credit contamination while preserving intra-subtask credit assignment and value bootstrapping. In addition, Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration (BATE) dynamically coordinates task sampling and local exploration incentives based on the mastery of individual atomic subtasks, directing learning toward the remaining bottlenecks. Finally, we develop a Real2Sim2Real pipeline that bridges online RL in simulation with real-world deployment, facilitating practical transfer to physical robots. On LIBERO-LONG, AtomicRL achieves absolute performance gains of 3.6% and 4.0% over PPO across two VLA architectures. On CALVIN ABC-D, it improves full-task performance by up to 9.5% over PPO. Combined with the Real2Sim2Real pipeline, AtomicRL further improves real-world task performance by an average of 21.3%. These results demonstrate that AtomicRL effectively improves the learning efficiency and manipulation performance of VLA policies on long-horizon tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 原子RL:长视机器人操纵的原子强化学习
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型在机器人操控中表现出了希望,但单是模仿学习(IL)往往会挣扎去掌握复杂的长视距技能. 强化学习为进一步改进职业劳工政策提供了有效途径。 然而,由于轨迹水平微薄的奖励,现有的VLA-RL方法通常受到延迟和有偏向的信用分配的影响,而不平衡的子任务掌握则造成了瓶颈,限制了总体绩效. 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议采用原子核研究(AtomicRL),即利用原子任务结构进行可靠的信用分配和适应性探索的辐射后培训框架。 AttomicRL引入了语义-智能政策优化(SAPO),它使用语义-感知地标来约束因跨越任务界限传播而失败的原子子任务而遗留的TD,减轻信用污染,同时保留子任务内信用分配和价值夹. 此外,Bottleneck-Adaptive Goal Exploration(BATE)在掌握单个原子子任务的基础上,动态地协调任务采样和地方探索激励,将学习引导到剩下的瓶颈. 最后,我们开发了一个Real2Sim2Real管道,在模拟现实世界的部署中连接在线RL,促进实际向物理机器人的转移. 在LIBERO-LONG上,AtomicRL在两个VLA架构上比PPO实现3.6%和4.0%的绝对性能增益. 在CALVIN ABC-D上,它比PPO提高了9.5%的全任务性能. 与Real2Sim2 Real输油管结合,AtomicRL进一步提高了现实世界的任务性能平均21.3%. 这些结果表明,AtomicRL有效地提高了学习效率并改进了VLA政策在长距离任务上的操纵性能.

articles.title: ProactEgoMem: Benchmarking Proactive Memory in Streaming Egocentric Video
articles.content: Today's multimodal assistants are typically prompted to interpret the visual evidence presented to them. To offload the cognitive burden of remembering across long horizons, wearable assistants should instead proactively acquire and maintain useful memory as the user's surroundings evolve. Doing so on the user's behalf requires identifying what matters, understanding the scene in real time, and initiating memory maintenance in the background while the user stays focused on their activities. We introduce ProactEgoMem, a benchmark that evaluates proactive memory in streaming egocentric video. Three tasks ground the evaluation in ambient environmental needs: Information Capture (IC) preserves transient yet dense visual information, State Tracking (ST) follows changing object states, and Location Tracking (LT) records object movements. The benchmark defines its protocol at two levels of proactiveness: the Notification Level asks for a single timely notification that satisfies the user's intent, while the deeper Intervention Level asks the agent to maintain memory on the user's behalf through an active start-to-stop tool lifecycle. Parallel ProactEgoMem-Daily and ProactEgoMem-Sci tracks contain 300/100 clips covering daily and scientific use cases, paired with 1000/500 questions in ProactEgoMem-QA, which measures the quality of the proactively acquired memory. Across proprietary, open-source, video-language, and streaming baselines, even the strongest models fail to capture memory both timely and accurately. ProactEgoMem provides a rigorous evaluation foundation for proactive multimodal assistance and for video agents that co-exist with their users.

articles.title_zh: ProactEgoMem:在流出爱高中心时设定主动记忆的基准 视频
articles.content_zh: 今天的多模式助理通常是为了解释提交给他们的视觉证据。 要卸下跨越长地平线记忆的认知负担,可穿戴的助手应主动获取并随着用户周围环境的发展而保持有用的内存. 代表用户这样做,需要确定什么是紧要的,实时了解场景,并在用户继续专注于活动的同时在背景中启动内存维护. 我们引入了ProactEgoMem,这个基准在流出以自我为中心的视频中评价主动记忆. 三项任务使评价以环境需要为基础:信息捕获(IC)保存瞬时而密集的视觉信息;国家跟踪(ST)跟踪不断变化的物体状态;地点跟踪(LT)记录物体运动。 该基准在主动性两个层面定义了其协议:通知级别要求一个满足用户意图的单一及时通知,而更深层的干预级别则要求代理通过一个主动起止工具生命周期来代表用户维护内存. ProactEgoMem-Daily和ProactEgoMem-Sci的音轨包含300/100个剪辑,涵盖日常和科学使用案例,与ProactEgoMem-QA的1000/500个问题对齐,该内容测量了主动获取的内存的质量. 纵观专有,开源,视频语言和流线基线,即使是最强的模型也无法及时准确地捕捉到内存. 行为 EgoMem为积极主动的多模式援助和与用户共存的视频代理提供了严格的评价基础。

articles.title: Attn-Forcing: Learning Full-Context Attention Proxies for Streaming Video Generation
articles.content: Increasing the attention context length significantly improves streaming video generation quality, while incurring prohibitive memory and computational costs as the context grows. Existing methods attempt to capture this contextual information through attention selection or compression, but remain limited by bounded representations and lack explicit attention-level supervision to retain historical contributions to current queries. To address this, we introduce Attn-Forcing, a novel framework that preserves full-context attention contributions for streaming video generation under bounded memory and computation. We achieve this by introducing attention proxies that continuously approximate the attention responses induced by the historical context. Specifically, we implement the proxies as learnable visual latents and employ a Proxy Update Module to incorporate visual context from historical latents. Moreover, we propose an Attention Matching Loss to explicitly constrain the attention behavior of the learned proxies using full-context attention supervision. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that Attn-Forcing consistently improves streaming video generation quality and achieves state-of-the-art performance over existing baseline methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Attn-Forcing:学习全文本关注流视频生成代理
articles.content_zh: 增加关注的上下文长度大大提高了流出视频生成的质量,同时随着上下文的增长,也造成了令人望而却步的内存和计算成本. 现有方法试图通过注意选择或压缩来获取这种背景信息,但仍受到限制,缺乏明确的注意层次监督,无法保留对当前询问的历史贡献. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了Attn-Forcing这个新颖的框架,这个框架保留了在有界内存和计算下对流视频生成的完整文本关注贡献. 为此,我们引入了连续近似于历史背景所引发的注意反应的注意力。 具体地说,我们把代理作为可学习的视觉潜质加以实施,并使用一个代理更新模块,以纳入历史潜质中的视觉背景。 此外,我们提出一个"注意相匹配"(Contenting Complete Loss),以通过全文本的注意力监督,明确限制被学习的代理人的注意力行为. 广泛的定性和定量实验表明,Attn-Forcing不断提高流媒体视频生成质量,并比起现有基准方法取得最新性能.

articles.title: Plausible but Unimplantable: A Trustworthiness Audit of Shape Completion Foundation Models for Cranial Defect Reconstruction
articles.content: A patient who has lost part of the skull vault needs an implant that fits the defect exactly, and such implants are still drawn by hand in CAD by specialists, which makes each case slow and expensive. The task can be considered as a shape completion problem, so pretrained completion models, and now the first shape completion foundation models, look like a way to remove that manual step. We audited three publicly released pretrained shape completion models, two of them foundation models, applied zero-shot to 239 cranial defects, some carved from public skull datasets and some real post-craniectomy cases. Each output was compared with simply returning the patient's own remaining bone, and tested for whether the predicted material could be placed without intersecting the bone that is still there. On the 210 carved defects none of the three improved on doing nothing, and on the 29 real cases only one did so beyond chance. Yet not one output, from any model in any configuration, was implantable: none managed both to stay clear of the bone the patient still has and to place more material than doing nothing, where a task-specific volumetric model, trained for this task and selected on these cases, was implantable on all but one. The output that most convincingly resembles a skull is no more placeable than the rest, and at these point densities implant thickness cannot be read off the emitted points at all, which is a property of the output representation rather than of any one model. On this evidence the shape completion foundation models we could obtain cannot be trusted and, used as released, are not usable in clinical practice. Substantial research towards trustworthy foundation models for shape completion is still needed.

articles.title_zh: 有可能,不过 可一并栽培:对整形完成基础重建模式的可信赖性审计
articles.content_zh: 失去部分头骨金库的病人需要一个完全适合缺陷的植入物,这种植入物仍然由专家在CAD中手取出,这使得每个病例都缓慢而昂贵. 任务可以被认为是形状完成问题,所以预先训练的完成模型,现在的第一个形状完成基础模型,看起来像是去除那个人工步骤的方法. 我们审计了3个公开发布的预先训练的外形完成模型,其中2个是基础模型,对239个颅骨缺陷应用了零镜头,有些是从公共头骨数据集中雕刻出来的,还有一些是真正的脑后切除病例. 每一次输出都与简单的还原患者自己所剩的骨骼相比较,并测试预测出的物质能否被放入而不与尚存的骨骼相交叉. 在210个被雕刻出来的缺陷上,三个都没有改进过无所事事,在29个真正的案例中,只有一个没有机会这样做。 然而,从任何配置中的任何模型来看,没有一个产出是能够被植入的:除了一个模型外,没有一种模型既能够远离病人的骨骼,又能够放置比无所事事更多的材料,因为只有一个模型能够植入一个特定的任务体积模型。 最令人信服地类似于头骨的输出不会比其他的更能被取而代之,在这个时候,密度的植入厚度完全不能从所发射的点上读取,这是输出代表而不是任何一个模型的属性. 根据这些证据,我们所能获得的形状完成基础模型是无法信任的,而且作为释放物使用,在临床实践中无法使用。 仍需要进行大量研究,以建立可靠的基础模型来完成形状。

articles.title: RealMe: Immersive Volumetric Video from Minimal Captures
articles.content: This paper addresses the problem of creating immersive volumetric videos from sparse and low-resolution capture resources. Conventional dense multi-view reconstruction methods can produce high-quality volumetric videos, but their reliance on costly capture setups makes them impractical in real-world scenarios. Recent approaches use generative models to relax capture requirements, but still suffer from limited resolution and 4D inconsistency. To overcome these constraints, we propose RealMe, a unified framework built around a high-resolution video diffusion model that enhances limited captures into high-resolution (2K), 4D-consistent videos for volumetric video reconstruction. Specifically, RealMe constructs auxiliary data from capture videos and encodes them into latents along with layout-aware positional embeddings. The video diffusion model adapts factorized spatio-temporal attention to the multi-view capture layout, denoises these latents across viewpoints and time, and decodes them into enhanced videos to refine the 4D representation. This adaptation helps the model capture temporal dynamics and multi-view relationships, leading to more 4D-consistent generation. To reduce the data gap between generated videos and real captures, we apply a latent frequency loss that provides frequency-domain supervision in latent space. Extensive experiments on the public DNA-Rendering benchmark and our self-captured RealVV dataset demonstrate that RealMe is able to create immersive volumetric videos and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity and 4D consistency.

articles.title_zh: Real Me: 最小捕捉器所摄入的相片
articles.content_zh: 本文探讨了从稀有和低分辨率的捕捉资源中创建浸泡式卷片的问题. 常规密集多景重建方法可以产生出高质量的量子视频,但是它们依赖于昂贵的捕捉设置使得它们在现实世界的情景中不切实际. 近期的方法使用基因模型来放松捕捉要求,但仍然受到分辨率有限和4D不一致的影响. 为了克服这些制约因素,我们提议RealMe,一个围绕高分辨率视频传播模式所构建的统一框架,这个模式能增强有限的捕捉到高分辨率(2K),4D相容的视频,用于量产视频重建. 具体来说,真实 我从捕捉视频中构建辅助数据,并将视频编码为潜伏数据,同时进行布局意识定位嵌入. 视频传播模型对多视图捕捉布局进行了因地制宜的spatio-timperal关注,将这些潜伏物在观点和时间上进行分解,并解码为增强的视频来完善4D表现. 这一改编有助于模型捕捉时间动态和多视角关系,导致更多4D相容的生成. 为了缩小生成的视频与真实捕获之间的数据差距,我们采用了潜在的频率损失,在潜在的空间中提供频率域监督. 对公共DNA渲染基准和我们自拍的RealVV数据集的广泛实验表明,RealMe能够在视觉忠心度和4D一致性方面创造出浸泡性卷片并超越最先进的方法.

articles.title: ClunoGS: Compact Language 3D Gaussian Splatting via Unified Optimization
articles.content: Language 3D Gaussian Splatting enables open-vocabulary scene understanding by associating Gaussian primitives with language features. These semantic attributes increase model storage, while most existing 3DGS compression methods are designed mainly to preserve RGB rendering quality. One straightforward approach is to apply sparsification and quantization sequentially. However, pruning based only on rendering quality can remove Gaussians that have small RGB contributions but are important for semantic prediction. Once removed, their semantic information cannot be recovered by later quantization. We propose ClunoGS, a compact framework for Language 3DGS that combines semantics-aware Gaussian sparsification and vector quantization in a unified constrained objective. Semantic supervision is used during sparsification, and the objective jointly considers rendering quality, semantic accuracy, and compactness. We optimize the unified objective with alternating primal, sparsification, quantization, and dual updates. We evaluate ClunoGS on open-vocabulary localization and segmentation using the LERF and ScanNet-10 benchmarks. Under aggressive compression, our unified, semantics-aware formulation substantially alleviates the degradation of semantic representations caused by sequential compression and semantics-agnostic Gaussian sparsification. Ablations further show that jointly coordinating sparsification and quantization better preserves semantic accuracy than applying them independently.

articles.title_zh: ClunoGS:通过统一优化实现收缩语言3D高斯平板
articles.content_zh: 语言 3D 高斯克平板化通过将高斯克人原始人与语言特征联系起来,实现了开口-伏地语场景理解. 这些语义属性会增加模型存储,而大多数现有的3DGS压缩方法主要是为了维护RGB渲染质量而设计的. 一个直截了当的方法是按顺序施用垃圾邮件和定量。 然而,只基于渲染质量的穿行可以去除那些对RGB贡献较小但对语义预测很重要的高斯人. 一旦被移除,它们的语义信息无法被后期的量化所恢复. 我们提出ClunoGS,即语言3DGS的紧凑框架,将语义学-意识高斯语的斯波化和向量化合并为一个统一的受限目标. 语义督导在斯巴塞化过程中被使用,目标共同考虑渲染质量,语义精度和紧凑性. 我们优化了统一的目标, 交替的初选,斯帕克化,量化,和双重更新。 我们利用LERF和ScanNet-10的基准,对ClunoGS进行开放式地方化和分区化评估。 在积极的压缩下,我们统一而有语义意识的配体大大地缓解了由相继压缩和语义-不可知的高斯孢子化所引发的语义表达的退化. 通缩还进一步表明,联合协调斯巴塞化和量化比独立应用更能保持语义精度.

articles.title: Multiclass Boundary Refinement with Neural Cellular Automata for Remote Sensing Land Cover Segmentation
articles.content: Semantic segmentation of remote sensing imagery often places class boundaries a few pixels away from where they truly lie, and this position error is concentrated in the thin band measured by Boundary IoU (BIoU). We treat boundary refinement as the iterated application of a small learned local rule: the Boundary Refinement Neural Cellular Automaton (BRNCA), that starts from the class probabilities of a frozen, pre-trained segmenter and corrects them cell by cell. We generalise the binary rNCA to the multiclass case by keeping the visible channels on the probability simplex through an Aitchison (log-space) update and by adding free hidden channels. The best configuration improves the mean BIoU over the base segmenter by 2.36 points (from 46.63 to 48.99). The gain is concentrated on the irregular woodland class (+8.5 points BIoU); this suggests that position error is correlated with the fractal dimension of the class boundaries.

articles.title_zh: 多类边界 完善用于遥感的神经细胞自动地图
articles.content_zh: 对遥感图像进行语义分解时,往往会将类分界线放出一些像素,使其远离它们真正所躺的地方,而这种位置误差集中在由边界IoU(BIoU)所测量的薄带上. 我们把边界的完善视为对一个小而有学问的局部规则的反复应用:边界完善神经细胞自通(BRNCA),它从被冷冻,预先训练的分管器的类概率开始,逐个细胞加以纠正. 我们通过一个Aitchison(log-space)更新,将二进制 rNCA 常规化到多类的大小写中,通过保留概率简单x上的可见道并添加自由隐藏道. 最佳配置将平均BIOU比基分器提高2.36分(从46.63分到48.99分). 增益集中于不规则的林地类(+8.5分 BIOU);这说明位置误差与类分界线分形维度相关.

articles.title: DONIC: Generalist Dexterous Bimanual Tracking Control from Human Demonstrations
articles.content: Despite recent progress in dexterous reference tracking, existing models focus primarily on single-hand manipulation and a limited range of interactions, leaving the bimanual dexterous behaviors common in real life unaddressed. The scarcity of contact-rich bimanual manipulation data and the increased complexity of coordinating contacts make developing a generalist bimanual tracker particularly challenging. Therefore, we present 1) DONIC, the first generalist bimanual tracker jointly trained across operation categories and human-motion sources, together with 2) BiHOI, a multi-view dataset of 1,575 sequences spanning 229 objects and emphasizing sustained bimanual interaction, where reconstructed interactions are retargeted into robot references. DONIC combines proximal policy optimization with behavioral cloning in a feedback loop that recycles verified successful executions into training demonstrations. An object-centered per-hand reward maintains object-motion feedback while supervising each hand according to its reference contact role. Clip-Centered Advantages remove reference-dependent advantage offsets while preserving within-trajectory differences. Together, these designs enable one single policy to learn coordinated manipulation across heterogeneous references. Without finetuning, a single checkpoint achieves 86.79% success on unseen trajectories of training objects and 57.32% on held-out objects, surpassing the state-of-the-art bimanual tracking baselines by 77.36 and 45.73 percentage points.

articles.title_zh: 通用Dexterous双人追踪控制
articles.content_zh: 尽管最近在离子参考跟踪方面取得了进展,但现有的模型主要侧重于单手操纵和有限的相互作用范围,使得现实生活中常见的双手离子行为得不到解决. 缺乏内容丰富的双人操作数据以及协调接触日益复杂,使得开发通用双人跟踪器尤其具有挑战性。 因此,我们介绍1)DONIC,这是第一个跨行动类别和人类运动源联合培训的通用双人追踪器,以及2)波黑OI,一个由1,575个序列组成的多视图数据集,覆盖了229个物体,强调持续的双人互动,其中重建的互动被重新锁定为机器人参考。 DONIC将近效政策优化与行为克隆结合在一个反馈回路中,将已核实的死刑成功执行回收到训练演示中. 以对象为主的单手奖励保持对象运动反馈,同时按照参考接触作用监督每只手. 以 Clip-Clecting 为主的优势消除了依赖参考的优势相抵消,同时保留了内向差异. 这些设计合在一起,使单一政策能够学习不同参考文献的协调操作。 没有微调,一个检查站在未见的训练物体轨道上取得了86.79%的成功,在被扣留物体上取得了57.32%的成功,比最新双人追踪基线高出77.36和45.73个百分点。

articles.title: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
articles.content: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve. Under teacher forcing, strong temporal redundancy may allow local visual continuity to serve as a shortcut for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to model visual evolution. We introduce Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), an auxiliary objective jointly optimized with teacher-forced denoising that predicts temporally separated chunks without access to the intervening visual context. Drawing supervision directly from training videos, FCP requires no additional pretrained visual encoder and leaves autoregressive inference unchanged. Our method achieves superior physical plausibility over standard teacher-forced autoregressive training with a lower overall training compute budget, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of future-chunk supervision for modeling visual evolution. Intriguingly, our visualizations suggest that FCP fosters a more structured representation space, which may be valuable for building autoregressive world models.

articles.title_zh: Looking Ahead: 自动视频生成中模拟未来进化
articles.content_zh: 自动回放的视频传播模型逐块生成视频,然而,产生可信的续作并不能保证它们能捕捉到场景的发展过程. 在教师强迫下,强烈的时间冗余可能会使局部视觉连续性成为当前-cunk去诺化的捷径,降低模拟视觉进化的压力. 我们提出未来春克预测(Future Chunk President (FCP)),这是一个辅助目标,与教师强迫去诺共同优化,它预言在时间上分离出块而无法进入干扰视觉环境. FCP直接从训练视频中绘制监督,不需要额外的事先训练的视觉编码器,而自动回转推论保持不变. 我们的方法实现了优于标准师资强制自发性培训的物理合理性,总体培训计算预算较低,凸显出未来全能监理视觉演化模型的效能和效率. 有趣的是,我们的可视化表明,FCP培育出一个更有条理的能代表空间,这对建立自相递进的世界模型可能很有价值.

articles.title: Training-free Acceleration for Blind Compressed Image Restoration via Activation-Calibrated Singular Value Decomposition
articles.content: Transformer-based models achieve strong performance on blind compressed image restoration (CIR) under unknown compression settings, but their densely stacked projection operators make deployment costly. We study training-free acceleration for such models through an empirical, operator-level analysis. Specifically, we profile where computation is concentrated, characterize channel-wise activation distributions under compressed inputs, and examine the singular-value decay of representative projection weights. These measurements identify the recurring projections in the attention, feed-forward, convolutional, and prompt-conditioning pathways as effective low-rank replacement targets that preserve the original inference graph. They further establish truncated SVD (TSVD) as a principled training-free baseline for blind CIR and reveal why a uniform low-rank objective is mismatched to the channel-imbalanced feature distributions of compressed images. Accordingly, we formulate Activation-Calibrated Singular Value Decomposition (ASVD) for this restoration setting, deriving low-rank factors entirely offline from pretrained weights and lightweight activation statistics gathered from only a few compressed calibration images. By weighting the decomposition with channel-wise activation magnitudes, our ASVD assigns larger penalties to errors on more active channels, requiring neither retraining nor online calibration and leaving the restoration pipeline intact. When instantiated on PromptCIR at rank 64, ASVD consistently improves PSNR-B over TSVD across four standard benchmarks under identical parameter and MAC budgets. At this operating point, the factorized model cuts parameters by 59% (34.75M to 14.34M) and computation by 16.1% (258.79 to 217.16 GMACs for a 256 x 256 input), enabling acceleration without retraining.

articles.title_zh: 通过活化-解析的 Singular 值解析实现盲人压缩图像修复的免费培训加速
articles.content_zh: 基于变压器的模型在未知的压缩设置下在盲压缩图像还原(CIR)上实现了强大的性能,但其堆积稠密的投影操作器使得部署成本高昂. 我们通过经验性操作分析,研究这些模型的无培训加速。 具体地说,我们描述计算集中之处,在压缩投入下描述顺道活化分布,并检查代表性投影权重的单值衰减. 这些测量结果将注意力、进取、进取和快速空调路径中反复出现的预测确定为有效的低级替换目标,保留了原来的推论图。 他们进一步将短发SVD(TSVD)作为盲CIR的原则性无训练基线,并揭示一个统一的低级目标为何与被压缩图像的频道-不均匀特征分布不相匹配. 因此,我们为这种恢复设置制定了活化-分解的 Singular 值分解法(ASVD),它完全通过从少数压缩校正图像中收集的被预先训练的重量和轻量级活化统计而得出出低等因素。 通过将分解分解量与信道的活化量进行加权,我们的ASVD对更活化的信道出错分配了更重的处罚,既不要求再培训,也不要求在线校正,使恢复管道完好无损. ASVD在SourceCIR第64等分时,在相同的参数和MAC预算下,将PSNR-B比TSVD改进为四个标准基准。 在这个操作点,因地制宜的模型参数削减了59%(34.75M至14.34M)并计算了16.1%(258.79至217.16GMAC为256×256输入),使得无需再培训即可加速.

articles.title: Existence of Minimizers for the Gaussian Mumford-Shah Model via Covariance Floors on the Value Distribution
articles.content: The Gaussian Mumford-Shah model segments an image into regions by minimizing a continuous multivariate Gaussian negative log-likelihood term plus a perimeter penalty. It is used for scalar- and vector-valued images, in particular hyperspectral images, but the existence of a minimizer in general is not guaranteed. The energy is unbounded below whenever the covariance of a single region degenerates, regardless of the perimeter of the regions. A quantitative covariance floor on the covariances of all regions, or equivalently uniform Hölder continuity with exponent at most one of all one-dimensional marginals of the histogram, guarantees a lower bound on the energy and the existence of a minimizer. Our approach therefore shows that existence follows from a property of the histogram of the image, and we furthermore argue that scale-independent covariance floors cannot exist. Admitting a quantitative covariance floor is generic: it holds almost surely for all images with suitable noise. As applications of our theory, we show the convergence of regularized models used in practice and of numerical methods.

articles.title_zh: 高斯穆福德-沙赫模型在价值分配上通过同值平面最小化器的存在
articles.content_zh: Gaussian Mumford-Shah模型通过将连续多变量的Gaussian负向日志词加周边惩罚来将一幅图像分入区域. 它被用于有分级和矢量值的图像,特别是超光谱图像,但一般不能保证存在最小化器. 每当一个单一区域的同质性退化时,无论这些区域的周边情况如何,能源都不受限制。 所有区域同位素上的一个定量同位素下层,或等同地统一的Hölder相继性,并最多在直方图上所有一维边际的其中一维相接性,保证能量的下限和最小化器的存在. 因此,我们的做法表明,存在源于图像直方图的属性,我们还认为,不能存在规模独立的共变地层。 加入一个量化的同分层是通用的:它几乎可以肯定地保存着所有有适当噪音的图像。 作为我们理论的应用,我们显示了实践中使用的正典模型和数字方法的趋同.

articles.title: DewHand: Direct Metric World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos
articles.content: Recovering metric world-space hand motion from egocentric video supports understanding human interactions and transferring them to embodied agents. Three challenges complicate this task: multi-stage pipelines propagate errors from independently estimated hand and camera motion; monocular observations leave physical scale ambiguous; and occlusion and out-of-view hands admit multiple plausible motion trajectories. We present DewHand, a unified model for direct joint reconstruction of world-space hand and camera motion. To avoid compounding errors from multi-stage estimation, DewHand jointly predicts hand and camera motion in a shared world coordinate system within a single-stage pipeline. To resolve metric-scale ambiguity, it combines scene-level geometric features from VGGT-$Ω$ with metric-space supervision, while hand-specific features preserve fine-grained articulation. To handle occlusion and out-of-view hands, we formulate reconstruction as conditional motion generation with flow matching. Under the same architecture, this generative formulation outperforms direct regression in both accuracy and temporal smoothness with only two sampling steps. Experiments on HOT3D and ARCTIC demonstrate improved world-space accuracy and temporal consistency over state-of-the-art methods. DewHand reduces rigid-aligned world-space error relative to StableHand from 32.9 to 28.4 mm on HOT3D and from 76.2 to 36.2 mm on ARCTIC. It also recovers camera scale within 10% on two thirds of HOT3D clips, versus about a quarter for SLAM. Moreover, in zero-shot evaluations on HoloAssist, H2O, and TACO, captured with different devices, DewHand achieves the lowest rigid-aligned world-space error (WA-MPJPE) on each dataset.

articles.title_zh: DewHand:来自爱高中心视频的直取量子世界-空间手动重建
articles.content_zh: 从以自我为中心的视频中恢复测量的世界-空间手动,有助于理解人类的相互作用,并将它们转移给体现的物剂。 三项挑战使这项任务复杂化:多阶段管道传播独立估计的手动和相机运动出错;单相机观察使物理尺度模糊;隔离和视线外的手能识别出多种可能的运动轨迹。 我们介绍DewHand,一种直接联合重建世界空间手和相机运动的统一模式. 为了避免多相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 为了解决公制尺度的模糊性,它把场景水平的几何特征从VGGT-$-$与公制空间监督相结合,而手定特征则保留了精细的相接性. 为了处理被隔离和视线外的手,我们把重建设计成有条件的有流量相匹配的运动生成. 在同一结构下,这种基因配体在精确度和时间平滑度上都超过了直接回归,只有两个取样步骤. 关于HOT3D和ARCTIC的实验表明,世界空间的准确性和时间一致性比最先进的方法有所提高。 与StableHand相比,DewHand将刚性相通的世界-空间误差从HOT3D上的32.9毫米降低到28.4毫米,将ARCTIC上的76.2毫米降低到36.2毫米. 在HOT3D的三分之二片段上,摄相机比例也在10%以内,而SLAM则约为四分之一. 此外,在用不同设备捕获到的HoloAssist,H2O,和TACO的零镜头评价中,DewHand在每个数据集上实现了最低刚性-相通世界-空间误差(WA-MPJPE).

articles.title: CausalAlign: Causal Alignment of Video Generation Models for Consistent Ego-Motion
articles.content: Diffusion-based video generation models (VGMs) can produce visually plausible videos, yet their camera ego-motion often drifts over long horizons. Camera ego-motion determines how the viewpoint changes between frames and is essential for maintaining consistent geometry and trajectories. To address this problem, we propose CausalAlign, a causal alignment framework with two components. First, we diagnose how precise ego motion is represented, used, and retained within VGMs using linear probes and causal interventions, revealing a rise-and-fall pattern during denoising. Second, we strengthen ego-motion state in VGM by aligning the representations at the identified layers to a 3D foundation model through delta-token space. This space encodes the changes between consecutive frames, allowing the alignment to focus on ego-motion dynamics rather than static scene content. With Wan2.2 fine-tuned on DL3DV and RealEstate10K, CausalAlign can largely improve motion accuracy, geometric consistency, and temporal smoothness, while preserving visual quality. For example, it improves geometric consistency by more than 20% relative to the base model. Moreover, with the fine-tuned VGM, CausalAlign improves the success rate of world action models (WAMs) by 10 points on mobile manipulation tasks of RoboCasa365 benchmark. Overall, CausalAlign improves ego-motion consistency in diffusion-based VGMs and yields noticeable gains in embodied models.

articles.title_zh: CausalAlign: 视频生成模式对接一致的Ego-Motion
articles.content_zh: 以传播为基础的视频生成模型(VGMs)可以产生视觉上可信的视频,然而他们的相机自负-运动往往会漂移到长的地平线上. 相机自负-运动决定了视角在相框之间如何变化,对于保持相容的几何和轨迹至关重要. 为了解决这一问题,我们提议建立由两个部分组成的因果协调框架CausalAlign。 首先,我们通过线性探测和因果干预, 来判断自我运动的精确性, 使用和保留在VGM内部, 揭示了在解密期间的起伏模式。 其次,我们通过三角空基空间,将识别层的表达方式与3D基础模型相协调,从而加强了VGM中的自动机状态. 这个空间编码了相继相框之间的变化,使得对齐能够专注于自负-运动动态而不是静态场景内容. 随着Wan2.2在DL3DV和RealEstate10K上进行微调,CausalAlign可以在很大程度上提高运动精度,几何一致性,以及时间平滑性,同时保持视觉质量. 例如,相对于基模型,它能使几何一致性提高20%以上. 此外,随着VGM的微调,CausalAlign在RoboCasa365基准的移动操纵任务上将世界行动模型的成功率提高了10分. 总体而言,CausalAlign提高了基于传播的VGM的自负-运动一致性,并在所体现模式中取得了显著收益。

articles.title: Asking a Multimodal LLM Whether Someone Fell: Zero-Shot Screening of Low-Resolution Thermal Video in a Laboratory and an Occupied Home
articles.content: Thermal cameras can watch over older people living alone without capturing faces, and multimodal large language models (LLMs) can judge a short video without task-specific training. We evaluate a production multimodal LLM, Gemini 3.8 Flash at temperature 0, as the decision stage of an event-triggered fall screener, used exactly as a deployed prototype uses it: one request per short thermal clip, with its sound track when there is one, and its predecessor Gemini 3.7 Flash on the same requests. On 438 staged falls and 563 non-fall windows that we located by hand in a public 32x24 thermal dataset, the deployed request called 69% of the held-out subjects' falls (67% over all subjects; bed falls excluded) and none of 499 non-fall windows, including people lying on the floor and getting up. Over 76 h of ordinary life in an occupied room, recorded at 160x120 with sound, it called none of 395 clips a fall (95% upper bound 1.2 false alarms per day) and caught 4 of the 9 staged falls the camera could see. One cautionary sentence in the prompt ("a person who goes out of view ... is not a fall") accounted for many of the misses: removing it raised sensitivity on the held-out subjects from 69% to 83% on 3.8 Flash and from 80% to 92% on Gemini 3.7 Flash, and in the home from 4 to 9 of the 9 visible falls, with no false call in ordinary living but at the price of calling deliberate lie-downs a fall. Sensitivity collapsed at 8x6 pixels (34%); identical requests disagreed on 4% of windows; and when the model called a fall, its explanation placed it within a second of the annotated landing 99% of the time. Two conventional detectors trained on the laboratory data caught nearly every held-out laboratory fall but raised 14.2 and 23.9 false alarms per day in the home. We release the frame-level fall annotations of the public dataset and every model answer on it.

articles.title: ViBMR: A Large-Scale Multi-Sequence Brain MRI Dataset and Comprehensive Evaluation for Vietnamese Radiology Report Generation
articles.content: Automated radiology report generation for multi-sequence brain MRI holds strong promise for alleviating radiologists' workload, yet it remains a demanding problem: brain MRI studies are inherently volumetric, each pulse sequence carries complementary diagnostic information, and annotated data are critically scarce for low-resource clinical languages. Existing brain MRI-report resources are still dominated by English reports, translated clinical text, or datasets adapted from task-specific imaging benchmarks, leaving routine low-resource clinical reporting and heterogeneous multi-sequence MRI protocols insufficiently represented. To bridge this gap, we introduce ViBMR, to the best of our knowledge, the first large-scale multi-sequence brain MRI dataset paired with routine Vietnamese clinical reports, comprising 3,649 patients and 11,875 MRI series across T1, T2, FLAIR, and contrast-enhanced T1 sequences. Building on ViBMR, we establish a comprehensive evaluation setup for brain MRI report generation, covering representative medical vision-language models, multi-sequence inputs, and feature aggregation strategies. The results provide key insights into dataset characteristics and model behavior, while demonstrating the necessity of native low-resource clinical datasets for reliable Vietnamese-origin brain MRI report generation. Our dataset and baseline models will be released for non-commercial research.

articles.content_zh: 为多序列脑磁共振生成自动放射学报告对减轻放射科医生的工作量很有希望,然而,这仍然是一个很棘手的问题:脑磁共振研究本质上是体积的,每个脉冲序列都带有补充性诊断信息,对低资源临床语言而言,附加说明的数据极为稀缺。 现有的大脑核磁共振报告资源仍然以英文报告,翻译临床文本,或根据特定任务成像基准而改编的数据集为主,使得常规的低资源临床报告和多序列核磁共振协议没有得到充分体现. 为了弥合这一差距,我们向大家介绍我们所了解的最早的大规模多序列脑磁共振数据集与越南常规临床报告对接,由3,649名患者和11,875个核磁共振系列组成,跨越了T1,T2,FLAIR,以及对比增强的T1序列. 在生物、生物、MR的基础上,我们为编制脑磁共振报告建立了全面的评价机制,涵盖有代表性的医学视觉语言模型、多序列投入和特征汇总战略。 这些结果提供了对数据集特征和模型行为的关键见解,同时证明了本地低资源临床数据集对于可靠的越南原生脑磁共振报告生成的必要性. 我们的数据集和基线模型将发布,用于非商业研究.

articles.title: Expandable Modality Experts for Medical Vision-Language Learning
articles.content: Learning across medical imaging modalities requires making use of images without paired text and accommodating new domains while retaining existing representations. We propose a medical vision-language technique built around an expandable bank of modality experts. Its Multiway Transformer combines shared visual computation with deterministically routed feed-forward experts and a separate text pathway. A modality-aware visual tokenizer supplies targets for masked pretraining on 19.4 million unpaired image rows across seven modalities; contrastive alignment then uses 3.23 million image-text pairs. Additional fundus and optical coherence tomography experts learn from paired data while the original image and text embedding paths remain frozen. With a ViT-Large backbone, the proposed technique achieves the best or tied-best result in 24 of 25 benchmark settings across nine modalities: 10 of 11 zero-shot classification benchmarks, all 10 linear probes, and all four retrieval benchmarks. Mean balanced accuracy is 0.674 for zero-shot classification and 0.856 for linear probing, and mean bidirectional retrieval recall is 20.70%. A separate three-seed sequential experiment with matched adaptation data yields fundus and OCT retrieval gains of 14.95 and 9.31 percentage points, with no measured loss on preceding fundus or pathology tasks. The preservation argument requires unchanged existing computation paths and inference conditions, and feature-identity checks verify retention on evaluated inputs. The proposed technique provides a modular approach to learning and expanding medical vision-language representations.

articles.title_zh: 医疗远景-语言学习可扩展模式专家
articles.content_zh: 跨医学成像模式的学习需要使用不配对文本的图像,并适应新的领域,同时保留现有的表述。 我们提出一种医疗视觉语言技术 围绕一个可扩展的模式专家库。 其多向变形器将共享的视觉计算与确定路由的向导传输专家和单独的文本路径相结合。 一种具有模式意识的视觉示意器为覆盖7个模式的1,940万个未发光图像行的遮掩预训提供目标;对比对接然后使用323万个图像文本对. 更多的Fundus和光学一致性图谱学专家从配对数据中学习,而原始图像和文本嵌入路径仍然被冻结. 采用ViT-Large主干线,该拟议技术在25个基准设置中的24个实现最佳或捆绑最佳结果,涵盖9个模式:11个零发分级基准中的10个,所有10个线性探测器,以及所有4个检索基准。 平均平衡精度为:零发分级为0.674;线性测试为0.856;平均双向回取回20.70%. 与适应数据相匹配的三种子相继试验产生Fundus和OCT检索增益为14.95和9.31个百分点,以往的Fundus或病理任务没有衡量损失。 保存论证要求现有的计算路径和推断条件不变,特征识别检查对被评价的投入进行验证保留. 拟议技术为学习和扩大医疗视觉语言表述提供了模块化方法。

articles.title: Stochastic Nonlinearities Improve Uncertainty Estimation
articles.content: Reliable uncertainty estimation is important across visual recognition tasks, providing information about the confidence and reliability of model predictions. Many uncertainty estimation methods obtain predictive diversity through mechanisms that can suppress intermediate features, perturb the input, or require substantial additional computation. Stochastic activation functions, where network units randomly select between multiple nonlinearities during a forward pass, have previously been used to improve optimization behavior, mitigate limitations of fixed ReLU activations, and increase output diversity. In this work, we reframe stochastic activation switching as a lightweight mechanism for uncertainty estimation. The proposed method samples between nonlinear activation functions, inducing predictive diversity while keeping intermediate feature pathways active. This enables uncertainty estimation from a single trained model without the training cost of ensembles, task-specific uncertainty heads, or architectural redesign. We evaluate the proposed approach across classification, semantic segmentation, and out-of-distribution detection using convolutional and transformer-based architectures on diverse datasets. Across these settings, stochastic activation switching improves uncertainty quality while preserving competitive primary-task performance, showing that stochastic nonlinearities provide an effective and information-preserving source of predictive variation for visual recognition.

articles.title_zh: 非线性改善不确定性估计
articles.content_zh: 可靠的不确定性估计在视觉识别任务中都很重要,它提供了有关模型预测的信心和可靠性的信息。 许多不确定性估计方法通过能够压制中间特征、扰动输入或需要大量额外计算的机制获得预测多样性。 Stochastic活化功能,即网络单元在前行行期间在多条非线性之间随机选择,之前曾被用来改进优化行为,减轻固定ReLU活化的限制,并增加输出多样性. 在这项工作中,我们重新塑造了可变活化的活化转换,作为不确定性估计的轻量级机制. 拟议的方法样本介于非线性活化函数之间,诱导预测多样性,同时保持中间特征路径活性. 这使得能够从单一的训练有素的模型中作出不确定性估计,而无需培训综艺节目、具体任务的不确定性主管或建筑重新设计的费用。 我们评估拟议的方法,包括分类、语义分解、分配外检测等,在各种数据集上采用以转录和变压器为基础的结构。 在整个这些设置中,活化活化切换提高了不确定性的质量,同时保持了竞争性的初级任务性能,表明活化非线性为视觉识别提供了有效和信息保存的预测变异源.

articles.title: GeoMem-VLA: Internalizing 3D Scene Understanding into Temporal Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
articles.content: Geometric structure is essential for robotic manipulation and understanding the 3D world. Most VLA models rely on 2D representations of current observations, while geometry-aware approaches often require additional 3D information. However, geometry inferred independently from individual observations is often discarded rather than accumulated into a persistent task representation. Our key insight is that action generation needs a compact, task-relevant geometric abstraction that can be continuously updated, rather than a complete, renderable 3D reconstruction at every step. We introduce GeoMem-VLA, a VLA framework that internalizes explicit 3D supervision into dedicated geometric tokens and maintains them as temporal memory for action generation, without directly aligning the VLM's native visual embeddings with the teacher feature space. During training, a frozen geometry foundation model supervises learnable GeoPlan tokens through a geometric flow-matching objective over the current scene point map and future end-effector tracks. These tokens are integrated with the memory of observation representations, where historical information is retrieved, adaptively fused with current observations, and consolidated to retain event frames as the task progresses. At inference, the policy retrieves historical representations and fuses them with the current working representation to predict actions, without invoking the 3D teacher or explicitly reconstructing the scene. After benchmark-specific downstream adaptation, GeoMem-VLA achieves 98.9% average success on LIBERO and 91.10% / 91.24% on RoboTwin's clean/randomized settings. Across five real-world tasks, GeoMem-VLA achieves 78.0% average success. These results suggest that internalizing and remembering 3D scene understanding is a promising approach to robot control.

articles.title_zh: GeoMem-VLA:将3D场景理解内化为视觉-语言-行动模型的瞬间记忆
articles.content_zh: 几何结构对于机器人操纵和理解3D世界至关重要. 大多数VLA模型依赖于当前观测的2D表示,而几何-知觉方法往往需要额外的3D信息. 然而,从个别观察中独立推断出来的几何往往被抛弃,而不是被累积成一个持续的任务表述. 我们的主要见解是,行动生成需要一种紧凑的、与任务相关的几何抽象,这种抽象可以不断更新,而不是在每一个步骤上进行完整的、可转换的三维重建。 我们引入了GeoMem-VLA,这是一个VLA框架,将明确的3D监督内化为专用几何符号,并保持它们作为动作生成的时间记忆,而不会直接将VLM的原生视觉嵌入与老师的特有空间相配合. 在训练期间,一个被冻结的几何地基模型通过一个几何相容的目标,对可学习的地平规划符号进行监督,该目标将覆盖目前的地平线地平线地平线和未来的终点效应轨道。 这些标志与观测表达的内存相融合,其中历史信息被检索,适应性地与当前观测相融合,并被合并,以保留随着任务进展的事件帧. 推论,政策取回了历史表述,并将其与目前的工作表述相融合,以预测行动,而无需引用3D老师或明确重建场景. 在具体基准下游适应后,GeoMem-VLA在LIBERO上取得了98.9%的平均成功,在RoboTwin的清洁/随机设置上取得了91.10%/91.24%的平均成功. 在五个现实世界的任务中,GeoMem-VLA取得了78.0%的平均成功. 这些结果表明,对3D场景的内化和记忆理解是机器人控制的一种有希望的方法.

articles.title: How Do DiTs Denoise? An Aggregator-Predictor View of Attention and MLPs
articles.content: How do diffusion transformers (DiTs) represent image content and learn rules for reusing it to generalize? We develop an aggregator--predictor view of DiTs as input-adaptive local denoisers, in which context aggregation and patch prediction provide functional roles for interpreting attention and MLPs. We first establish that, for Gaussian Markov random field (GMRF) priors, the global Bayes denoiser can be approximated using only a subset of context patches, with error decaying exponentially in context radius. We further show that patchwise linear denoisers, often invoked to explain diffusion generalization, recover the empirical local denoiser with sufficiently informative aggregation. Within this view, AdaLN-modulated attention naturally parameterizes an input- and noise-dependent aggregator, while the MLP admits a learned key--value representation for tokenwise patch prediction. Our experiments support this view. DiTs trained on real images exhibit noise-dependent denoising contexts resembling those in the analytic GMRF setting, while attention mass exhibits a qualitatively corresponding broadening pattern. In a controlled CelebA64 study, shared-memory patch predictors used in place of DiT MLPs achieve competitive denoising and generative performance. Finally, cross-dataset component transplantation reveals compatibility patterns consistent with the proposed roles of QK in spatial weighting, VO in feature transport, and MLPs in patch prediction. Together, these results provide a component-level account of DiT denoising and motivate architecture-specific fine-tuning and controlled intervention.

articles.title_zh: 迪特斯·德诺瓦斯怎么样? 注意力和MLP的聚合-前导视图
articles.content_zh: 扩散变压器(DiTs)如何代表图像内容并学习重用它来概括的规则? 我们开发一种聚合-前导视图,将 DiTs 视为可输入-可适应的本地阴极,其中上下文聚合和补丁预测提供了解释注意力和MLP的功能作用. 我们首先确定,对于高斯·马尔可夫随机字段(GMRF)前传,全球Bayes denoiser可以仅使用上下文补丁的子集进行近似化,误差在上下文半径上成指数地衰变. 我们进一步显示, 补丁线性阴茎, 经常被引用来解释扩散一般化, 用足够的信息聚合来恢复经验性的地方阴茎。 在这个观点中,AdaLN调制的注意力自然参数化了一个依赖输入和噪声的聚合器,而MLP则承认了一种学习到的按键-值表示,用于象征性的补丁预测. 我们的实验支持这一观点。 接受过真实图像培训的DiT显示与分析性GMRF环境相似的依赖噪声的去诺环境,而关注量则显示质量上相应的扩大模式。 在一项受控制的CelebA64研究中,用来代替 DiT MLP 的共享-memory补丁预测器实现竞争性去诺能和基因分泌性能. 最后,跨数据集组件移植揭示出与QK在空间权重设定中的拟议作用相符合的相容性模式,特征迁移中的VO,以及补丁预测中的MLP. 这些结果共同提供了DiT调制和激励特定架构的微调和控制干预的组件级账户.

articles.title: Revealing Hidden Failure Modes in Chest X-ray Classification via Spectral Domain Analysis
articles.content: Deep learning models for chest X-ray anomaly detection remain vulnerable to subtle distributional shifts (e.g., acquisition technique, patient-related factors, and preprocessing). Traditional error analysis often relies on semantic metadata or model embeddings, which can mask low-level signal variations that degrade performance. In this work, we propose a data-centric framework for automated failure mode discovery using spectral analysis. We project images into the frequency domain and extract a compact profile summarizing the distribution of signal energy across frequency bands. By performing unsupervised clustering on these spectral profiles, we demonstrate that model failures are not randomly distributed, but are strongly concentrated within specific spectral clusters. This method effectively isolates "blind spots", enabling the prediction of model reliability and the discovery of performance-degrading data slices without requiring ground-truth failure annotations.

articles.title_zh: 通过光谱域分析揭示胸X射线分类中的隐藏失败模式
articles.content_zh: 胸X射线异常检测的深层学习模型仍然容易受到微妙的分布性转变(如获取技术,与患者相关的因素,以及预处理)的影响. 传统的错误分析往往依赖于语义元数据或模型嵌入,这可以掩盖能降解性能的低等信号变异. 在这项工作中,我们提出一个利用光谱分析进行自动化故障模式发现的数据中心框架. 我们把图像投射到频率域 并提取一个紧凑的剖面图 总结信号能量在频率段的分布 通过在这些光谱剖面上进行不受监督的集群,我们证明了模型故障不是随机分布的,而是被强烈集中在特定的光谱集群内. 这种方法有效地将"盲点"隔离出,使得能够预测模型的可靠性并发现能分解性能的数据片而无需地面-真实故障说明.

articles.title: Early versus Late RGB-Infrared Fusion for Counter-UAV Detection: A Comparative Study
articles.content: This paper presents a novel strategy for UAV detection through visible (RGB) and infrared (IR) fusion, in order to improve accuracy and precision in harsh environments and weather conditions. In this research, two opposite approaches have been studied and implemented: the first concerns image-level (early) fusion, which merges two different spectra into a single image to which one detector is applied. On the other hand, the second approach, called decision-level (late) fusion, focuses on blending together the output bounding boxes of two different detection pipelines, aiming to create a common result that can be applied to both spectra simultaneously. Both strategies have been extensively tested in a dedicated environment, which included alternating low and high brightness scenes, different backgrounds (sky and ground), distances (5, 25 and 60 m), altitudes and zoom levels (1X, 2X and 4X). These tests allowed for the assessment of actual detection capabilities and system reliability in real-world applications. Furthermore, the two fusion strategies were evaluated and compared over a set of aligned images in order to highlight the better approach of the two. The results indicate that early fusion achieves better raw performance, since it incorporates the thermal information from the beginning of the training process. However, late fusion presents an innovative and useful detection workflow that can be applied in cases of sensor or frame misalignment. Both positive and negative aspects have also been pointed out and discussed, in order to give a more comprehensive overview. Finally, the paper outlines implementation considerations and practical recommendations based on operational priorities. Overall, the findings contribute to the research in RGB-IR fusion modalities, with the goal of enhancing UAV detection capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 反UAV的早期对后期RGB-红外融合 检测:比较研究
articles.content_zh: 本文提出了通过可见(RGB)和红外(IR)聚变进行无人驾驶航空器探测的新策略,以在恶劣环境和天气条件下提高准确度和精确度. 在这项研究中,研究并执行了两种相反的方法: 第一种是图像级(早期)聚变,将两个不同的光谱合并成一个单一的图像,用于一个探测器. 另一方面,第二种方法称为决策级(后期)聚变,其重点是将两个不同探测管的输出边框混合在一起,目的是形成一个共同的结果,可以同时应用于两个光谱. 这两项战略都在一个专门的环境中进行了广泛的测试,其中包括交替的低亮度和高亮度场景,不同的背景(天空和地上),距离(5、25和60米),高度和放大水平(1X、2X和4X)。 这些测试有助于评估实际世界应用中的实际探测能力和系统可靠性。 此外,对两个聚变战略进行了评价并比较了一套一致的图像,以突出两者的更好办法。 结果表明,早期聚变可以实现更好的原始性能,因为它从培训过程一开始就纳入了热能信息。 然而,后聚变呈现出一种创新而有用的检测工作流程,可用于传感器或帧错配的情况. 还提出并讨论了积极和消极两个方面,以便进行更全面的概述。 最后,文件根据业务优先事项概述了执行方面的考虑和切实可行的建议。 总体而言,研究结果有助于RGB-IR聚变方式的研究,目的是提高无人驾驶航空器的探测能力.

articles.title: GuidedSAM-Plume: An Expert-Guided Segmentation Framework for Volcanic Plumes
articles.content: Quantitative analysis of environmental phenomena increasingly relies on image-based measurements. In volcanology, the geometric characterization of volcanic plumes and clouds from RGB images remains hindered by the scarcity of dedicated segmentation solutions and partially handcrafted annotations remain widely prevalent. We present GuidedSAM-Plume, an open-source expert-guided framework tailored for the interactive segmentation of volcanic plumes and clouds. It leverages the zero-shot, spatial prompt-based capabilities of SAM2. The framework was thoroughly validated on a challenging dataset through dedicated segmentation metrics and field-relevant volcanological descriptors. From minimal user inputs, it is able to significantly increase performance compared to fully automatic dedicated solutions while preserving the reliability of derived volcanological parameters. The absence of retraining requirements lowers adoption barriers within the volcanological community, and the framework's demonstrated suitability for complex, diffuse plume-shaped phenomena extends its applicability to broader environmental science domains. The re-annotated dataset, produced under the guidance of expert volcanologists within the proposed framework, ultimately yields a more standardized release. The framework and accompanying dataset are made available at https://github.com/tad-damo/GuidedSAM-Plume.

articles.title_zh: GuidedSAM-Plume:由专家指导的火山柱分块框架
articles.content_zh: 对环境现象的定量分析越来越依赖于基于图像的测量. 在火山学中,来自RGB图像的火山羽和云的几何特征因专用分解溶液的缺乏而仍然受到阻碍,而部分手工制作的说明仍然普遍存在. 我们介绍GuidedSAM-Plume,这是专门为火山羽流和云层交互分化设计的开源专家指导框架。 它利用了SAM2的零发速成能力. 该框架通过专用分块测量仪和与实地有关的火山描述仪,在一个具有挑战性的数据集上得到了彻底验证。 与全自动专用解决方案相比,它从最低限度的用户输入可以大大提高性能,同时保持了所衍生出火山参数的可靠性. 缺乏再培训要求降低了火山学界内的收养障碍,而且该框架已证明适合复杂而分散的羽毛状现象,从而将其适用于更广泛的环境科学领域。 重新附加说明的数据集在拟议框架内由火山学家专家指导制作,最终使数据发布更加标准化。 框架和配套数据集见https://github.com/tad-damo/GuidedSAM-Plume。

articles.title: Compositionality with Primitives: A Unified View from Euclidean to Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) aims to recognize novel combinations of previously observed objects and attributes. Prior work showed that large-scale vision-language models encode decomposable semantic structures that can be recomposed to enable generalization. The Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) framework formalizes this by identifying directions in the tangent space at the Frechet mean of the embedding distribution, which encode primitive visual concepts. Unseen attribute-object compositions can be synthesized through vector addition of these primitives. We revisit the assumption that compositional generalization requires explicit attribute-object pair re-composition. By means of new compositional scoring functions and extensive evaluations, we show that directly using the decomposed primitives suffices for recognizing unseen compositions. In that, we gain insights on how the geometry of the embedding manifold (Euclidean, spherical, or hyperbolic) and dataset structure affect compositional reasoning. Across models (CLIP, DINOv2, MERU, HyCoCLIP), we show that compositional structure consistently emerges as primitive representations, enabling inference on CZSL benchmarks (MIT-States, VAW-CZSL, UT-Zappos50K, Clothing16K) and group robustness on Waterbirds and CelebA. Code: https://github.com/nis-research/Compositionality-with-Primitives.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 具有先入为主的构成性:从欧克利德到超曲线视野-语言模型的统一视图
articles.content_zh: 组成式零发学习(CZSL)旨在识别以前观测到的物体和属性的新颖组合. 之前的研究表明,大规模视觉语言模型将可分解的语义结构编码,可以被再分解来进行通化. 大地测量可分解嵌入物(GDE)框架通过确定嵌入物分布的Frechet平均值正切空间中的方向,将这一点正式化,该数值编码了原始的视觉概念. 不明属性-对象组成可以通过这些原始物的向量添加来合成. 我们重温一个假设,即组成通论需要明确的属性-对象对再分解. 通过新的组成评分功能和广泛的评价,我们显示,直接使用被分解的原始物就足以识别无形的组成。 由此,我们对嵌入多面体(Euclidean,球形或双曲形)的几何学和数据集结构如何影响组成推理有了深刻的认识. 在各种模型(CLIP、DINOv2、MERU、HyCoCLIP)中,我们显示组成结构一直作为原始代表出现,从而能够推论CZSL的基准(MIT-States、VAW-CZSL、UT-Zappos50K、Cloat16K)和水鸟和CelebA上的组稳健性。

articles.title: Open-Vocabulary Models and Label Propagation for Uncertainty-aware Pseudo-Labeling of Object Detection Datasets
articles.content: Object detection models rely on large-scale annotated datasets that require substantial manual annotation effort. The labeling costs further increase when annotation uncertainty is captured through soft labels, as multiple annotations must be collected for each object. We address this challenge by introducing a semi-supervised framework for the uncertainty-aware annotation of object detection datasets. Our approach leverages open-vocabulary object detectors to generate region proposals and semantically meaningful object representations. Based on these representations, we construct an object-level similarity graph and propagate probabilistic label information. Our framework assigns soft labels to previously unlabeled objects, quantifying both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. We evaluate our method on four object detection benchmarks with soft-label annotations and demonstrate that high-quality annotations can be obtained with only a small fraction of manually labeled objects. Furthermore, we show that detectors trained on semi-automatically annotated data achieve performance comparable to models trained on fully manually annotated data. We achieve state-of-the-art downstream detection performance for the task of semi-supervised object detection on the COCO dataset, with 40.5% AP virtually matching the performance of the model trained on fully manually constructed data (40.9%) at only 1% of labeling costs. These results highlight the potential of open-vocabulary models and graph-based label propagation for efficient, accurate and uncertainty-aware pseudo-labeling.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 对象检测数据集的未确定认知的开放式词汇模型和标签宣传
articles.content_zh: 对象检测模型依赖于需要大量人工注释的大规模注释数据集. 标签成本在通过软标签获取注释不确定性时会进一步增加,因为每个对象必须收集多条注释. 我们通过引入一个半监督框架来应对这一挑战,即对物体检测数据集的不确定性作出认知。 我们的方法利用了开放式的活性物体探测器,生成区域建议和具有高度意义的物体表示。 基于这些表述,我们构建出一个对象级相似性图并传播概率标签信息. 我们的框架为以前没有标签的物体分配了软标签,量化了厌食和感知的不确定性。 我们用四个带有软标签说明的物体探测基准来评价我们的方法,并表明只有一小部分手动标记物体才能获得高质量的说明. 此外,我们显示,经过半自动附加说明数据培训的探测器的性能与经过完全人工附加说明数据培训的模型相当。 在COCO数据集上实现半监控对象检测任务最先进的下游检测性能,40.5%的AP几乎匹配了完全人工构建的数据所训练的模型性能(40.9%),其标签成本仅为1%. 这些结果突出表明了公开票价模型和以图表为基础的标签传播对有效、准确和不确定的假标签的潜在作用。

articles.title: JointLight: Human-Centric Video Relighting with Asynchronous RGB-Irradiance Joint Modeling
articles.content: Understanding and modeling light transport in human-centric scenes is a longstanding challenge. While recent progress in diffusion models has boosted research in relighting, precise illumination control still lags, primarily due to the scarcity of diverse, high-quality, precisely labeled video relighting datasets. Existing end-to-end relighting approaches model light transport implicitly through neural networks, which substantially complicates controllability. In contrast, some works resort to path-traced irradiance cues as an explicit blueprint for light transport. However, such constructed irradiance cues are prone to artifacts and hinder generative quality when directly used as control signals. With the key observation that noise corruption removes high-frequency artifacts and preserves low-frequency light transport, we introduce an asynchronous joint-modeling paradigm that facilitates fine-grained illumination control. During two-stage training, we force the model to jointly denoise RGB and ground-truth irradiance frames with separate timesteps scheduling. A domain matching strategy is applied to the second stage to bridge the domain gap between irradiance cues and ground-truth irradiance maps. At inference time, we introduce an asynchronous hijacked generation pipeline that facilitates flexible illumination control. For training data, we develop a multi-illumination high-quality synthetic video dataset with paired irradiance maps using a powerful game engine. Trained exclusively on this dataset, our model exhibits robust generalization to real- world scenarios and outperforms prior approaches in both lighting fidelity and generative quality. The code and dataset will be publicly released.

articles.title_zh: 联合光:以同步RGB-异能联合建模为载人-儿童视频再亮相
articles.content_zh: 在以人为中心的场景中理解并建模轻型运输是一个长期的挑战。 虽然最近在传播模型方面的进展推动了再点亮方面的研究,但准确的照明控制仍然滞后,主要原因是缺乏多样、高质量、贴有准确标签的视频再点亮数据集。 现有的端到端再照方法模式光传输隐含地通过神经网络,这极大地使可控性复杂化. 相形之下,一些工程采用路径跟踪辐射提示作为光能运输的明确蓝图. 然而,这种已建成的辐照道口在直接用作控制信号时容易出现文物并会妨碍基因质量。 以噪声腐败能去除高频文物并保存低频光能运输的关键观察,我们引入了一种同步联合模型范式来方便精细的发光控制. 在两个阶段的训练中,我们强迫模型联合去除RGB和地面-真实辐射框架,并分别安排时间步骤。 第二阶段采用了域匹配策略来弥合辐射提示和地-真辐射图之间的域间隙. 在推论中,我们引入了一个同步被劫持的发电管道,以方便灵活的照明控制。 对于训练数据,我们利用强大的游戏引擎开发出多发光能高品质的合成视频数据集,并配对出辐射图. 我们的模型专门对这一数据集进行了培训,显示了对现实世界情景的强烈概括,在照明忠诚度和基因质量方面都超过了以往的做法。 代码和数据集将公开发布.

articles.title: Key Findings for Small UAS for Post-Disaster Damage Assessment from the CURSE'26 Exercise
articles.content: The CLARKE building and road damage assessment AI classifier was incorporated into the Catastrophic Unmanned Remote Sensing Exercise (CURSE) 2026, which trained 23 small uncrewed aerial systems (sUAS) teams from state and local agencies and non-governmental organizations in Florida and Missouri on how to collect imagery for an incident command Remote Sensing Cell. Although CLARKE has been operationally deployed to two hurricanes (Debby and Helene), CURSE'26 presented an opportunity to evaluate the machine learning model with a larger set of never-before-seen orthomosaics. The results show that building and road damage assessment together ran in 3.5 minutes on average, and that building damage assessment achieved a Micro F1 of 0.834 with no manual adjustments to correct spatial misalignment and delivered that performance in both Florida and Missouri, demonstrating good geographic transfer. It also showed that road damage assessment performed poorly due to sensitivity to misalignment between road maps and the images, and to lighting and environmental conditions in an urban setting. The analysis of CURSE'26 presents five other findings of value to the sUAS community: that the use of sUAS and machine learning is now operationally normalized and accepted, sUAS teams in the field can improve classification accuracy by timing their flights, exercises are good operational tests but their value for evaluating learning models is less clear, edge computing is needed to overcome the wireless upload barrier, and the application of sUAS and AI to disaster response has ethical and legal ramifications for pilots and data managers.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CURSE'26演习关于灾害后损害评估小型无人机系统的主要调查结果
articles.content_zh: CLARKE的建筑和道路损坏评估AI分类器被纳入了2026年灾难无人遥感演习(CURSE),该演习对来自佛罗里达州和地方机构和非政府组织的23个小型无人驾驶航空系统小组进行了关于如何为事件指挥遥感小组收集图像的培训。 虽然CLARKE已经实际部署在了两场飓风(德比和海伦)上,但CURSE'26提供了一个机会,用更大的一套永不见光的正交形来评价机器学习模型. 结果显示,建筑和道路损坏评估平均在3.5分钟内进行,建筑损坏评估实现了0.834的Micro F1,没有进行人工调整来纠正空间错位,并在佛罗里达州和密苏里州都实现了这一性能,显示出良好的地理学转移. 评估还显示,道路损坏评估表现不佳,原因是对路线图和图像之间不一致的敏感性以及城市环境中的照明和环境条件。 对CURSE'26的分析提出了对SUAS社区有价值的其他5个结论:SUAS和机器学习的使用现已在业务上正常化并被接受,SUAS在外地的团队可以通过飞行时间提高分类准确性,练习是良好的操作测试,但其评价学习模型的价值并不明确,需要边际计算来克服无线上传障碍,SUAS和AI在救灾中的应用对飞行员和数据管理人员具有伦理和法律影响.

articles.title: UniRAP: Towards Unified Part-level Physical Affordance Reasoning and Actionable Perception
articles.content: Vision-language perception has achieved impressive progress in aligning natural language with visual observations, yet grounding high-level semantics into part-level physical interaction remains challenging. To address this gap, we propose UniRAP, a unified model for inferring part-level physical affordances and mapping language instructions to actionable geometric representations. UniRAP formulates this problem as a conditional multimodal generation task, integrating visual inputs, textual instructions, and optional prompts into a shared spatiotemporal representation space through a unified interface token mechanism. To predict executable contact geometry, we introduce a Unified Affordance Decoder (UAD), which jointly performs object detection, part-level affordance segmentation, and 4-DoF interaction pose estimation by leveraging intermediate segmentation features. In addition, we propose a curriculum-based transfer training strategy that progressively adapts the model from general visual parsing to interaction-aware perception, improving data efficiency under limited textual annotations. Experiments show that UniRAP achieves state-of-the-art performance on referring expression segmentation, affordance grounding, and interaction pose estimation, while maintaining strong spatiotemporal consistency in dynamic video scenarios. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of UniRAP as a unified perception framework for language-guided physical manipulation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 联合RAP:实现统一的部分实体承受能力合理性和可操作性观念
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言感知在将自然语言与视觉观测相配合方面取得了令人印象深刻的进展,然而将高层次的语义定位为部分层次的物理互动仍然具有挑战性. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议采用UniRAP这一统一模式,将部分水平的物理负担和绘图语言说明推向可操作的几何表示。 UniRAP将这个问题表述为有条件的多模式生成任务,通过统一的界面符号机制,将视觉输入,文字指示,以及可选的提示集成到共享的spatiotemporal表示空间. 为了预测可执行的接触几何,我们引入了United Affordance Decoder(UAD),它联合进行对象检测,分层支付分解,以及4-DoF交互通过利用中间分解特性进行估计. 此外,我们提出了基于课程的转移培训战略,该战略逐步使模型从一般视觉解析到互动感知,在有限的文字说明下提高数据效率。 实验表明,UniRAP在转录表达分解、承受力定位和相互作用方面实现了先进的性能,同时在动态视频情景中保持了强烈的瞬间一致性。 这些结果表明UniRAP作为语言引导物理操纵的统一感知框架的有效性.

articles.title: LEAF-Mamba: Feature Adaptation and Fusion for Whole Slide Image Analysis
articles.content: Whole slide image (WSI) analysis enables computational diagnosis and prognosis, but gigapixel images and limited annotations make slide-level learning challenging. Multiple instance learning addresses this task by aggregating patch representations from frozen pretrained encoders. Recently, Mamba has enabled efficient modeling of long patch sequences. However, task supervision alone does not explicitly constrain information recovery during feature adaptation, while Mamba couples local processing with long-range propagation rather than retaining separate representations for fusion. Motivated by these challenges, we introduce LEAF-Mamba, a framework that jointly addresses latent evidence adaptation and fusion for frozen-feature WSI analysis. A reconstruction-regularized adapter learns compact, task-specific representations while reconstructing the input features. Parallel Mamba and convolutional streams then capture long-range dependencies and sequence-local interactions, with an input-dependent gate modulating their joint representation before slide-level pooling. Experiments across feature extractors demonstrate improved average performance over strong MIL baselines in both diagnostic classification and survival prediction. Component analyses further support the contributions of adaptation and fusion. These findings highlight the value of jointly designing feature transformation and contextual aggregation to translate pretrained representations into effective slide-level predictions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LEAF-Mamba:全幻灯片图像分析的特性适应和融合
articles.content_zh: 整个幻灯片图像(WSI)分析可以进行计算诊断和预测,但千兆像素图像和有限的说明使得幻灯片级别的学习具有挑战性. 多个实例学习通过汇总被冻结的被预先训练的编码器的补丁表达来应对这项任务. 最近,曼巴实现了长补丁序列的高效建模. 然而,单靠任务监督并不能明确限制适应特征过程中的信息恢复,而曼巴夫妇则通过远距离传播在当地进行处理,而不是保留单独的聚变表述。 在这些挑战的推动下,我们引入了LEAF-Mamba,这个框架将共同处理潜在的证据适应和聚变,以便进行WSI冷冻特性分析。 重建规范化的适配器在重建输入特征的同时会学习紧凑,任务特有的表现. 然后平行的曼巴和相生流捕捉到长距离的依赖性和序列-局部的相互作用,一个以输入为依存的门在滑行级集合之前会调节他们的联合代表. 跨地物提取器的实验表明,在诊断分类和生存预测两方面,平均性能均高于强的MIL基线。 构成部分分析进一步支持适应和融合的贡献。 这些结论突出了联合设计地物转换和上下文汇总的价值,以便将事先训练过的表示转化为有效的幻灯片级预测.

articles.title: APED-CXR: Adaptive Privileged Evidence Distillation for Chest X-Ray Grounding with Image-Only Inference
articles.content: Compact chest X-ray (CXR) models that localize findings suit deployment, but box annotations are limited and report-aware multimodal models are expensive at inference. We introduce APED-CXR, which distills report-informed spatial evidence from a frozen multimodal teacher into a student with 11.1M parameters that predicts diseases and boxes from shared evidence maps and requires the image alone at test time. During training, the teacher uses the radiograph, report, and queried class to evaluate regions proposed from the student's current evidence maps, and its support scores serve as training targets for the student's pooled evidence scores within these regions. Trained on PadChest and evaluated on held-out PadChest-GR, refreshing the student's proposals for teacher evaluation improves box-level localization F1 from 0.302 with fixed warm-up proposals to 0.338 (IoU >= 0.5; gain 0.036, 95% CI [0.022, 0.049]), while maintaining diagnostic AUC. This gain depends on the teacher checking current proposals: with equally many random boxes, a fixed dense box set, teacher-generated boxes, or report rules instead of the teacher, F1 stays near the fixed-proposal level, and proposals two refreshes old recover only part of the gain. On NIH ChestX-ray14, a secondary test set, box recall also rises from 0.423 to 0.447.
