articles.title_zh: APED-CXR:可适应的特指证据分解 胸X射线平地与图像仅推论
articles.content_zh: 压缩胸X-射线(CXR)模型可以将发现的外观定位为部署,但方框说明有限,而报告认知的多模式模型在推论上是昂贵的. 我们引入APED-CXR,它从被冻结的多模式教师那里将报告知情的空间证据提炼成一个拥有11.1M参数的学生,这些参数从共享的证据地图中预测疾病和盒子,并需要在测试时仅需要图像. 在培训期间,教师使用放射图、报告和询问班评价学生当前证据地图中建议的区域,其支持分数是学生在这些区域内集合证据分数的培训目标。 在PadChest上接受训练,并在被搁置的PadChest-GR上接受评价,刷新学生关于教师评价的建议,将盒级本地化F1从0.302与固定的取暖建议提升到0.338(IoU >=;增收0.036,95% CI [0.022,0.049]),同时保持诊断AUC. 这一增益取决于教师检查当前建议:同样多的随机箱,固定密集箱,由教师生成的箱,或者报告规则而不是老师,F1停留在固定建议水平附近,两个建议刷新了旧的只恢复部分收益. 在NIH ChestX-ray14上,一个二级测试集,盒回想也从0.423上升到了0.447.

articles.title: Learning to Measure and Diagnose: A Clinical-Dictionary Radiomic Bottleneck Model for Thyroid Nodule Classification
articles.content: Thyroid ultrasound supports the assessment of nodule malignancy, but classification predictions often lack evidence linked to familiar clinical descriptions. Radiomics provides explicitly defined measurements that can support such explanations through a clinical dictionary. However, using these measurements as interpretable evidence requires reliable estimation from ultrasound images and preservation of measurement fidelity when optimizing classification performance. We propose a clinical-dictionary radiomic bottleneck model for thyroid nodule classification. Within this model, Family-Aware Radiomic Learning (FARL) estimates measurements with balanced supervision across feature families. Fidelity-Guided Bottleneck Modeling (FGBM) constructs a fixed bottleneck, followed by joint optimization of measurement estimation and classification under fidelity guidance. Decision evidence decomposition then traces feature contributions through a linear classifier and organizes them by clinical dictionary categories. Experiments on ThyroidXL and TN3K show competitive classification performance, while case studies illustrate feature contributions for benign and malignant nodules. These findings indicate interpretable classification with inspectable quantitative evidence informed by clinical knowledge. Code is available online.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习测量和诊断:甲状腺细胞分级的临床-词典
articles.content_zh: 甲状腺超声波支持结核恶性评估,但分类预测往往缺乏与熟悉的临床描述相联的证据. 放射学提供明确定义的测量,可以通过临床词典支持这种解释. 然而,使用这些测量作为可解释的证据,需要从超声波图像中作出可靠的估计,并在优化分类性能时保持测量忠心。 我们提出甲状腺结核分类的临床-词典放射瓶颈模型。 在这一模式中,家庭-知识放射学习(FARL)在对各特色家庭进行均衡监督的情况下对测量进行估算。 Fidelity-Guided Bottleneck Modeling(FGBM)构建了固定的瓶颈,然后在忠诚度指导下共同优化测量估计和分类. 决策证据分解后通过线性分解器来追踪贡献,并按临床词典类别加以组织. 关于甲状腺素XL和TN3K的实验显示有竞争力的分类性能,而案例研究则说明了对良性和恶性结核的贡献。 这些调查结果表明,可解释的分类和可检查的量化证据以临床知识为依据。 代码可在网上查阅。

articles.title: Forward-Only Learning for Shared-Kernel Wavelet Neural Networks without Backpropagation
articles.content: Backpropagation remains the dominant training paradigm, using backward gradients and local updates that can suffer from vanishing or exploding gradients in deep networks. Although the Forward-Forward algorithm avoids conventional backpropagation, it remains mainly local or layer-wise, motivating global whole-network learning using forward evaluations only. For shared-kernel wavelet neural networks, we therefore propose a CMA-ES-based global forward-only learning framework. We further introduce structure-aware parameter decomposition and channel-specific credit assignment, factorizing the search into three subspaces. On BSDS500, our method reduces test MSE from 4.1783 to 4.0130 and improves PSNR from 42.621 to 42.787~dB over Adam/BP without backward propagation. Beyond these gains, training requires only 6 training-set coverages, compared with 1500 epochs for BP. Ablations show that structural decomposition and aligned credit assignment are more important than increasing population size, demonstrating the feasibility of whole-network forward-only learning for compact reconstruction networks. These results suggest a potential route toward forward-only optimization of compact reconstruction models for resource-constrained imaging and edge or near-sensor systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 共享- Kernel 微波神经网络的先行学习, 不反向传播
articles.content_zh: 反向扩散仍然是主要的训练模式,使用后向梯度和当地更新,这些梯度在深层网络中会消失或爆炸。 虽然前向算法避免了传统的后向传播,但它仍然主要是局部的或分层的,只利用前向评价推动全球的全网络学习。 因此,对于共享内核波神经网络,我们提出了一个基于CMA-ES的全球前置学习框架。 我们进一步引入结构感知参数分解和频道专用信用分配,将搜索要素化为三个子空间. 在BSDS500上,我们的方法将测试MSE从4.1783减少到4.0130,并将PSNR从42.621改进为42.787~d. B超越了亚当/BP 没有落后的传播。 除这些成果外,培训只需要6个培训对象,而基础教育有1 500个时代。 赤字表明,结构分解和一致的信贷分配比扩大人口规模更为重要,表明整个网络只能向前学习对紧凑的重建网络的可行性。 这些结果表明,对于资源受限的成像和边缘或近传感器系统而言,有可能实现紧凑的重建模型的前向优化。

articles.title: Efficient Generative Image Compression with Quantized Latents Refinement
articles.content: Generative image compression (GIC) delivers strong perceptual quality at low bitrates. However, GIC methods with strong perceptual quality often rely on pretrained diffusion models with high latency, while recent lightweight GIC methods reduce latency but deliver lower perceptual quality. We observe that, for lightweight GIC methods at low bitrates, coarse deterministic quantization can collapse nearby encoder latents corresponding to different fine details to the same point, making these details difficult to recover. Motivated by this, we propose GR-GIC, an efficient GIC that delivers competitive reconstruction performance with fast inference. For better performance, we introduce Guided Refinement (GR), which combines latent refinement guided by entropy context with adaptive perturbations for training regularization, jointly improving reconstruction at low bitrates. For fast inference, we introduce reorganized projected residual vector quantization (P-RVQ), which equivalently reorganizes residual updates into low-dimensional lookups to expose greater parallelism and reduce sequential computation. Experiments on Kodak show that for performance, compared with OneDC, GR-GIC achieves BD-rate savings of 23.19%, 37.71%, 22.30%, and 22.14% for LPIPS, DISTS, PSNR, and FID, respectively. For fast inference, the highly optimized implementation of GR-GIC encodes and decodes in 4.60 and 5.98 ms on an NVIDIA A100. Specifically, the reorganized P-RVQ implementation achieves a $3.14\times$ average speedup over the original implementation under the same FP32 setting. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, GR-GIC achieves latency comparable to lightweight GIC methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高效的基因图像压缩与量化的Latents
articles.content_zh: 基因图像压缩(GIC)在低比特率下提供很强的感知质量. 然而,具有很强知觉质量的GIC方法往往依赖于具有高耐久性的预先训练的传播模型,而最近的轻量级GIC方法则会降低耐久性,但能提供较低的知觉质量. 我们观察到,对于低比特率的轻量级GIC方法,粗细的确定性四分法可以崩溃附近的编码器潜伏物,对应到同一点的不同细细细节,使得这些细节难以被回收. 基于这一点,我们提出GR-GIC,一个高效的GIC,以快速推论提供竞争性重建业绩. 为了提高业绩,我们引入了《指南完善》(GR),它把以演化环境为指导的潜在改进与培训正规化的适应性干扰结合起来,共同改善低比特率的重建。 为了快速推论,我们引入了重组后预测的剩余向量量化(P-RVQ),它相当于将剩余更新重组为低维取景,以暴露出更大的平行性并减少相继计算. 关于Kodak的实验表明,与OneDC相比,GR-GIC在性能方面分别实现了23.19%、37.71%、22.30%和22.14%的LPIPS、DISTS、PSNR和FID的BD率节余。 为了快速推论,在NVIDIA A100上高度优化地执行GR-GIC编码和解码. 具体地说,经过重组的P-RVQ执行在相同的FP32设定下比最初执行的平均速度达到3.14\times美元. 在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上,GR-GIC实现了与轻量级GIC方法相仿的耐久性.

articles.title: Rethinking Post-hoc Debiasing of Large Pretrained Models
articles.content: Large pretrained models such as CLIP are widely used as frozen feature extractors. However, their embeddings inherit spurious correlations from training data, introducing bias into the features. A growing body of research has sought to address this issue through post hoc debiasing, leaving the backbone untouched. We discover that despite differing mechanisms, these methods require the bias feature to be identified and expressed in text. This dependency is not innocuous. In this work, we experimentally demonstrate that this requirement incurs an unforeseen penalty in certain scenarios. For example, on the UrbanCars benchmark, having two co-occurring bias attributes, the recent methods underperform a vanilla classifier on biased frozenbackbone features, and even providing ground-truth bias identities does not close the gap. We show that the pattern that such methods seek is readily observable in the frozen geometry. Specifically, cross-class training pairs placed closest together by the frozen encoder almost always share a spurious attribute, regardless of the bias type, without requiring access to the bias labels. Based on this, we propose a novel approach to identify such pairs and learn a single linear map that transforms the features to perform post-hoc debiasing. The proposed approach achieves competitive performance across all datasets without access to bias attribute annotations or any LLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重新思考大型预训模型的后期设计
articles.content_zh: CLIP等大型预训型号被广泛用作冷冻特性提取器. 然而,它们的嵌入从培训数据中继承了虚假的关联性,给特征引入了偏见. 越来越多的研究试图通过事后调离来解决这一问题,使骨干不受影响。 我们发现,尽管有不同的机制,这些方法需要确定偏差特征,并在案文中加以表述。 这种依赖性并非无害。 在这项工作中,我们实验性地证明,这一要求在某些情况下会造成意外处罚。 例如,在 " UrbanCars " 基准上,由于具有两个共同发生的偏差属性,最近的方法在偏差的冷冻后骨特征上使香草分级器表现不佳,甚至提供地真相偏差特性也无法弥补差距。 我们显示,这些方法所寻求的模式在被冻结的几何学中是很容易看到的。 具体地说,被被冷冻编码器放得最相近的跨级训练对几乎总是有一个虚假的属性,无论偏差类型如何,而不需要访问偏差标签. 在此基础上,我们提出了一种新颖的方法来识别这种对子,并学习一个单一的线性地图来改变特征来进行hoc后分解. 拟议办法在所有数据集中实现竞争业绩,没有偏见属性说明或任何有限责任管理。

articles.title: Learning to Reason Like a Cytopathologist:Clinically Grounded Multiscale Evidential Learning for Cervical Cytology
articles.content: Cervical cytology presents a fundamentally ambiguous diagnostic landscape, where equivocal categories such as Atypical Squamous Cells of Undetermined Significance (ASC-US) occupy a morphological grey zone that is definitional. For clinical decision support, the goal extends beyond assigning a definitive label to every sample: cases must also be distinguished by whether the available evidence supports a confident decision or warrants further consideration, a distinction conventional classification models are not designed to explicitly represent. We propose a multiscale evidential framework that models cervical cytology along an ordinal disease continuum using clinically grounded soft anchors, representing progression from benign reactive changes to precancerous lesions and malignancy. Three biologically motivated spatial contexts--nuclear morphology, cytoplasmic characteristics, and neighbourhood cellular architecture--are independently encoded using a shared frozen DINOv2 backbone, preserving inter-scale disagreement that early fusion may obscure. Calibrated predictions are transformed into Dempster--Shafer belief masses and fused with reliability discounting, allowing conflicting evidence and insufficient support to remain explicitly uncommitted rather than forcing a decision. The fused belief state drives interpretable routing that separates confidently classified cases from those with irreducible evidential insufficiency, enabling clinically meaningful triage. Across two independent publicly available conventional cytology datasets, RIVA and CRIC Cervix, the framework generalises consistently, with uncertainty strongly associated with diagnostic difficulty: incorrect predictions carry 1.94x-4.13x higher uncertainty than correct ones.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习理性 像一个病理学家: 在临床上为子宫颈细胞学进行多种规模的实验学习
articles.content_zh: 子宫颈细胞学呈现出一个根本模糊不清的诊断地貌,其模棱两可的分类如非典型的分量细胞(ASC-US)占据着一个具有定义性的形态灰色区. 对于临床决策支持,目标超越了给每个样本指定一个明确的标签:病例还必须区分为现有证据是否支持一个自信的决定或是否值得进一步审议,区分常规分类模型的设计并不明确代表. 我们提出一个多尺度的证据框架,利用临床基础的软锚,将子宫颈细胞学模拟在平分疾病连续体上,代表从良性反应变化到先发性损伤和恶性。 三个具有生物动力的空间环境 -- -- 核形态、细胞质特征和相邻的细胞结构 -- -- 使用一个共享的被冻结的DINOv2主干线进行独立编码,保留了早期聚变可能模糊的大规模分歧。 校正后的预测被转化为"德姆斯特-Shafer"信仰团并被与可靠性折价结合,允许相冲突的证据和不充分的支持保持明确不承诺,而不是强迫决定. 连接的信念状态驱动可解释的路径,将有自信地分类的病例与那些有不可减少的证据不足的病例区分开来,从而得以在临床上有意义的分解. 在两个独立的可公开获取的常规细胞数据集,即RIVA和审评委Cervix中,框架的通用性一致,不确定性与诊断困难密切相关:不正确的预测比正确预测的不确定性高1.94x-4.13x。

articles.title: Spatially Gated Demographic Steering for Debiasing Multi-Person Text-to-Image Generation
articles.content: Text-to-Image models reproduce societal stereotypes, and existing mitigation applies one demographic correction to the whole scene. In multi-person scene generation this creates a trade-off: global steering improves aggregate balance only by homogenizing the people within an image. Steering-based methods like Embedding Arithmetic drive the intra-image diversity below the unsteered baseline. Text- and latent-projection approaches shift the aggregate skew with only marginal gains in intra-image diversity. We present Spatially Gated Steering (SGS), which steers the demographics of each person independently by extracting per-person masks from the Diffusion Transformer's (DiT) internal attention maps at a critical denoising timestep and applying a distinct demographic vector within each mask for the remaining steps. SGS needs no fine-tuning, inversion or layout specifications, and uses a lightweight segmentor over frozen DiT attention features to localize subjects at early timesteps. On skewed occupational prompts, SGS reaches high intra-image racial and gender diversity while keeping aggregate balance competitive and image quality near baseline, a result we validate on two architecturally distinct diffusion transformers, FLUX.1-Dev and SD3.5-Large. Codebase and model weights are available at https://github.com/cvims/spatially-gated-steering
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用于Debiasing多个人文字到图像生成的空间Ged人口指导
articles.content_zh: 文字到图像模型复制了社会定型观念,而现有的缓解措施将一种人口矫正应用于整个场景。 在多人场景的生成中,这创造了一种取舍:全球取向只通过将画面内的人同化来改善总量平衡. 以"嵌入"算术"等以指导为主的方法,将图像内部多样性推向了未被测出基线以下. 文字和潜在预测方法转移了总汇,在图像内多样性方面只有微小收益。 我们提出空间定位指导(SGS),它通过在关键的解点时间步骤中从传播变形器内部注意力图中提取每人口罩,并在每个口罩中为其余步骤应用一个独特的人口载体,独立地指导每个人的人口结构。 SGS不需要微调,倒置或布局规格,并使用轻量级分管比起被冷冻的DiT注意力特性来在早期将被子本地化. 在扭曲的职业提示下,SGS达到了高度的图像内种族和性别多样性,同时保持了总体平衡的竞争力和图像质量接近基线,我们验证了两个结构上独特的扩散变压器,即FLUX.1-Dev和SD3.5-Large。 代码基础和模型权重可在https://github.com/cvims/spatially-gated-steering上查阅。

articles.title: MS2CAST: A Video Anomaly Detection Framework via Multi-Scale Spatial Cross-Attention and Efficient Spatiotemporal Networks
articles.content: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is a challenging task for surveillance systems due to the scarcity and diversity of anomalous events. While semi-supervised VAD approaches have advanced the field, many rely on computationally intensive optical flow networks to capture motion dynamics. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are also widely used for spatial encoding, but their effective receptive field is highly local. To address these limitations, we introduce MS2CAST, an end-to-end semi-supervised predictive VAD framework. For spatial encoding, we employ a multi-scale cross-attention encoder that fuses the hierarchical feature representations from a vision transformer (MViTv2-S) and a CNN (ConvNeXt-T) to exploit their distinct receptive fields. To model spatiotemporal dynamics without optical flow estimation, we integrate two interchangeable spatiotemporal modules in the latent space. One module (SwinLSTM) incorporates a Swin Transformer, while the other (VMRNN) integrates Vision Mamba blocks. Our objective function combines L1 loss, Gradient Difference Loss (GDL), and Multi-Scale Structural Similarity Index Measure (MS-SSIM) to ensure pixel-wise accuracy, sharpness, and structural integrity. Evaluations across the UCSD Ped2, CUHK Avenue, and ShanghaiTech datasets demonstrate frame-level Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) Area Under the Curve (AUC) scores that are competitive with top-tier techniques while maintaining a peak GPU memory usage of under 1 GB.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MS2CAST:通过多尺度空间跨功能和高效spatiotemporal网络的视频异常检测框架
articles.content_zh: 视频异常检测(VAD)由于异常事件的稀缺性和多样性,对于监控系统来说是一项具有挑战性的任务. 虽然半监督的VAD方法已经推进了这个领域,但许多人依靠计算密集的光学流网络来捕捉运动动力学. 革命神经网络(CNNs)也被广泛用于空间编码,但其有效的可接受领域是高度局部的. 为解决这些局限性,我们引入了MS2 CAST,一个端到端半监督的VAD预测框架. 在空间编码方面,我们使用一个多尺度的交叉意向编码器,将视觉变压器(MViTv2-S)和有线电视新闻网(ConvNeXt-T)的分级特征表示相接,以利用其独特的可接受领域。 为了在不进行光学流估计的情况下模拟spatiotopal动态,我们把两个可互换的spatiotopal模块整合在了潜在的空间. 一个模块(SwinLSTM)包含一个Swin变形器,而另一个模块(VMRNN)包含Vision Mamba块. 我们的客观功能结合了L1损失,渐变相差损失(GDL)和多比例结构相近指数度量(MS-SSIM),以确保像素精度,锐度和结构完整性. 跨UCSD Ped2, CUHK Avenue, 和上海科技数据集的评价显示帧级接收器操作特征(ROC)区域 在Curve(AUC)下,与顶级技术竞争的分数同时保持了1GB以下的顶峰GPU内存使用.

articles.title: Reading the Room: Scale-ambiguous Semantic Registration of Sparse VSLAM Maps to Floor Plans in Partially Built Environments
articles.content: Many robotic construction applications, such as progress tracking, require registering a sensor trajectory to a prior 2D floor plan. Visual capture is attractive for its low cost and availability, but aligning a visual simultaneous localization and mapping (VSLAM) map to a floor plan is difficult; VSLAM recovers geometry only up to an unknown similarity transform, the sparse point cloud is cross-modal to the symbolic floor plan, sites are only partially built during capture, and construction sites are visually repetitive, degrading map quality while removing distinctive features. Existing methods address at most two of these challenges. We thus introduce Reading the Room(RR), a global-local approach to register scale-ambiguous, sparse, semantic VSLAM maps to partially built floor plans. Our key idea is to define a single robust, differentiable, class-balanced semantic-geometric energy function that governs all stages of the pipeline. We develop two global initialization schemes, leveraging a single inaccurate user-provided correspondence if provided, or estimating the initialization globally using a cross-modal matching network. Both schemes are designed to find initial candidates with respect to the energy function, which is then directly optimized for local refinement. We evaluate RR on 33 sequences across three active construction sites against classical and learning-based baselines, achieving a 4.5x improvement in mean absolute trajectory error over the strongest baseline in the general unconstrained setting, which increases to 7.6x when an anchor is provided.

articles.title_zh: 阅览会议室:部分建成环境的 Sparse VSLAM 地表图到地上计划的缩放式语义登记
articles.content_zh: 许多机器人构造应用,如进度跟踪,都需要将传感器轨迹登记到之前的2D平面计划. 视觉捕捉因其成本和可用性都比较低而吸引人,但很难将视觉同步本地化和绘图(VSLAM)地图与平面图相配合;VSLAM只恢复到未知的相近变相,稀有的点云与象征平面图是交叉模式,在捕捉时场地仅部分被建造,建筑站点是视觉重复的,在去除显著特征的同时降低地图质量. 现有方法最多解决了其中两项挑战。 因此,我们介绍阅读室(RR),这是一个全球-地方方法,用于登记比例模糊、稀少、语义模糊的VSLAM地图,以便部分地层图。 我们的关键思想是界定一个单一的强健,不同,阶级平衡的语义-几何能函数,它支配着管道的各个阶段. 我们制定两个全球初始化计划,利用用户提供的单一不准确的通信,或利用跨模式匹配网络估计全球初始化。 这两项计划都旨在寻找能源功能方面的初始候选者,然后直接优化能源功能,以便在当地加以完善。 我们对照古典和以学习为基础的基线,对三个活动建筑地点的33个序列进行RRR评价,使平均绝对轨迹误差比一般无限制情况下最强基线有所改善,在提供锚时增加到7.6x。

articles.title: Joint Semantic-Channel Coding and Modulation for Generative Image Transmission
articles.content: Digital image transmission typically optimizes source coding, channel coding, and modulation separately, limiting how source representations adapt to channel impairments. We propose SemQAM, a joint semantic-channel coding and modulation scheme for generative image transmission converting source to modulated symbols, such as standard QAM symbols. Channel impairments create two challenges: they can corrupt the latent representation at the receiver, and this corruption can compound through autoregressive coding, degrading reconstruction quality. First, SemQAM represents latent features with vector quantization (VQ), maps each VQ index to a QAM symbol, and updates the codeword corresponding to the detected symbol so that channel impairments directly affect codebook learning. Moreover, SemQAM uses the conditional expectation of received codewords to approximate the receiver reconstruction and reduce error propagation during autoregressive coding. SemQAM supports multiple SNRs and CBRs in a unified model, while also supporting conventional source coding through SemQAM-C. Experiments show that (i) under the same LDPC and QAM settings, SemQAM-C outperforms OneDC in LPIPS and DISTS with substantially lower complexity, showing that the unified model retains competitive capability for source coding. (ii) Compared with this separated counterpart, SemQAM reduces channel uses by 18.57% at matched LPIPS and outperforms the compared JSCC methods, demonstrating the benefit of joint coding.

articles.title_zh: 基因图像传输的语义-通道编码和模块化
articles.content_zh: 数字图像传输一般会优化出源编码,通道编码,并分别调制,限制出源表示如何适应通道减值. 我们提出"SemQAM",是一种用于基因图像传输的联合语义-通道编码和调制方案,将源转换为调制符号,如标准QAM符号. 通道障碍带来了两个挑战:它们会腐蚀接收者的潜在代表,这种腐败会通过自旋编码而加剧,使重建质量下降。 首先,SemQAM以向量量化(VQ)代表了潜在的特征,将每个VQ指数映射到QAM符号上,并更新了与被检测到的符号对应的代码词,使通道减值会直接影响代码簿的学习. 此外,SemQAM使用对收到的密码词的有条件期望来取近似接收器重建,并减少自递编码过程中出错的传播. SemQAM在一个统一的模型中支持多个SNR和CBR,同时也通过SemQAM-C支持常规源编码. 实验显示(一)在同一LDPC和QAM设置下,SemQAM-C在LPIPS和DISTS中比OneDC要复杂得多,表明统一模型保留了源编码的竞争能力. (二) 与这个分离的对应方相比,SemQAM在匹配的LPIPS时将信道使用量减少了18.57%,并且超过了比较的JSC方法,显示了联合编码的好处.

articles.title: OpenEarth-OVS44: A Multimodal Remote Sensing Dataset for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
articles.content: In remote sensing, open-vocabulary segmentation is particularly important for flexible and scalable land-cover understanding across diverse regions, as it improves generalization to novel categories without requiring exhaustive pixel-level annotations. Despite its great promise, progress in this area remains largely constrained by existing datasets with limited category coverage and overly coarse taxonomies, and therefore struggles to support fine-grained semantic understanding required in real-world applications such as urban functional zoning, carbon accounting, and post-disaster assessment. To address these challenges, we present OpenEarth-OVS44, a multimodal benchmark with 290,587 expert-verified segments from 2,832 RGB images and 1,341 strictly registered RGB-SAR pairs at sub-meter spatial resolution, covering 40 cities across France, Japan, and the United States under a unified 44-class taxonomy organized into 9 base categories. Three evaluation tracks are provided: an RGB-only fine-grained benchmark, a multimodal track with diverse synthetic cloudy conditions for weather-robust evaluation, and a held-out cross-region track. Extensive experiments on representative open-vocabulary segmentation models demonstrate that training on OpenEarth-OVS44 substantially improves fine-grained segmentation performance over the strongest training-free baseline, with improvements of up to 7.1 mIoU points on unseen categories and 27.6 mIoU points on seen categories. The dataset and code will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OpenEarth-OVS44:用于开放式词汇分区的多式遥感数据集
articles.content_zh: 在遥感方面,开放-省分对于不同区域灵活和可扩展的土地覆盖理解尤为重要,因为它改进了对新类的概括,而不需要详尽的像素级说明。 尽管有巨大的希望,但这一领域的进展在很大程度上仍然受到现有数据集的限制,这些数据集的类别覆盖面有限,而且分类过于粗糙,因此难以支持在城市功能分区、碳核算和灾后评估等现实世界应用中所需的精细语义理解。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出了OpenEarth-OVS44这一多式联运基准,该基准由2,832个RGB图像的290,587个专家验证段和1,341个严格登记的RGB-SAR对子空间分辨率,覆盖了法国、日本和美国的40个城市,按照统一的44个分类分类分为9个基本类别。 提供了三条评价道:仅限RGB精细分量的基准;具有多种合成云态天气扰动评价条件的多模式道;以及被搁置的跨区域道道. 对代表性的露天 -- -- OVS44分区模型的广泛实验表明,关于露地 -- -- OVS44的培训大大改进了无培训最强基线的精细分解性能,在未见类别上改进了最多7.1毫升分,在已见类别上改进了27.6毫升分。 数据集和代码将被发布.

articles.title: FogTTA: Online Test-Time Adaptation for Robust Transformer-based Object Detection in Foggy Weather
articles.content: Object detection models for autonomous driving commonly experience substantial performance drops when deployed under adverse weather due to the domain shift between training data and real-world operating conditions. This degradation is especially evident when models trained on clear-weather images encounter foggy environments with reduced visibility and contrast. To address this challenge, we introduce FogTTA, an online test-time adaptation framework designed to improve the robustness of Transformer-based object detectors in fog. Using RF-DETR as the underlying object detector, FogTTA enables real-time adaptation to the streaming target domain without requiring source data or retraining. The framework follows a teacher-student design, where the deployed model serves as the teacher and generates pseudo labels from weakly augmented target inputs. These predictions are subsequently refined through non-maximum suppression and confidence filtering. The student model then learns from strongly augmented target sample using the Varifocal loss to mitigate pseudo-label noise. The teacher is updated via exponential moving averaging to ensure stable and continuous adaptation. Experiments show that FogTTA outperforms prior baselines, delivering improved detection accuracy and stability while maintaining real-time performance.

articles.title_zh: FogTTA:基于强变形器在Foggy Weather 中的对象检测的在线测试-时间适应
articles.content_zh: 由于培训数据与现实世界操作条件之间的域位转移,在恶劣天气下部署时,自主驾驶的物体检测模型通常会发生显著性能下降. 当经过清风图像培训的模型遇到可见度和对比度降低的雾化环境时,这种退化尤其明显。 为了应对这一挑战,我们引入了"雾"(FogTTA),这是一个在线测试时间适应框架,旨在提高以变形器为基础的物体探测器在雾中的强性. FogTTA使用RF-DETR作为基础对象探测器,可以实时适应流出目标域而无需源数据或再培训. 该框架遵循师生设计,其中部署的模型充当教师,并从弱增强的目标投入中产生伪标签. 这些预测随后通过非最大压制和信心过滤得到完善. 学生模型然后用Varifocal损失来从强烈增强的目标样本中学习来减轻伪标签噪声. 教师通过指数移动平均得到更新,以确保稳定和持续适应。 实验显示,雾TTA的性能超过了先前的基线,在保持实时性能的同时,提供了更好的检测精度和稳定性.

articles.title: TernScope: Model-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient Ternary Endoscopic Segmentation
articles.content: Edge medical segmentation must reconcile small model size, high accuracy, and fast inference. TernScope addresses this tradeoff through model--hardware co-design, learning a compact segmentation network whose low-bit operators also simplify hardware execution. Split-channel large-kernel blocks preserve spatial context with limited computation, while branch fusion removes redundant inference paths. Ternary Progressive Quantization-aware Training (TPQ) then adapts the fused network from deep to shallow layers, through the decoder, and finally to the input and prediction layers. All 25 convolutions use ternary weights and 8-bit activations, enabling packed storage and multiplier-free computation. The resulting model uses 0.2483 M parameters and 0.0949 GMACs while retaining competitive segmentation accuracy on in-domain and external datasets. Under the same 45 nm technology, TernScope reduces compute-array area by 88.46% compared with the original Gemmini, a systolic-array accelerator with 8-bit $\times$ 8-bit multipliers. These results demonstrate a path from accurate lightweight medical segmentation to compact low-bit hardware.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TernScope:高效三相内分光的模型-硬件联合设计
articles.content_zh: 边缘医学分解必须调和小模型大小,高精度,快速推论. TernScope通过模型-硬件共设计解决了这种取舍,学习了紧凑的分块网络,其低位运算器也简化了硬件执行. 分化-通道大内核块以有限的计算方式保留了空间上下文,而分支聚变则去除冗余的推论路径. 然后通过解码器将引信网络从深层到浅层进行再调整,最后调整为输入和预测层。 所有25个演化体都使用三相重和8位活化,使被打包的存储和无倍数计算成为可能. 由此产生的模型使用了0.2483 M参数和0.0949 GMAC,同时保留了内域和外域数据集的竞争分化精度. 在同为45nm的技术下,TernScope将计算阵列面积与最初的Gemmini相比减少了88.46%,而Gemmini是一个具有8-times $\times 8-times乘数的同位素-阵列加速器. 这些结果显示了从精确的轻量级医疗分解到紧凑的低位硬件的路径.

articles.title: An interpretable deep learning method for early hepatocellular carcinoma diagnosis on multiphase CT
articles.content: Early diagnosis of hepatocellular carcinoma is critical to preserve access to curative treatment options. The Liver Imaging Reporting and Data System (LI-RADS) provides a standardized framework for non-invasive diagnosis on multiphase computed tomography, based on major visual imaging features. However, these features may be difficult to assess consistently, particularly in small liver lesions. We developed dLI-RADS, an interpretable artificial intelligence method designed to estimate the probability of hepatocellular carcinoma from multiphase computed tomography images of manually segmented liver lesions, while remaining aligned with LI-RADS-related imaging concepts. dLI-RADS combines neural network-derived predictions with handcrafted quantitative imaging measurements reflecting LI-RADS major features and integrates these inputs using logistic regression. In this multicenter retrospective study, patients with multiphase computed tomography and at least one liver lesion were included, while lesions larger than 40 mm were excluded. Histology served as the reference standard for hepatocellular carcinoma, and a composite reference standard was used for non-hepatocellular carcinoma lesions. The lesion-level accuracy of dLI-RADS and LI-RADS were compared on the internal evaluation set using 10,000-repetition bootstrap non-inferiority tests, with 5% margins and significance levels. On the external test set, sensitivities were similarly compared. dLI-RADS was non-inferior to LI-RADS for lesion-level accuracy in the internal evaluation set, achieving 80% accuracy compared with 74% for LI-RADS (p = 0.04)...

articles.title_zh: 多相CT早期肝细胞癌诊断的可解释的深层学习方法
articles.content_zh: 早期诊断肝细胞癌对保持治疗选择至关重要。 活体成像报告和数据系统(LI-RADS)根据主要的视觉成像特征,为多相计算成像法的非侵入性诊断提供了一个标准化的框架。 然而,这些特征可能难以一致评估,特别是在小肝损伤中。 我们开发了dLI-RADS,一种可解释的人工智能方法,旨在从人工分解肝脏损伤的多相计算成像图中估计肝细胞癌的概率,同时与LI-RADS相关的成像概念保持一致。 dLI-RADS将神经网络推导的预测与反映LI-RADS主要特征的手工定量成像测量结合起来,并使用物流回归来整合这些输入. 在这项多中心追溯研究中,包括了多相计算成像和至少一次肝脏损伤的病人,但不包括40毫米以上的损伤。 历史学是肝细胞癌的参考标准,对非肝细胞癌损伤采用了综合参考标准. 在内部评价中比较了dLI-RADS和LI-RADS的损伤水平精确度,采用了10 000个重犯靴子的非发烧试验,其幅度和意义水平为5%。 在外部测试中,对敏感性进行了类似的比较。 dLI-RADS在内部评价集中对于LI-RADS的损伤级准确性没有受到侵蚀,实现了80%的准确度,而LI-RADS的准确度为74%(p=0.04). .

articles.title: Diff-IrisPAD: Modeling Bona Fide Iris Distributions for Unsupervised Presentation Attack Detection
articles.content: Iris recognition systems are vulnerable to presentation attacks (PAs), including textured contact lenses, print replays, and synthetic irises. Existing PAD methods rely on supervised learning with attack data, limiting generalization to unseen attacks and new sensors. We propose Diff-IrisPAD, an unsupervised framework based on Brownian Bridge Diffusion that models bona fide iris distributions without using attack samples. The method reconstructs clean iris textures from degraded inputs and detects attacks via reconstruction inconsistency using ViT scoring and pixel-level measures. Experiments on a large-scale multi-sensor dataset (125K+ images, NIR and VIS, 8 attack types) show that Diff-IrisPAD achieves an overall ACER of 30.52, significantly outperforming diffusion-based baselines while demonstrating strong generalization to unseen attacks. These results highlight the effectiveness of diffusion-based bona fide modeling for robust and scalable iris PAD.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Diff-IrisPAD:为无监督的演示发布模拟 Bona Fide Iris
articles.content_zh: 虹膜识别系统容易受到演示攻击(PAs)的伤害,包括纹理隐形眼镜,平面回放和合成虹膜. 现有的PAD方法依赖于有监督的学习,使用攻击数据,将通俗化限制在不可见的攻击和新的传感器上. 我们提出Diff-IrisPAD,这是一个基于布朗斯桥分流的无人监督的框架,在不使用攻击样本的情况下模拟善意的虹膜分布. 该方法从已退化的输入中重建出干净的虹膜纹理,并使用ViT分数和像素级测量方法通过重建不一致来检测攻击. 对大规模多传感器数据集(125K+图像,NNIS和VIS,8个攻击类型)的实验显示,Diff-IrisPAD总体实现30.52的ACER,显著地超越了基于扩散的基线,同时表现出了强烈的通俗化到不可见的攻击. 这些成果突出表明了以传播为基础的善意模型对于强健而可扩展的虹膜PAD的有效性。

articles.title: No Frames, Just Frequencies: Bandwidth-Efficient Deployment-Time Adaptation for Smart Glasses
articles.content: Deep neural networks deployed on smart glasses must adapt to changes in the distribution of incoming data while adhering to strict privacy and device constraints. We present No Frames, Just Frequencies, a bandwidth-efficient source-assisted adaptation framework that characterizes distribution shifts using compact frequency descriptors computed on-device. Rather than transmitting camera frames, the glasses compute and send frequency descriptors to a host device that contains a replica of the model. The host device maps the received frequency descriptor to a distribution shift operator that synthesizes out-of-distribution data and adapts a model replica using a pre-defined adaptation protocol. We evaluate the framework on mixtures of ImageNet-C corruptions using convolution-based (ConvNeXtV2-Femto), self-attention-based (DeiT-Tiny), and hybrid (TinyViT-5M) vision models, on person classification (Visual Wake Words), and on object detection (MS-COCO). Our results reveal that adaptation driven solely by the transmitted descriptors recovers $93-95\%$ of the supervised oracle adaptation gain on all three architectures, $82\%$ on Visual Wake Words and $94$--$98\%$ on MS-COCO. Notably, adaptation quality degrades gracefully as the descriptor resolution decreases from $224 $ to $28$ pixels, consistently across architectures, enabling bandwidth reductions from $213\times$ to $784\times$ across the frequency descriptors.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 无框架, 仅是花序: 带宽- 有效部署- 智能眼镜的时空适应
articles.content_zh: 部署在智能眼镜上的深神经网络必须适应来信数据分布的变化,同时遵守严格的隐私和装置限制. 我们提出 " 无框架 " , " Just Frequenies " ,这是一个带宽效率高的源辅助适应框架,其特征是使用紧凑的频率描述符在设备上计算,进行分配。 眼镜与其传输相机相框,不如计算并发送频率描述符给包含模型复制品的宿主设备. 主机设备将接收到的频率描述符映射到一个分布式移位操作员,该移位操作员会利用预先定义的适应协议来合成出放数据并调整出一个模型复制. 我们评价关于ImageNet-C腐败的混合物的框架,使用以革命为基础的(ConvNetV2-Femto)、以自觉为基础的(DeiT-Tiny)和混合的(TinyViT-5M)视觉模型,以及人分类(Visual Wake Words)和物体检测(MS-CO)。 我们的结果表明,完全由传送的描述器驱动的适应措施,从所有三种建筑的受监督的甲骨文适应收益中回收了93-95美元,从视觉醒目词条中回收了82美元,从MS-CO中回收了94美元-98美元。 值得注意的是,适应质量被轻而易举地降低,因为描述器分辨率从224美元降至28美元等效物,整个结构一致,使得频率描述器的带宽从213美元降至784美元。

articles.title: CineEvolve: An Agentic Self-Evolution Framework for Cinematic Multi-Shot Video Generation
articles.content: Cinematic multi-shot video generation requires both narrative planning and iterative refinement. Existing methods either lack narrative reasoning or rely on feed-forward workflows without policy updates. In this paper, we propose CineEvolve, an agentic self-evolution framework for cinematic multi-shot video generation that unifies a Director and a Critic within a single vision-language policy. Emulating real-world filmmaking that couples iterative direction with critical feedback, we train CineEvolve via alternating reinforcement learning, where the Director surfaces flaws to sharpen the Critic, and the updated Critic guides the Director's targeted revisions. To stabilize co-evolution, we introduce Evolutionary GRPO (E-GRPO), leveraging historical anchoring and revision safeguarding to mitigate advantage inflation. Additionally, we contribute CineTraj, a 40K cinematic trajectory dataset spanning creation, critique, and revision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CineEvolve outperforms existing approaches. Our code will be available at https://github.com/JingZhe-8/CineEvolve.

articles.title_zh: CineEvolve:电影多热视频生成的代理自演框架
articles.content_zh: 电影多镜头录像制作既需要叙事规划,也需要迭代完善. 现有方法要么缺乏叙事推理,要么依赖没有政策更新的向导工作流程。 在本文中,我们提出CineEvorve,这是电影多镜头录像制作的代理性自我演进框架,它统一了导演和在单一视觉语言政策范围内的批评. 模拟现实世界的电影制作 以批判性的反馈 互相反复引导 我们通过交替的强化学习来训练CineEvolve 在那里,导演 表面的缺陷使批评更加尖锐, 更新的批评 指导导演的目标修改。 为了稳定共同演变,我们引入了E-GRPO(E-GRPO),利用历史锚地和修订保障来缓解优势通胀. 此外,我们贡献了CineTraj,一个40K电影轨迹数据集,涵盖创作、批评和修订。 广泛的实验表明,CineEvolve的绩效超过了现有方法。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/JingZhe-8/CineEvolve上查阅。

articles.title: Unlocking Spatial Grounding in Flow-Matching Models via SNR Tuning
articles.content: Despite the success of foundation models in image synthesis, achieving fine-grained spatial control remains a significant challenge, typically requiring auxiliary structural adapters or complex inference-time steering. While modern vision-language (VLM) text encoders possess the latent capacity to represent spatial coordinates, generative models often fail to leverage this information. We demonstrate that the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) distribution is a critical determinant of spatial grounding in flow-matching models. Using a novel synthetic benchmark of geometric primitives, we isolate structural mechanics from textural complexity inherent in natural imagery and introduce a rigorous color-aware layout metric to quantify spatial fidelity. We show that training on a centered SNR distribution results in poor layout adherence (25.9%). Instead, we identify high-noise regimes as a "critical learning phase" for spatial grounding. Shifting the training focus toward these stages increases layout adherence to 80.8%, effectively reaching the 83.6% reconstruction ceiling of the underlying variational autoencoder. We find that the necessity for this shift scales with resolution and aspect ratio variance, and that the conservative noise schedules employed by models like FLUX.1 are insufficient for precise layout adherence. Finally, we show that these findings translate to real-world imagery via the COCO dataset (1.0 vs. 57.3 Average Precision), where state-of-the-art layout adherence is unlocked through distribution tuning alone, without architectural modifications.

articles.title_zh: 通过 SNR Tuning 解锁流程匹配模型中的空间地平面
articles.content_zh: 尽管基础模型在图像合成上取得了成功,但实现精细的空间控制仍然是一个重大挑战,通常需要辅助结构适配器或复杂的推论时间引导. 虽然现代视觉语言(VLM)文本编码器具有代表空间坐标的潜在能力,但基因模型往往未能利用这些信息。 我们证明,信号与噪声比例(SNR)分布是流相匹配模型中空间定位的关键决定因素. 使用一款由几何原始物构成的新合成基准,将结构力学与自然影像所固有的纹理复杂性相分离,并引入了严格的色感布局度量法来量化空间忠心. 我们显示,关于中央SNR分配的培训导致布局守旧率低(25.9%)。 相反,我们将高噪声制度确定为空间地平面的"关键学习阶段". 将培训重点转向这些阶段,使布局坚持率提高到80.8%,实际上达到了基本变异自编码器的83.6%重建上限。 我们认为,这种具有分辨率和相比相差的转向尺度的必要性,以及FLUX.1等模型采用的保守噪声表不足以精确地坚持布局。 最后,我们通过COCO数据集(1.0对57.3平均精度)表明这些发现转化为了现实世界的图像,其中最先进的布局守口如瓶,仅通过分布调谐即可解锁,而不进行建筑改造.

articles.title: Rethinking Underwater Image Enhancement: Learning through Text-Guided Degradation Curriculum
articles.content: Existing paired clean-degraded datasets have advanced learning-based underwater image enhancement, but they remain either limited in scale or difficult to acquire, and still fail to adequately cover the diverse degradations encountered in real-world underwater environments. Such scarce and insufficient data ultimately restrict the generalization of underwater image enhancement models, highlighting the need for realistic and controllable degradation modeling to better capture real underwater conditions and improve enhancement robustness. To this end, we propose a unified degradation-aware training framework for the underwater image enhancement task. A Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation Pipeline uses a text-guided diffusion model to synthesize diverse and semantically consistent degraded samples, providing paired data to support the subsequent curriculum learning strategy. The proposed Progressive Degradation Curriculum organizes training across multiple attributes and difficulty levels to promote balanced learning, and a Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion Model leverages this progressive process to better address the wide range of degradation severity and restoration ambiguity in underwater images. Extensive experiments on multiple underwater benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed method achieves superior performance. Our code and models will be released upon the publication of this work.

articles.title_zh: 反思水下图像增强:通过文字指导的退化课程学习
articles.content_zh: 现有对等的清洁分级数据集具有先进的以学习为基础的水下图像增强功能,但它们在规模上仍然有限或难以获得,仍然未能充分涵盖现实世界水下环境中所遭遇的各种分级. 这种稀缺和不足的数据最终限制了水下图像增强模型的通俗化,突出表明需要现实和可控制的降解模型来更好地捕捉水下的真实条件并增强增强强度. 为此,我们提议为水下图像增强任务建立一个统一的降解意识训练框架。 一个有文字条件的降解增强管道使用文字指导的传播模型来合成多样的和精密相容的退化样本,提供配对数据支持后续的课程学习战略. 拟议的 " 渐进退化课程 " 组织多种属性和困难层次的培训,以促进均衡的学习, " 传输指导 " 的 " 一步传播模式 " 利用这一渐进进程,更好地解决水下图像中广泛的退化严重性和恢复模糊问题。 对多个水下基准的广泛实验表明,我们提议的方法取得了优异的性能. 我们的代码和模型将在这部作品出版后发布.

articles.title: Generalized CycleGRPO for Fine-Grained Multimodal Understanding and Grounding
articles.content: Fine-grained multimodal intelligence requires models to both understand a designated region and localize it from language. Existing methods learn these directions with separate objectives and task-specific annotations. We present Generalized CycleGRPO, the first unified reinforcement learning framework coupling region understanding and localization across spatial, temporal, and spatio-temporal domains. Given a region, a multimodal large language model generates candidate descriptions and then localizes each description to reconstruct the input region. Reconstruction overlap provides a verifiable reward for captioning, while individual localization rewards improve the inverse mapping. A common region-space formulation extends this cycle from image masks and boxes to video intervals and timestamped spatial evidence, without reference captions or an external language-model judge during reinforcement learning. In videos, the cycle encourages descriptions that distinguish a target event from similar recurrences. We introduce DOVE (Distinctive Occurrence-level Video-caption Evaluation), a human-verified contrastive benchmark for this temporal distinctiveness. CycleGRPO improves SAMTok's overall gIoU from 57.5% to 68.2% on GroundingSuite and average gIoU from 71.2% to 78.7% on GRES. For temporal tasks, it achieves 51.9% tIoU on Charades and 33.3% Temporal Evidence Coverage on DOVE, compared with 45.6% and 14.8% for the Qwen3-VL initialization. These results establish region-text cycle consistency as a general self-evaluation principle for multimodal understanding and localization. Models, code, and DOVE are available at https://devinxzhang.github.io/Generalized-CycleGRPO-Page/.

articles.title_zh: 精细多式理解和定位通用循环GRPO
articles.content_zh: 精细的多模式智能要求模型既能理解指定区域,又能从语言上本地化. 现有方法学习这些方向,并有分别的目标和具体任务的说明. 我们提出通用循环GRPO,这是第一个统一的强化学习框架,将空间、时间和时空领域的区域理解和本地化结合起来。 鉴于一个区域,一个多模式的大型语言模型生成候选描述,然后将每个描述本地化来重建输入区域. 重建重叠为字幕提供了可核查的奖励,而个人本地化奖励则改善了反向绘图. 共同的区域-空间配制将这一周期从图像口罩和盒子扩大到视频间隔和时间戳的空间证据,在强化学习期间没有参考说明或外部语言模型法官。 在视频中,循环鼓励描述区分出一个目标事件和类似的重现. 我们引入了DOVE(Distinotive Occurence-level Video-caption Experiment),这是这一时间性差异的经人验证的对比基准. CycleGROPO改进了SAMTok在地基套件和平均地基活化铀上的总体GIOU从57.5%提高到68.2%,在GRES上从71.2%提高到78.7%. 在时间性任务方面,Charades实现了51.9%的tIoU,DOVE实现了33.3%的时态证据覆盖,而Qune3-VL初始化率为45.6%和14.8%. 这些结果确立了区域文本周期的一致性,作为了解多式联运和本地化的一般自我评价原则。 模式、代码和DOVE可在https://devinxzhang.github.io/Generation-CycleGPRO-Page/上查阅。

articles.title: Hyperspherical Simplex Representations for Backward-Compatible Retrieval
articles.content: Training modern AI models has become increasingly expensive, and updating deployed models can alter their internal feature representations, affecting applications built upon them. In retrieval systems, such updates often require complete gallery re-indexing, a computationally expensive process at scale. Existing backward-compatibility methods enable direct comparison of representations from updated and earlier models, avoiding re-indexing. However, they typically require compatibility-specific training, learned mapping functions, or architectural modifications, and often depend explicitly on the previous model. We propose hyperspherical simplex representations derived from softmax outputs and logits for backward-compatible retrieval across independently trained models. They leverage the simplex structure induced by softmax cross-entropy training with one-hot labels as a common geometric reference across model updates. Since this reference depends on the number of classes, adding new ones expands the simplex, misaligning existing class prototypes with their earlier counterparts. We therefore derive a deterministic linear transformation to restore their alignment. Our theoretical analysis of the formal backward-compatibility definition identifies two geometric conditions under which its inequalities hold in expectation, assuming von Mises--Fisher class distributions with increasing concentration across updates. Aligned regular-simplex representations satisfy these conditions, providing a theoretical basis for the proposed representations under the stated assumptions. Without using additional compatibility-specific losses, learned mappings, or architectural modifications, the proposed representations achieve competitive results on standard compatibility benchmarks, including expanded class sets, more expressive architectures, and independently trained models from public repositories.

articles.title_zh: 用于后向兼容检索的超球面简单显示
articles.content_zh: 现代人工智能模型的培训越来越昂贵,更新所部署的模型可以改变其内部特征表述,影响其基础上的应用. 在检索系统中,这种更新往往需要完整的画廊再索引,这是一个规模上计算昂贵的过程. 现有的后向兼容方法能够直接比较更新模型和早期模型的表示,避免重新索引. 然而,它们通常需要针对兼容性的培训,学习的绘图功能,或建筑改造,并往往明确依赖于以前的模型. 我们提出超球形的简单x表达式, 由软max输出和对数产生, 用于在独立训练的模型中进行后相兼容的检索。 它们利用由软马克斯交叉通体训练所诱导的简单x结构,并用一热标签作为整个模型更新的共同几何参考. 由于这个引用依赖于类数,增加新的类会扩展出简单的x,使现有的类原型与早期的同级相错. 因此,我们得出一种决定性的线性转变,以恢复它们的一致。 我们对正式的后向相容性定义的理论分析确定了两种几何条件,假定冯·米塞斯-费舍阶级分布在各种更新中日益集中,那么,不平等就预示着这两个条件。 一致的正则-简单表述满足了这些条件,为根据所述假设提出的表述提供了理论基础。 在不使用额外的相容性特定损失,所学的绘图,或建筑修饰的情况下,所拟议的表述在标准相容性基准上取得了竞争的结果,包括扩展的类集,更表现式的建筑,以及从公共寄存器中独立培训出的模式.

articles.title: Melange: A Synthetic Visual Bias Benchmark for Multi-modal Large Language Models
articles.content: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have seen broad adoption, but their biases are still far less examined than those of standard LLMs, creating possible social harms when deployed in real-world settings. Prior efforts to extend bias analyses from LLMs into the multi-modal space either cover only a few bias categories or do not ensure that the groups being compared are clearly addressed by visual cues in the images. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Melange, a wide-ranging synthetic visual benchmark covering seven categories for assessing social biases in MLLMs. It is grounded in the widely used language-only BBQ dataset (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) from BigBench, carefully extending its constructed contexts via controlled generation of visual scenarios so the target attributes appear visually and clearly. To maximize reliability, our generated images pass through two stages of validation: automated screening using visual question answering (VQA) and subsequent manual inspection by human annotators. By systematically evaluating 23 open-source MLLMs across three matched evaluation settings---text-only, image-only, and image-with-context---Melange isolates the fairness effect of the input modality. Switching from text to vision reduces fairness by 0.291 on average, a gap that varies by model family rather than by scale alone. A perception control confirms that this gap is not an artifact of visual comprehension: models identify the depicted attributes at 90--95\% accuracy yet still fail to abstain. When models do commit to a biased answer, polarity-aware stereotype alignment shows they choose the human-stereotypical response roughly three-quarters of the time.

articles.title_zh: Melange:多式联运大语言模式的合成视觉比喻基准
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)得到广泛采用,但其偏差仍然比标准LLMs的偏差要少得多,在现实世界环境中部署时可能造成社会伤害. 以往将偏差分析从LLMS扩展到多模式空间的努力要么只涵盖少数偏差类别,要么无法确保所比较的群体在图像中通过视觉提示得到明确处理。 为了克服这些限制,我们引入了Melange,这是一个广泛的合成视觉基准,涵盖评估MLLMs中社会偏见的七个类别。 它以来自Big Bench的被广泛使用的仅能使用语言的BBQ数据集(Bias Basic for Question Answering)为基础,通过可控生成可视情景来仔细扩展其构建的背景,从而使目标属性在视觉上清晰地出现. 为了最大限度地提高可靠性,我们生成的图像经过两个验证阶段:利用视觉问题回答(VQA)进行自动筛选,以及随后由人类注释员进行人工检查。 通过系统评价23个开源的MLLMs,通过三个匹配的评价设置——只文本,只图像,并有图像的Context--Melange隔离出输入模式的公平效果. 从文本切换到视觉,平均会减少0.291的公平性,这一差距因模范家庭而异,而不只是规模。 一个感知控制证实,这种差距并不是视觉理解的产物:模型以90-95分的精确度识别所描绘的属性,但仍然未能投弃权. 当模型确实致力于一个偏颇的答案时,极性-认知定型对接显示它们选择了大约四分之三时间的人-定型反应.

articles.title: Supervision-Adaptive Curriculum and Guarded Anti-Curriculum Learning for Dense Prediction
articles.content: Curriculum learning orders samples by difficulty, but difficulty alone does not establish supervision reliability for dense prediction. Easy samples can expose shortcuts, hard samples can be informative, and noisy or ambiguous samples can mislead training. Building on our conference method CurriSeg, we present PaceShift, a stabilize-then-challenge paradigm combining supervision-adaptive curriculum selection with guarded spectral post-training. A learning-dynamics view motivates separating supervision reliability from temporal update value and applying spectral challenges after stabilization. The first phase estimates reliability from available supervision, augmentation consistency, model disagreement, and prediction certainty. Temporal statistics guide sample weighting, while pixel-uncertainty weights reduce the early influence of uncertain regions. The second phase ranks predictions from multiple spectral views using supervision agreement, robustness, reference consistency, and penalties. A pairwise preference objective measured against the frozen Phase-I reference, together with an anchor, refines the prediction. The framework supports full, weak, semi-supervised, and model-derived supervision. Experiments across context-entangled content segmentation (CECS), broader dense-prediction tasks, and foundation-model and cross-modal adaptations show accuracy gains. Targeted diagnostics indicate improved pooled calibration and corruption robustness in the evaluated settings. PaceShift preserves the deployed architecture and adds no inference computation. Code will be publicly released.

articles.title_zh: 监督-强化课程和防腐教育
articles.content_zh: 课程学习通过难度来定下样本,但单靠难度并不能确立对密集预测的监督可靠性. 简单样品可以暴露出捷径,硬样品可以提供信息,吵闹或模棱两可的样品可以误导训练. 根据我们的会议方法CurriSeg,我们介绍PaceShift,一种稳定、当时充满挑战的范式,将监督-适应性课程选择与防守光谱后培训相结合。 学习动力学观点促使将监督可靠性与时间更新值区分开来,并在稳定后应用光谱挑战. 第一阶段从现有监督、增强一致性、模型分歧和预测确定性中估算可靠性。 时间统计指导了样本权重,而像素-不确定性权重则会减少不确定区域的早期影响. 第二阶段利用监督协议、稳健性、参考一致性和惩罚,从多光谱角度对预测进行排序。 对照被冻结的第一阶段参考物衡量的双向偏好目标,加上一个锚,可以完善预测. 该框架支持全面、薄弱、半监督以及模型产生的监督。 跨上下文缠绕内容分解(CECS)的实验,更广泛的密集预测任务,以及基础模型和跨模式的改造,都显示出精度的提高. 有针对性的诊断表明,在被评价环境中,集合校准工作有所改善,腐败程度强劲。 PaceShift 保存了已部署的架构并添加了不推断计算. 代码将公开发布。

articles.title: AutoPhyX: Automatic Text-Condition Physics Property Generation
articles.content: High-fidelity 4D physical simulation requires accurate physical parameter assignments that align with diverse material properties. Previous methods struggle with critical bottlenecks: they either rely on computationally intensive per-scene optimization or predict parameters from purely visual inputs. The latter suffers from inherent ambiguity, e.g., the inability to distinguish the stiffness of rubber from its appearance alone. To bridge this gap, we propose AutoPhyX, a text-conditioned framework for predicting spatially-varying physical properties. Since training robust feed-forward models requires fine-grained supervision, we first introduce a novel part-controllable data generation pipeline that decomposes complex 3D assets into semantically distinct components and pairs them with physically plausible, diverse parameters and corresponding text descriptions. Leveraging this dataset, AutoPhyX employs a cross-modal modulation mechanism where text features dynamically modulate visual features for precise physical grounding. By formulating property prediction within a voxel field, AutoPhyX ensures compatibility with diverse 3D representations, including meshes, point clouds, Gaussian Splatting, and NeRF. Experiments demonstrate that our method enables physically plausible, text-driven parameter assignment in a single forward pass. It achieves high accuracy and robust generalization to in-the-wild objects, paving the way for future physics-intensive embodied and robotic applications.

articles.title_zh: AutoPhyX: 自动文本条件物理属性生成
articles.content_zh: 高真性4D物理模拟需要精确的物理参数任务,与不同的物质属性相配合. 以往的方法与关键瓶颈相抗衡:它们要么依靠计算强度的每层优化,要么通过纯粹的视觉输入来预测参数. 后者有内在的模糊性,例如无法区分橡胶的硬度与外观本身。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出AutoPhyX,这是预测空间变化物理属性的文字条件框架. 由于训练有素的进取饲料模型需要精细的监管,我们首先引入了一个新的可控制部分的数据生成管道,将复杂的立体资产分解成精密相通的组件并配以物理上可信的,多样的参数和相应的文字描述. 利用此数据集,AutoPhyX采用了跨模式的调制机制,其中文本具有动态调制可视特征,用于精确的物理地平面. AutoPhyX通过在一个活性场内制定属性预测,确保了与包括 meshes,点云,高斯平板化,和NeRF等多种3D表示的相容性. 实验表明,我们的方法能够使物理上可行的、文字驱动的参数在单一的前进通道中分配。 它实现了高精度和强力地将各种物体普遍化,为未来的物理学密集型和机器人应用铺平了道路。

articles.title: Balancing Foundation Models and Trait-Specific Learning for Forehead-Crease Recognition
articles.content: Biometric recognition often degrades under partial facial vis- ibility, where conventional facial cues are occluded. The forehead region remains consistently visible and contains distinctive crease patterns that can serve as a complementary biometric trait. We present a unified eval- uation of forehead-crease recognition across explainable zero-shot rea- soning, domain-adaptive learning, and trait-specific modeling. FIRE en- ables interpretable zero-shot verification using multimodal large language models, while pretrained face-recognition models are adapted to the fore- head domain through margin-based learning. Under open-set evaluation, the best zero-shot model GPT-4o+FIRE achieves 18.22% EER, while Edge-Forehead achieves 8.30% EER and 54.01% TMR@0.1% FMR. The results show that although MLLMs offer interpretable zero-shot verifi- cation, trait-specific learning remains more effective for robust forehead- crease biometric recognition.

articles.title_zh: 平衡基金会模式和用于前头-创意识别的Trait-Special学习
articles.content_zh: 生物识别往往在部分面部相对于可视性下降解,其中传统的面部提示被所渗透. 前额区域始终可见并有明显的折痕,可作为生物特征的补充。 我们提出一个统一的eval - eu, 额头-craes识别 跨解释性的零射回声, 域-适应性学习, 和特异性的模型。 FIRE en能使用多式大语言模型解释可被零发校正,而经过预先训练的面相识别模型则通过边距学习来适应前头域. 在开放设定评价下,最佳零射出型GPT-4o+FIRE能达到18.22%的EER,而边缘-Forehead能达到8.3%的EER和54.01%的TDR@0.1%的FMR. 结果表明,虽然MLLMs提供可解释的零发-活性配子,但针对特征的学习对于强健的前额-折痕生物识别仍然更为有效.

articles.title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose $\textbf{LongZero}$, a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. Instead of writing questions and answers over existing documents, LongZero first has the model synthesize the question and answer with its supporting evidence in a compact structured form, and only then separately expands the evidence into a long multi-document context. LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO. We evaluate LongZero on two LLMs across five long-context reasoning benchmarks and compare it with RL on data synthesized from external corpora. Experimental results show that LongZero can generalize to real tasks, and outperforms both baselines, suggesting a viable and promising path to improving long-context reasoning of LLMs.

articles.title_zh: LongZero:加强长文 从零数据获取的法学硕士学位
articles.content_zh: 强化学习(RL)是加强大语言模型(LLMs)长文本推理的有效途径,但它需要长期,多样,具有挑战性和可核查性的培训数据. 人类对此类数据的注释很昂贵,自然出现的数据太少,无法维持RL,而现有的合成方法依赖于外部的Corpora或更强的师范模型,随着训练有素的模型变得更强而变得更难获得. 最近,一个模型从零数据中学习到它自己提出的任务的RL取得了优异的性能,但现有方法以短写任务为目标. 因此,我们提议 $\textbf{ LongZero}$, 这个方法可以让 LLM 在没有任何外部数据的情况下改进自己的长文本推理 。 LongZero没有在现有文档上写问答,而是先由模型以紧凑的结构形式用支持性证据来综合问答,而后再单独地将证据扩展为长多文档上下文. 长 Zero将这些自写多跳推理任务与自写多轮取回任务结合起来,并用GRPO来训练模型. 我们评价了LongZero在两个LLMs上的5个长文本推理基准,并与外部公司合成的数据RL比较。 实验结果表明,LongZero可以概括到实际任务,并且表现优于这两个基线,为改进LLMs的长写推理提出了一条可行而有希望的道路.

articles.title: Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
articles.content: Existing sequential recommenders usually allocate a fixed computational budget to every item in a user's interaction history, regardless of the item's contribution to the final prediction. We challenge this de facto design with two diagnostic findings. (1) Non-uniform computational need: items within the same sequence vary drastically in how much computation they require. Most converge after shallow processing while a critical minority only stabilizes at full depth. (2) Suboptimality of fixed allocation: given oracle access to the target item, a non-uniform depth assignment consistently outranks the fixed one, indicating that existing uniform computation both wastes capacity on already-converged items and sacrifices overall recommendation quality. These observations motivate a shift from fixed-depth computation to item-level adaptive reasoning. To this end, we propose LoopRec. LoopRec recursively applies a single weight-shared block and introduces a lightweight gate at each recursion boundary that makes a binary exit-or-continue decision for every item independently. Items whose representations have sufficiently matured exit early, while those requiring deeper reasoning continue to subsequent recursions. This design converts the fixed global depth into a learned, per-item property without auxiliary depth labels, and is readily adaptable to diverse backbone architectures. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks with four backbone families demonstrate that LoopRec consistently outperforms matched fixed-depth counterparts. Further analysis reveals that LoopRec's learned allocation exhibits interpretable patterns aligned with our post-hoc oracle analysis: lower-frequency items and more recent interactions naturally receive deeper computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Elpmis117/LoopRec.

articles.title_zh: 更用力一点 重要之处:对顺序性建议进行项目级适应性追溯
articles.content_zh: 已存在的相继推荐者通常会为用户互动历史中的每一个项目分配固定的计算预算,而不管项目对最终预测的贡献如何. 我们用两个诊断结论对这一事实上的设计提出质疑。 (1) 非统一计算需要:同一序列内的项目在需要多少计算时差异很大。 多数在浅加工后趋同,而极少数只稳定在充分深度。 (2) 固定分配的不理想性:如果有甲骨文进入目标项目,非统一深度分配总是比固定的要高,表明现有统一计算已核实项目的废物容量和牺牲总体建议质量。 这些意见促使人们从固定的深度计算转向项目一级的适应性推理。 为此,我们提出"循环". Looprec 递归性地应用了单一的权重共享块,并在每个递归边界上引入一个轻量级门,使每个项独立地作出二进制出或相继决定. 其陈述已经足够成熟的项目提前退出,而需要更深入推理的项目随后继续出现。 这种设计将固定的全局深度转换为没有辅助深度标签的有学问的每件属性,并易于适应多种骨干架构. 对四个骨干家庭的公共基准进行的广泛试验表明,LoopRec的业绩一贯高于固定的、深入的对应方。 进一步的分析显示,Looperc的所学分配显示可解释的规律与我们的后预言分析一致:低频项目和更近期的相互作用自然会得到更深入的计算. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/Elpmis117/Looperc.

articles.title: Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution
articles.content: Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. Beyond the scores, the pairwise interactions form a microcosm of how models affect one another. Head-to-head outcomes are transitive and so yield a stable ranking; independent authors converge on the same designs; and in a reinforcement-learning study with Qwen3.8-27B, the learner's hint lift on an author's environments tracks how much training on those environments improves it on held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks, whether the environments are its own or another model's. Each of these patterns has a counterpart in how models shape one another outside the duel. By staging these interactions under controlled conditions, Environment Duels offers a window onto how LLMs teach, challenge and learn from one another. Code is available at https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 环境 Duels: LLM 共同进取的缩影
articles.content_zh: 通过从合成培训管道到公开网上共享数据等现实世界互动的纠缠,前沿有限责任公司吸收了其前身和竞争对手创造的东西。 作为创造者和解决者,每个模型在这个生态系统中都发挥多大作用? 我们引入了Environment Duels,这是一个动态的代理基准,在互动环境中评价两种能力. 每个模型写环境,每个都带有特权提示,目标任务是有能力的解决者在没有提示的情况下失败并与之相通. 跨越9个前沿 LLMS,解析和写作证明是独特的技能:最强解析者不是最强的作者,而更小的模型则更多地学习别人如何玩弄和写出最难的环境和最有用的提示. 在分数之外,双相相互作用形成了模型如何相互影响的缩影. 头到头的结果是过渡性的,因此可以产生稳定的排名;独立作者在相同的设计上趋同;在与Qune3.8-27B的强化学习研究中,学习者在作者环境中的提示升起跟踪这些环境的训练多少可以改善在被搁置的推理和代理基准上的训练,无论环境是自己的还是另一个模型的. 这些图案在模型如何在决斗之外相互塑造方面都有对应的. 通过在受控条件下进行这些互动,“环境模拟”提供了一个窗口,了解LLMs如何相互传授、挑战和学习。 代码见https://github.com/LLM-Duels/Envduels。

articles.title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
articles.content: Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep. Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or individual trading decisions, leaving open whether large language models (LLMs) can complete this loop and produce strategies that work beyond the research period. We introduce Quant-Arena, a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback only on 2022--2023, and freezes one strategy for assessment on the sealed year 2024. A cash-account evaluator applies trading constraints and costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Scores are dominated by realized excess return and complemented by signal quality and the diversity of features used by the strategy. We evaluate nine frontier models, among which GPT-6 Astra scores highest; yet no model beats the equal-weight market in 2024. Quant-Arena is open to submissions from any model or agent harness.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Quant-Arena:定量贸易研究的LLM代理基准
articles.content_zh: 定量研究是一个迭代循环:研究者提出市场假说,作为可执行信号执行,在历史数据上测试,并决定保存什么. 现有基准计分公式,代码,或单个交易决定,对于大语言模型(LLMS)能否完成这个循环,产生超过研究期有效的策略,则留有开口. 我们引入了"Quant-Arena",这是对真实的A-share市场数据进行端到端定量研究的基准和公共领导板. 一个模型构建了特征和股票评分代码,只在2022-2023年接收回馈,并冻结了被封存的2024年的一个评估策略. 现金账户评估员采用交易限制和成本,包括模拟订货簿估计的市场影响。 分数以实际的超额回报为主,并以信号质量和该战略所用特性的多样性为补充。 我们评价了9个前沿模型,其中GPT-6 Astra的得分最高;然而,2024年没有任何模型能比同量市场强. Quant-Arena可接受任何模型或代理设备的提交。

articles.title: Did the Problem Actually Get Harder? Testing LLMs on Paired P and NP-Complete Problems Hardened by Adversarial Multi-Agent Rewriting
articles.content: Many NP-complete (NPC) problems have a polynomial-time (P) twin that differs in a single structural detail, such as 3- versus 2-colouring a graph. A model that reasons rather than recalls should notice which side of this boundary a problem falls on, yet existing benchmarks either fix the wording of each task or ignore its complexity class, so they cannot separate the two. We introduce P2NPCBench, a benchmark of 12 problem families in which every NPC problem is paired with a P twin posed over the same surface. To remove the textbook cues that enable recall, we build it with AgentGAN, an adversarial multi-agent framework in which a generator rewrites each statement until a panel of frozen code models fails, while an executable validity gate keeps every rewrite answer- and class-preserving. The result is 2,114 hardened statements with hand-verified reference human solvers. Evaluating 12 proprietary and open-source models, we find that every model scores lower on NPC statements than on their P twins (35.4% vs. 63.8% pass@1), and that 95.1% of model-family pairs fail more often on the NPC side. A tenfold time limit raises NPC accuracy only from 28.5% to 31.9%, so failures stem from wrong or crashing programs rather than slow ones. Hardening also narrows the class gap from 24.8 to 14.6 points, showing that part of the apparent gap reflects familiarity with textbook phrasing rather than complexity class.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 问题真的更难吗? 在Paired P和NP-Conflete问题上测试 LLMs 由逆向多代理重写来强化
articles.content_zh: 许多NP-完成(NPC)问题有一个多名-时(P)双子,在单个结构细节上有所不同,例如3-对2-色图. 说明问题的原因而不是回顾问题的模式应注意问题所在的边界,但现有基准要么确定每项任务的措辞,要么忽略其复杂性类别,因此不能将两者分开。 我们引入了P2NPC Bench,这是12个问题家庭的基准,其中每个NPC问题都与一个P双子放在同一个地表上。 为了删除允许召回的教科书提示,我们用AgentGAN构建了它,AgentGAN是一个对抗性的多代理框架,其中一个生成器重写每个语句,直到被冻结的代码模型的面板失败,而可执行有效性门则保留每个重写答案和类保存. 结果有2,114个有人工验证的参考人类解析器的硬化陈述. 对12个专有和开源模型的评价,我们发现每个模型在NPC语句上的得分都低于他们的P双胞胎(35.4%对63.8%通过@1),95.1%的模型-家族配对在NPC方面更经常地失败. 十倍的时间限制将NPC精度从28.5%提高到了31.9%,因此失败源于错误或崩溃的程序而不是慢程序. 硬化还使班级差距从24.8分缩小到14.6分,表明部分明显的差距反映了对教科书措辞的熟悉而不是复杂性班级.

articles.title: VX-One: Typed, Calibrated Decision Heads for Real-Time Perimeter Triage - An empirical study of unknown-attack honesty, cascade gray zones, and calibration under drift
articles.content: Perimeter triage faces a latency/semantics trade-off: signature engines are fast and format-safe but blind to unseen attacks, while generative models are semantic but slow and produce unparseable output. In late 2026 a class of commercial System One decision models (TypeSafe Jev; Microsoft-Decision-1) began selling typed decision primitives - binary gates, closed-set choices, ordinal scores - as product APIs, with no academic treatment. We present VX-One: a small multi-head network (100K-10M parameters) whose outputs are these primitives - a calibrated gate, a choice over a closed candidate set that always includes an explicit unknown option, and an ordinal score, trained multi-task, temperature-calibrated per head (~0.7-1.7 ms p50 on CPU). We evaluate it on UNSW-NB15, CIC-IDS2017, EMBER2024 against calibrated XGBoost, Random-Forest, MLP, Kitsune, and measure a two-phase cascade (Suricata with 52,674 Emerging-Threats rules -> VX-One) over five days of CIC-IDS2017. Findings: (i) VX-One wins detection (AUROC/FPR@95%TPR) on UNSW-NB15 and under temporal drift on CIC-IDS2017 (0.711 vs 0.637), but XGBoost wins multi-class attribution on all three benchmarks; (ii) leave-one-family-out gate detects never-seen families on 9/9 UNSW folds yet drops below chance on CIC recon family, and abstention threshold transfers poorly across benchmarks; (iii) on payload-less reconstructions signature engines resolve ~0.1% of flows - gray zone ~99.9% of traffic, recovered by Phase 2 (combined recall >=0.978); (iv) calibration collapses under temporal drift (ECE 0.04->0.40) for every method while ranking partially survives. We provide a measured account of where typed calibrated decisions help perimeter triage, and where they fail.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VX- 1: 实时周边打印、校准的决定头 纹身 - 对不明攻击诚实、级联灰色地带和漂流下校正的实证研究
articles.content_zh: 近缘分解面临暂时性/语义取舍:签名引擎快而格式安全但盲从了看不见的攻击;而基因模型是语义性但缓慢并产生无法分解的输出. 2026年后期,一号商业系统决定模型(TypeSafe Jev;Microsoft-Decision-1)作为产品API开始销售被打入了决定的原始-二进制门,封闭式设置选择,平分-作为产品,没有学术待遇. 我们提出VX-One:一个小型多头网络(100K-10M参数),其输出是这些原始的-校正门,选择一个总是包含一个明确未知选项的封闭候选集,以及一个经训练的多任务,温度校正每头(CPU上~0.7-1.7ms p50)的正数分. 我们在UNSW-NB15、CIC-IDS2017、EMBER2024上对校准的XGBoost、Random-Forest、MLP、Kitsune进行了评价,并在CIC-IDS2017的五天内测量出两相级联(Suricata有52 674个新兴-危险规则 -- -- > VX-One)。 调查结果:(一) VX-One在UNSW-NB15上(AUROC/FPR@95%TPR)和CIC-IDS2017上(0.711 vs 6.637)在时间漂移下胜出,但XGBoost在所有三个基准上都赢得了多等归属;(二)在UNSW9/9上,离开一个家庭门检测到永远看不到的家庭,但在CIC侦察家庭上却低于机会,在基准上弃权阈值转让差;(三)在无负载重建上,签名引擎解决了流量的~0.1% -- -- 灰色地段~99.9%,由第二阶段恢复(综合召回~0.978);(四)在时间漂移下校准崩溃(欧洲经委会0.04-0.40),同时将部分活下来。 我们提供了一份有分量的叙述,说明打出校正后的决定在哪些方面有助于周边的分辨,哪些方面失败了。

articles.title: GoiBERT: Compact Vietnamese Language Models via Two-Stage Knowledge Distillation
articles.content: Vietnamese pre-trained encoders have improved rapidly, but the strongest ones are large, multilingual-vocabulary models or depend on external word segmentation, which makes them costly to deploy. We present GoiBERT, a family of two compact Vietnamese encoders with 26M and 49M parameters that operate directly on raw text. GoiBERT learns from two complementary teachers. A same-tokenizer Vietnamese encoder first teaches general-purpose representations. A much larger teacher then provides task-level guidance through soft labels that are generated without ever labeling its own training data. Across eight benchmarks covering text classification, aspect-based sentiment analysis, natural language inference, and named entity recognition, GoiBERT-large achieves the highest average score among non-teacher models. It does so with fewer than half the parameters of the strongest compact baseline and twice its throughput. GoiBERT-base retains 99% of that baseline's performance at a quarter of its size. Our analysis shows that compression is nearly lossless for sentiment and classification tasks but remains costly for inference and entity recognition, which points to clear directions for future work. Our code and models are available at: https://github.com/Nhantran65/GoiBERT.git
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GoiBERT:通过"双阶知识分解"收缩越南语模式
articles.content_zh: 越南先行训练的编码器迅速改进,但最强的编码是大型多语种-vocabulary模型或依赖于外部的单词分解,这使得其部署成本昂贵. 我们介绍GoiBERT, 由两个越南语的紧凑编码器组成, 有26M参数和49M参数直接在原始文本上运行。 GoiBERT向两位互补教师学习. 一个同位调的越南编码器首先教授通用表示. 然后,一个大得多的教师通过软标签提供任务层面的指导,这些标签生成时从未给自己的培训数据贴上标签。 在包括文本分类、以方面为基础的情感分析、自然语言推论和被命名的实体识别在内的8个基准中,GoiBERT-group在非教师模式中取得了最高的平均分。 它利用不到最紧凑基线参数的一半和两倍的吞吐量来完成这项工作。 GoiBERT-base保留了该基准的99%的性能,其规模为四分之一. 我们的分析表明,压缩对于情绪和分类任务来说几乎是毫无损失的,但对推断和实体识别来说仍然是代价高昂的,这为今后的工作指明了明确的方向。 我们的代码和模型可查阅:https://github.com/Nhantran65/GoiBERT.git。

articles.title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: Uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising sequences of ordinary vocabulary tokens, any of which may be corrupted and subsequently revised. During training, UDLMs must denoise from a context that may itself be unreliable, whereas masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) always condition on a clean context. This challenging training objective makes UDLMs more FLOP-intensive to train than MDLMs, but it yields stronger downstream reasoning performance. Recently, selective looping, which recursively applies a few early Transformer layers within each denoising step, has been shown to improve training efficiency in MDLMs under an iso-FLOP budget. We investigate looping in UDLMs while keeping the training objective and sampler unchanged. We find that looping significantly improves training efficiency: looped UDLMs reach the validation NLL of a non-looped UDLM trained on about 0.5 trillion tokens with up to 2.8x fewer training FLOPs on OpenWebText and 3.3x fewer on FineWeb-Edu. We also find that, at a matched NFE budget, looped UDLMs reach up to 9.8% lower generation perplexity than the non-looped UDLM, with most gains achieved at moderate loop counts. Finally, we study different loop-count distributions and find that sampling smaller loop counts more frequently during training improves inference efficiency: on downstream tasks, this strategy uses 12% fewer loops than uniform loop-count sampling without degrading accuracy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 循环统一传播语言模式
articles.content_zh: 统一传播语言模型(UDLMs)通过迭代去命名普通词汇符号的序列来生成文本,其中任何一种都可能被腐蚀并随后被修改. 在培训期间,UDLM必须从本身可能不可靠的语境中隐去,而被掩盖的传播语言模型总是以干净语境为条件。 这一具有挑战性的培训目标使得UDLM对培训的FLOP更加密集,但比MDLM更能产生更强的下游推理性能. 最近,在异位-FLOP预算下,有选择性地循环在每一个去诺步骤中循环应用了几个早期变形器层,以提高MDLM的培训效率。 我们调查UDLM的循环情况,同时保持培训目标和取样员不变。 我们发现环绕大大提高了训练效率:环绕的UDLM达到了对一个用约0.5万亿个符号训练的非LUDLM的验证,在OpenWebText上的培训FLOP最多会减少2.8x,在FineWeb-Edu上的培训FLOP减少3.3x. 我们还发现,在匹配的NFE预算中,环绕的UDLM比非环绕的UDLM达到9.8%更低的生成复杂度,大多数收益都是在中度循环计数下取得的. 最后,我们研究了不同的循环计数分布,发现在培训期间抽样较小的循环计数更频繁地提高了推论效率:在下游任务中,这个策略使用比统一的循环计数抽样少了12%的循环,而没有降低准确度.

articles.title: What the Author Wrote, What the Agent Reads: Silent Cue Loss in Enterprise Document Ingestion
articles.content: Enterprise agents act on documents. Before an agent can follow a policy, answer a compliance question or file a ticket, some ingestion layer must turn a Word file or PDF into tokens - and that layer is where an agent deployed in the wild silently loses information. We show that one layer is lost by every mainstream converter - the meaning an author encodes in how text looks - and that the loss makes agents confidently wrong rather than visibly incomplete. We build a task from 76 real policy documents: recover the requirements the author singled out, scored against the file's own OOXML properties by a deterministic matcher with no LLM judge. Formatting-blind ingestion collapses from micro F1 0.690 to 0.150 (docling) and 0.075 (plain text), a gap that replicates across six answering models from two vendors - five Claude models spanning the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku tiers, and OpenAI's GPT-5.6. An agent that cannot see the cue guesses, and docling's false-positive rate on requirements the author did not flag is four times ours. A span-level leave-one-out localises the loss to two cues - highlight (+0.302) and colour (+0.262), both Holm-adjusted p < 1e-4 - while bold, italic, monospace and strikethrough each sit within +/-0.003 of zero. The same asymmetry appears in PDF. Colour is also the cue no mainstream converter preserves and no parsing benchmark scores, and it is common: 32.8% of 6,460 documents carry a deliberate colour or highlight, 10.3% on an obligation. A pre-registered test shows that typing a cue for the agent adds +0.085 beyond merely preserving it (Holm-adjusted p = 0.049). We validate the labels against rendered page images through an independent modality (kappa = 0.72) and bound what wording alone can achieve (AUC 0.664). For agent builders the practical finding is that ingestion, not reasoning, is where this reliability is won or lost, and that the fix is cheap and measurable.

articles.title_zh: 作者写作,代理读作:企业文档摄取中的寂静 Cue 损失
articles.content_zh: 企业代理人根据文件行事。 在代理人员能够遵循政策,回答遵守问题或提交罚单之前,一些摄入层必须把Word文件或PDF变成符号——而该层是部署在野外的代理人员默默地丢失信息的地方. 我们显示,每个主流转换器都丢失了一层,即作者在文本的外观中编码的含义,而且丢失使代理商自信地错误而不是明显地不完整。 我们从76个真正的政策文件中构建一个任务:恢复作者单独列出的要求,通过一个没有LLM法官的确定性匹配者来比对文件自己的OOXML属性。 格式化-盲摄入从微F1 0.690到0.150 (docling)和0.075 (plain text)相继倒闭,这一缺口复制了来自两个小贩的6个解答模型——5个克洛德模型跨越了Opus,Sonnet和Haiku等级,以及OpenAI的GPT-5.6. 无法看清提示猜想的代理 以及作者没有标注的要求上的假阳性率 是我们的四倍 跨级的一出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出入出出入出出出入出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出入出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 同样的不对称出现在PDF中. 彩色也是主流转换器没有保留、也没有解析基准分数的提示。 常见的情况是:在6 460份文件中,32.8%的文件带有故意的彩色或亮度,10.3%的文件带有义务。 预先登记的测试显示,为代理输入一个提示会增加+0.085,而不仅仅是保留(Holm调整后p=0.049)。 我们通过一种独立模式(kappa = 0.72)来验证所制作的页面图像的标签,并约束单凭措辞就能达到的目标(AUC 0.664)。 对于代理构建者来说,实际的发现是摄取而不是推理是这种可靠性的胜负所在,而固定是廉价和可测量的.

articles.title: Agent Behavior Maps: Locating Agents by What They Would Do, Without Running Them
articles.content: LLM agents with similar success rates can follow different action sequences. An Agent Behavior Map represents LLM-harness combinations using centered action log-likelihoods on shared reference trajectories, without requiring new environment rollouts from the target agent. We derive error bounds relating squared coordinate distances to trajectory KL under explicit assumptions, and across eight cross-scored models the distances track the directly measured trajectory KL in rank order. Across 100 LLMs and four environments, ALFWorld-based coordinates support performance prediction and identify behavioral similarities. In ALFWorld, these similarities persist after controlling for success rates and model size, including across model families. As an extension, harness-component displacements approximately compose, with accuracy varying across components and environments.

articles.title_zh: 代理行为 地图: 以他们愿意做什么来定位代理, 不运行 他们
articles.content_zh: 成功率相近的LLM剂可以遵循不同的动作序列. 一个代理行为映射(Agent Behavior Map)代表LLM-harness组合,在共享的参考轨迹上使用中心动作日志相类似,而不需要目标代理展开新的环境. 根据明确的假设,我们得出了与KL轨迹有关的平方坐标距离的误差界限,在八个交叉计分模型中,距离按照排名顺序跟踪直接测量的KL轨迹。 在100个LLMs和四个环境中,以ALFWorld为基础的协调支持性能预测并识别行为相似性. 在ALFWorld中,这些相似性在控制成功率和模型规模后继续存在,包括跨模型家庭. 作为一种延伸,利用成分迁移大约是构成的,准确性因组成部分和环境而异。

articles.title: Building Auditable AI Text Detectors with Sparse Autoencoders
articles.content: AI-generated text detectors are increasingly deployed in consequential settings---peer review, education, admissions, journalism, and content moderation---where their outputs directly affect individuals. Yet the strongest detectors are fine-tuned neural classifiers whose decisions are opaque, while transparent alternatives (stylometric and linguistic-feature classifiers) underperform them by wide margins. We present a pipeline that converts a fine-tuned neural detector into a classifier that operates on human-readable concepts. We accomplish this by training sparse autoencoders (SAEs) directly on a detector's residual stream, assigning auto-interpretation labels to each SAE feature, and retaining only features whose generated descriptions pass a global fidelity threshold. We then train a lightweight classifier on just the interpretable features. We find that our SAEs recover latent concepts that correspond to highly specific and predictive linguistic "tells" of AI-generated text. Classifiers built on these extracted features are not only highly interpretable but exhibit stronger performance on out-of-distribution texts than either neural or stylometric alternatives.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用 Sparse 自动编码器构建可审计的 AI 文本检测器
articles.content_zh: AI生成的文本探测器越来越多地被部署在相应的环境中 -- -- 同行审查、教育、录取、新闻和内容节制 -- -- 其产出直接影响到个人。 然而最强的探测器是微调的神经分级器,其决定不透明,而透明的替代方法(时态和语言特征分级器)则以宽边差来使其表现不佳. 我们提出一个管道,将一个微调神经探测器转换成一个在人可读概念上运作的分类器. 我们通过直接在探测器的剩余流上培训稀少的自动编码器来完成这项工作,为每个自动编码器的特性分配自动解释标签,并只保留其生成的描述超过全球忠诚阈值的特性。 然后,我们训练一个轻量级分类器 仅关于可解释的特性。 我们发现,我们的SAE恢复了潜在的概念,这些概念与AI生成的文本中高度具体和预测的语言"提"相对应. 以这些取出的特点为基础的分类器不仅具有高度的可解释性,而且在分配外文本上的性能也比神经或分型的替代品要强。

articles.title: HiddenLens: A Multi-Layer LLM Framework for Detecting and Resolving Hidden Assumptions in Software Requirements
articles.content: Natural-language software requirements often omit assumptions about performance, operating conditions, user behaviour, and domain constraints, affecting architecture, testing, and deployment. If undiscovered until implementation, resolving them is far more costly than addressing them early. Although ambiguity and vagueness are widely studied, less attention has been given to assumptions embedded in requirements that appear clear and reasonable. We propose HiddenLens, a novel six-layer BERT-LLM pipeline and, to our knowledge, the first framework engineered to detect, classify, question, and resolve hidden assumptions rather than merely flag ambiguity. Layer 1 uses BERT attention entropy to localise unresolved spans; Layer 2 uses CoT-prompted LLM reasoning to articulate each assumption and its failure risk; Layer 3 uses fine-tuned BERT to classify assumptions into six non-functional requirement categories: performance, security, scalability, usability, reliability, and domain; Layer 4 generates ranked clarification options using FS LLM prompting; Layer 5 enables human validation through confirmation, editing, or rephrasing; and Layer 6 rewrites the requirement using the confirmed resolution, producing an explicit, testable, and traceable requirement. We also introduce the HiddenLens Corpus (HLC), comprising 312 requirements annotated with 847 hidden assumptions across six NFR categories. Inspired by PROMISE and PURE, HLC addresses the lack of annotated data for this task and is, to our knowledge, the first dataset developed specifically for it. HiddenLens outperforms keyword-based and QuARS-Adapted baselines by 71% and 61%, respectively, achieving an end-to-end F1-score of 0.79; its BERT-based NFR classifier achieves an F1-score of 0.847. These results indicate that HiddenLens can help analysts resolve hidden assumptions before they propagate through software development.

articles.title_zh: 隐藏灯:多层 LLM 检测和解决软件要求中隐藏假设的框架
articles.content_zh: 自然语言的软件要求往往忽略了关于性能,操作条件,用户行为,和域域限制的假设,影响架构,测试,部署. 如果在执行之前尚未发现,解决这些问题比及早解决这些问题要昂贵得多。 虽然对模糊性和模糊性进行了广泛研究,但对似乎明确和合理的要求中所包含的假设却较少重视. 我们提出HiddleLens, 一个新的六层BERT-LLM管道, 而据我们所知,第一个设计框架是为了检测、分类、质疑和解决隐藏的假设, 而不仅仅是旗帜模糊。 第1层使用BERT注意力 en来本地化未解决的跨度; 第2层使用CoT催化的LLM推理来阐明每个假设及其故障风险; 第3层使用微调的BERT来将假设分类为6个非功能要求类别:性能,安全性,可缩放性,可用性,可靠性,和域; 第4层使用FS LLM提示生成排名澄清选项; 第5层通过确认,编辑,或重写,使人类能够进行验证; 第6层使用已确认的分辨率来重写要求,产生明确,可测试,可追踪的要求. 我们还引入了 " 隐藏Lens Corpus " (HLC),包含312项要求,并在6个NFR类别中附加了847个隐性假设。 在ProMISE和PURE的启发下,HLC解决了缺乏这项工作附加说明的数据的问题,据我们所知,这是专门为这项工作开发的第一个数据集。 HideLens的基于关键词和QuARS-Adapted基线分别以71%和61%的成绩取而代之,实现了从端到端的F1-分数为0.79;其基于BERT的NFR分数器的F1-分数为0.847. 这些结果表明"隐藏的Lens"可以帮助分析师在通过软件开发传播之前解决隐藏的假设.

articles.title: Remembering Through Change: Provenance-Preserving Hypergraph Memory for Multimodal Agents
articles.content: Long-term memory for multimodal agents remains challenging, as it must preserve fine-grained visual evidence while tracking entity evolution across sessions. Existing abstraction-based memories compress images into text, often discarding visually discriminative details, whereas pixel-preserving memories retain raw observations but struggle to reliably associate diverse observations with persistent entity identities and track their evolving states. To address these limitations, we propose MHG-Mem, a multimodal hypergraph memory that jointly organizes entity identity, state evolution, and provenance to visual evidence. Specifically, MHG-Mem represents distinct entity mentions and their observed facts as individual nodes, grouping identity-consistent mentions and facts through occurrence hyperedges. It then synthesizes aspect-specific evolution states from these grouped observations and links them to supporting entities, facts, and source evidence through evolutionary and evidential hyperedges. To navigate this structured memory, we introduce hypergraph-based agentic search, which adaptively selects an entry layer, traverses typed hyperedges across memory levels, and inspects source observations when fine-grained verification is required. These designs support both detailed visual verification and reasoning over cross-session state changes. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MHG-Mem, improving performance by 8.20-9.98% over the strongest baseline.
