articles.title_zh: 记忆通过 更改: 为多式联运代理保存超文本链接
articles.content_zh: 多式联运代理商的长期记忆仍然具有挑战性,因为它必须保留精细的视觉证据,同时跟踪各个环节的实体演变情况。 以抽象为基础的现有记忆将图像压缩为文字,往往丢弃视觉上有区别的细节,而以像素保存的记忆则保留了原始的观察,但努力将各种观察与持续的实体身份可靠地联系起来并跟踪其不断发展的状态. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议MHG-Mem,一种多模式的超地图记忆,它联合组织实体身份,状态演变,以及视觉证据的来源. 具体地说,MHG-Mem代表不同的实体作为个别节点提及和观察到的事实,将符合身份的提及和事实组合在一起,通过事件超尖端。 然后,它从这些分组观测中综合了具体方面的演变状态,并通过演化和证据超接头将其与辅助实体,事实和源证据相连接. 为了导航这种结构化的内存,我们引入了基于超地图的代理搜索,它适应性地选择了入地层,跨内存水平穿行了打入的超地层,并在需要精细的校验时检查源观测. 这些设计既支持详细的视觉验证,也支持跨会场状态变化的推理. 跨越三个基准的广泛实验表明MHG-Mem的功效,比最强的基准提高8.20%-9.98%。

articles.title: CulturalRiddles: A Multicultural Benchmark of Riddles
articles.content: As LLMs expand their language coverage, evaluating how well they understand and represent diverse cultures becomes increasingly important. However, many benchmarks remain English-centric, with limited cultural coverage and a focus on factual knowledge over its application in real-world cultural contexts. We propose CulturalRiddles, a benchmark of original, culturally grounded riddles created entirely by humans through a participatory community effort, spanning 62 cultures (45 countries, 51 languages). These riddles are deeply rooted in their respective cultures and require abductive and compositional reasoning, alongside detailed factual and social knowledge, language skills, and an understanding of culturally specific associations. We benchmark 28 LLM configurations using both automatic and large-scale human evaluation. Even frontier models achieve at most 22% accuracy in some communities. We publicly release all artifacts alongside an open contribution process to expand the benchmark's linguistic and cultural coverage.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 文化中枢:中枢的多元文化基准
articles.content_zh: 随着法学硕士扩大语言覆盖面,评价其理解和代表不同文化的程度变得日益重要。 然而,许多基准仍然以英语为中心,文化覆盖面有限,并注重实际知识,了解其在现实世界文化中的应用情况。 我们提出“文化之谜”,这是完全由人类通过社区参与努力创造的原始和基于文化的谜语的基准,涉及62个文化(45个国家,51个语言)。 这些谜语根深蒂固地扎根于各自的文化之中,需要有绑架性和构成性的推理,同时需要详细的事实和社会知识、语言技能以及对文化上特有的联系的理解。 我们使用自动和大规模人类评价来衡量28个LLM配置。 即使前沿模型在一些社区也达到了最多22%的准确度。 我们公开发布所有文物,同时公开贡献进程,以扩大基准的语言和文化覆盖面。

articles.title: Commit or Abstain? System One Decision Models, LLMs, and Missing Legal Authority
articles.content: Given the enormous number of claims to be checked, verifiable legal AI requires scalable, cost-effective models that answer the practical needs of law. System One decision models are built on large language models but, instead of generating text, return a calibrated probability for each option. This suits the verification of legal authority, where the question is closed: a given holding, or none of them. We test whether such models abstain when the correct authority is missing. We extend CaseHOLD with an abstention condition in which the correct holding is replaced in 1,670 of 5,314 items, and compare four decision models with six generative LLMs. When no option is correct, generative LLMs still pick one in 38-86% of items; the most cautious decision model does so in 30%. On standard CaseHOLD, a decision model matches the best generative LLM (88.1% vs. 88.2%) at 1/55 of the cost. Accepting that LLM's answer only when a decision model agrees halves its wrong citations, and distilling a decision model's probabilities into Qwen3-8B, without labels, yields a well-calibrated local model. Legal AI should be judged by its wrong citations, not by accuracy alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 投降还是投降? 系统一判决模式、有限责任公司和失踪法律机构
articles.content_zh: 鉴于需要核实的索赔数量之多,可核查的法律大赦国际需要适应法律实际需要的可扩展、成本效益高的模式。 系统 一个决定模型建立在大语言模型上,但是不生成文本,而是返回每个选项的校准概率. 这符合对法律权威的核查,因为问题已经解决:一个特定持有,或一个都没有。 我们检验这些模型是否在缺乏正确权威时弃权。 我们延长了CaseHOLD的弃权条件,即在5 314项中的1 670项中替换正确的持有量,并将4项决定模型与6项基因有限责任清单进行比较。 当没有选择正确时,遗传性LLMs仍然在38-86%的项目中选择一个;最谨慎的决定模式是30%。 在标准CaseHOLD中,一个决定模型与成本的1/55的最佳基因LLM(88.1%对88.2%)相匹配。 接受LLM的答案,只有在一个决定模型同意将错误的引用量减半时,才能接受,并且将一个决定模型的概率分馏为Qune3-8B,没有标签,产生一个精准的本地模型. 应以错误的引用,而不是仅以准确性来判断法警。

articles.title: Towards English - Mizo Legal Machine Translation: Corpus Creation, Analysis, and Benchmarks
articles.content: Indian court proceedings are held in English, so speakers of languages with limited translation technology have limited access to them. We present the first English Mizo parallel dataset of Indian court judgments. It contains 13,168 sentence pairs from the Gauhati High Court and the Supreme Court of India. Professional native Mizo translators translated complete documents; sentence pairs were manually aligned, and two independent reviewers checked the results. Our study finds that English words are borrowed in a very selective way: official and legal terms are almost always kept in English, but words for everyday things like actions, situations, and results are usually expressed in native Mizo. Mizo diacritics are also used inconsistently across the corpus. When we fine tune the NLLB 200 1.3B model on our training data, it scores 27.47 BLEU on a balanced legal test set of 1,000 sentence pairs, an improvement of 7.16 BLEU over the base model. However, it still uses English words about three times more often than a human translator does.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 走向英语 - Mizo法律机器翻译:公司创建、分析和基准
articles.content_zh: 印度的法庭诉讼程序以英语进行,因此,讲翻译技术有限的语言的人获得这些语言的机会有限。 我们提供了第一套关于印度法院判决的英文Mizo并行数据集。 其中收录了高哈蒂高等法院和印度最高法院的13,168对判决. 专业本地Mizo翻译翻译了完整的文件;句子对齐是手动对齐的,两名独立审查员检查了结果. 我们的研究发现,英语单词的借取方式是非常有选择性的:官方和法律术语几乎总是用英语来保留,但日常事物的用词如行动,情况,结果通常用原生的米佐来表达. 水上二甲酸盐在使用过程中也不一致。 当我们在训练数据上微调NLLB 200 1.3B模型时,它通过1000个句子的均衡法律测试集得分27.47 BLEU,比基模型改进了7.16 BLEU. 然而,它仍然使用英语单词的频率大约是人类翻译的三倍.

articles.title: ToM2Vec: Continuous Theory-of-Mind Tokens for Multi-Agent Coordination
articles.content: Forming an accurate theory-of-mind (ToM) is key to successful multi-agent collaboration and requires reasoning under uncertainty to capture multiple possible partner states. This is hard to do in the text representation space native to large language model (LLM) agents, which more easily describe a single partner state. To address this challenge, we introduce ToM2Vec, which learns to form abstract theories-of-mind in a rich latent space via a fixed budget of continuous reasoning tokens. During training, supervision for these tokens comes from the partner's actual thoughts, which the ToM tokens are trained to abstract and match. At test-time, ToM tokens are generated by each agent and act as conditioners for that agent's thoughts and actions. Across several environments covering collaborative, competitive, and mixed-motive settings (Overcooked-AI, multiparty negotiation, Decrypto, Hanabi, and Collab Escape/Capture), we evaluate ToM2Vec's ability to support multi-agent interactions and collaboration, finding consistent improvements over the base model and a variety of competitive trained and prompted baselines. We show that latent reasoning is critical, with performance dropping when reasoning is expressed in text. Moreover, we show that ToM2Vec training generalizes to partner model families not seen at train-time, including a proprietary model (GPT-5.4). In our analysis, we provide evidence that the latent tokens encode a ToM, rather than task-specific information: ToM2Vec's tokens improve the agent's ability to directly answer questions about partner beliefs, desires, and next actions.

articles.title_zh: ToM2Vec:多代理协调连续理论
articles.content_zh: 形成准确的 " 注意 " (Tom)理论是成功开展多代理人协作的关键,需要在不确定的情况下进行推理,以抓住多个可能的伙伴国家。 这在文字代表空间中很难做到,在大语言模型(LLM)代理中更方便地描述单个伙伴国. 为了应对这一挑战,我们引入了TOM2Vec,它通过固定的连续推理符号预算,在丰富的潜在空间中学习形成抽象的思维理论. 在训练期间,对这些道具的监督来自合伙人的实际想法,TOM道具经过了抽象和相配的训练. 在测试时,每个代理都会生成Tom符,并充当该代理的思想和行动调节器. 在整个涵盖协作、竞争和混合动机环境的多个环境(监督-AI、多方谈判、Decrypto、Hanabi和Collab Escape/Capture)中,我们评价了TOM2Vec支持多代理人互动和协作的能力,发现在基础模式和各种经过培训的竞争性基线方面不断改进。 我们表明,潜在的推理至关重要,当推理在文本中表达时,表现会下降。 此外,我们显示,TOM2Vec培训向在火车时刻没有见到的伙伴模范家庭进行概括,包括一种专有模式(GPT-5.4)。 在我们的分析中,我们提供了证据,说明潜伏的活符编码了一个Tom,而不是特定任务的信息:TOM2Vec的活符提高了代理商直接回答关于伙伴信仰,欲望和下一步行动的问题的能力.

articles.title: Graph Topology Meets Energy-Driven Pathfinding: Preserving Contextual Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.content: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frequently integrates knowledge graphs (KGs) for complex multi-hop question answering. However, their performance is increasingly bottlenecked by the knowledge structuring and reasoning processes. (i) Severe semantic loss: Distilling continuous texts into discrete symbols strips away contextual nuances and narrative coherence. (ii) Pronounced modality mismatch: Fragmented graph structures clash with the continuous texts LLMs are pre-trained on, while rewriting them into natural language introduces generative noise and omits information. To address these limitations, we propose ThreadRAG, a semantic-topology-based RAG framework for context-preserving knowledge structuring and modality-native evidence reasoning. ThreadRAG introduces a Semantic Topology Mapper (STM), which organizes retrieved documents into context-intact Semantic Nodes and constructs a Semantic Topology Graph (STG) through narrative, semantic, and lexical edges. It further incorporates Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP), which identifies query-relevant subgraphs via energy diffusion and deterministically linearizes them into coherent textual evidence paths. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that ThreadRAG consistently outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it achieves a 14.4% EM improvement over text-centric methods on HotpotQA and surpasses the best baseline by 5.8% EM on 2WikiMultihop, while reducing token cost to 23.3% of the strongest baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Graph Toplogy meets Energy-Driven Dathface: Retrieval-Auguped Crowth中保存环境一致性
articles.content_zh: Retrival-augmented generation(RAG)经常将知识图(KGs)集成,用于复杂的多跳问答. 然而,由于知识结构和推理过程,它们的绩效日益受到瓶颈。 (一) 严重的语义损失: 将连续文本分解成离散的符号会剥去背景的细微差别和叙述的连贯性。 (二)发音模式不匹配:断裂图结构与连续文本LLMs相冲突,被预先训练,而将它们重写为自然语言则引入了基因噪声并省略了信息. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议采用ThreadRAG,这是一个基于语义-地形学的RAG框架,用于上下文保存知识的结构和模式-内在证据推理。 ThreadRAG引入了语义地形图(STM),将检索到的文档组织入上下文-插入语义节点,并通过叙事,语义和词汇边缘来构建语义地形图(STG). 它进一步纳入了能源驱动路径搜索(EDP),通过能量扩散确定与查询有关的子图,并确定将其线性化为一致的文字证据路径。 关于三个多跳QA基准的实验表明,ThreadRAG的业绩始终高于强基线。 值得注意的是,在HotpotQA上,EM比以文字为中心的方法改进了14.4%,在2Wiki Multihop上超过最佳基线5.8%,同时将象征性成本降至最强基线的23.3%。

articles.title: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
articles.content: A benchmark is not merely a collection of test questions; it naturally induces an empirical measure over difficulty. In this work, we develop this measure-based view of benchmark evaluation. This perspective allows us to identify and formalize two central failure modes: measure mismatch, where the benchmark difficulty distribution differs from the intended difficulty distribution, and coverage gaps, where uncovered regions along the difficulty axis prevent benchmarks from detecting meaningful localized training progress. We propose two diagnostic metrics that capture these two failure modes and provide rigorous theoretical guarantees. Empirically, we analyze 25 popular benchmarks spanning 7 domains using carefully estimated item difficulties. Our results show that many benchmarks implicitly overweight certain difficulty regions, so their leaderboard conclusions should be interpreted with caution; others leave substantial portions of the difficulty axis uncovered, limiting their ability to monitor the model improvement process. Finally, we turn diagnosis into action by introducing BenchFill, a simple difficulty-targeted item rewriting algorithm that effectively reduces local coverage gaps.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 您的基准是一个经验性衡量标准过难
articles.content_zh: 基准不仅仅是一个测试问题集;它自然会诱导一种经验性衡量标准,而不是困难。 在这项工作中,我们发展了这种以衡量为基础的基准评价观点。 这一视角使我们能够确定和正式确定两种中心故障模式:衡量不匹配,即基准难度分布与预期难度分布不同;以及覆盖面差距,即困难轴上被揭开的区域阻碍基准发现有意义的局部培训进展。 我们提出两个诊断度量法,捕捉这两个故障模式,并提供严格的理论保证. 从经验上讲,我们利用仔细估计的项目困难,分析跨越7个领域的25个流行基准。 我们的结果显示,许多基准隐含地超重了某些困难区域,因此,应当谨慎地解释其领导板结论;另一些基准则留下了所发现的很大一部分困难轴,限制了它们监测模型改进进程的能力。 最后,我们通过引入BenchFill,将诊断转化为行动,这是一个简单的针对难度的项目重写算法,有效缩小了局部覆盖差距.

articles.title: Task-Preserving Multilingual Instruction Tuning for Open-Ended QA in WMT 2026 MIST
articles.content: This paper describes our submission to the WMT 2026 Multilingual Instruction Shared Task. We adapt Qwen3-8B with LoRA using organiser-provided data, EuroAlpaca, a multilingual instruction dataset created through task-preserving localisation, and CrossEuroAlpaca, a cross-lingual augmentation that assigns different source and target languages to instructions, contexts and responses. Our system targets open-ended question answering (QA-OEG) in ten shared-task languages represented in the auxiliary data. Under matched decoding, adaptation improves the mean Gemma-4 judge score on target-language QA-OEG by 7.8% relative to the base model. On an additional evaluation using the Aya Evaluation Suite across all shared-task languages, it yields relative gains of 41.5% in macro-averaged ROUGE-L and 2.9% in BERTScore-F1, with larger improvements in target languages. However, these gains are task- and language-specific. Gemma-4 scores improve for QA-OEG and summarisation in the target languages but decline for context-grounded QA there and across all three tasks in the non-target languages.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WMT 2026 MIST中为不限名额QA保留多种语言教学
articles.content_zh: 本文介绍了我们向 " 2026年万语教学共同任务 " 提交的报告。 我们利用组织者提供的数据对Qwen3-8B进行调用,EuroAlpaca,通过任务保存本地化创建的多语种指令数据集,以及Cross EuroAlpaca,一种跨语言的增强,它为指令,上下文和回应指定了不同的源和目标语言. 我们的系统的目标是用辅助数据所代表的10种共享任务语言回答开放式问题(QA-OEG)。 在相匹配的解码下,适应使目标语言QA-OEG的Gemma-4评分平均分比基准模型提高7.8%. 在利用Aya评价套件对所有共同任务语言进行的额外评价中,该套软件在宏观平均ROUGE-L和BERTScore-F1中分别取得了41.5%和2.9%。 然而,这些成果是具体的任务和语言。 Gemma-4的分数在QA-OEG上得到了改善,在目标语言上进行了总结,但在该地上下文的QA和在非目标语言上的所有三个任务上都下降了.

articles.title: Unintended Side Effects of Value Training in LLMs
articles.content: As LLMs are increasingly deployed in value-sensitive contexts, aligning them with human values has emerged as a post-training objective in NLP, aimed at instilling additional values and guiding model behaviour. However, current evaluations remain narrow. Because values are interconnected, it is unclear how fine-tuning for specific values alters unrelated capabilities and behaviours. In this work, we adapt four instruction-tuned LLMs across individual Hofstede's value dimensions and evaluate them on both cross-value transfer and broader behaviours. We find that value-specific training produces unintended side effects on untrained values, risk preferences, social cognition, and safety traits. Consequently, we suggest that value alignment after post-training should incorporate broader behavioral evaluations, and we highlight the need to investigate where additional value training might best fit into the pipeline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLMs 价值培训的无意副作用
articles.content_zh: 由于法学硕士越来越多地部署在对价值有敏感认识的环境中,因此将其与人类价值观相配合已成为NLP培训后的目标,旨在灌输更多价值观并指导示范行为。 然而,目前的评价仍然狭窄。 由于价值是相互关联的,因此不清楚具体价值的微调如何改变无关的能力和行为。 在这项工作中,我们调整了Hofstede个人价值层面的四个经指导调整的法学硕士课程,并评价了交叉价值转让和更广泛的行为。 我们认为,针对具体价值的培训会对未受过训练的价值观、风险偏好、社会认知和安全特征产生意外的副作用。 因此,我们建议,培训后的价值调整应纳入更广泛的行为评价,并强调需要调查哪些其他价值培训最适于进行。

articles.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Detecting Satirical Code-Mixed Sentences
articles.content: Code-switching is a natural linguistic phenomenon, yet its impact on high-level reasoning tasks remains largely unexplored in under-resourced languages like Romanian. Natural language processing tasks, such as satire detection, rely heavily on nuanced cultural and syntactic cues that large language models struggle to capture. In this paper, we investigate four methods (i.e., random replacement, phrase translation, dependency parsing, and large language models) for generating synthetic code-mixed Romanian sentences with English, German, French, and Italian. We start with an existing dataset for satire detection, compiled from Romanian news articles and annotated at the sentence level by humans, and augment it with over 600k samples, namely CS-SeLeRoSa. We provide an in-depth analysis of the dataset generation process. Then, we evaluate several multilingual large language models across zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and fine-tuning regimes on both the synthetic corpus and a human-adjudicated gold benchmark, namely CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold. While older open models suffer substantial degradation (dropping to 37%-55% macro-F1), newer models like Gemma 4 31B achieve 68.1% zero-shot, rivaling frontier models like GPT-5 mini (69.5%). Furthermore, fine-tuning significantly reduces formatting errors and improves the results, increasing Gemma 4 31B to 77.5% on CS-SeLeRoSa and 72.6% on the gold standard, outperforming frontier zero-shot baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以大语言模型为基准检测《讽刺法典》-混合判决
articles.content_zh: 代码切换是一种自然语言现象,但其对高层次推理任务的影响在罗马尼亚等资源不足的语言中仍然基本上没有得到探讨. 自然语言处理任务,如satire检测,严重地依赖于细微的文化和合成提示,即大型语言模型难以捕捉. 在本文中,我们调查了四种方法(即:随机替换、短语翻译、依赖性解析和大语言模型),用英语、德语、法语和意大利语生成合成编码混合的罗马尼亚语句。 我们首先从现有的用于萨蒂尔探测的数据集开始,该数据集由罗马尼亚新闻文章汇编,并由人类在句子层面作注释,并增加了600多克样本,即CS-SeLeRoSa. 我们深入分析数据集生成过程。 然后,我们评估了几种多语言的大型语言模型, 跨越了零镜头,思维链, 并微调了合成体和人类判断的黄金基准, 即CS-SeLeRosa-Gold。 虽然较老的开放型号出现大幅退化(降至37%-55%的宏-F1),但Gemma 4 31B等较新的型号实现了68.1%的零发,与GPT-5等前沿型号相竞争(69.5%). 此外,微调大大地减少了格式错误并改进了结果,使Gemma 4 31B在CS-SeLeRoSa和72.6%的金本位上增长到77.5%,超过了前沿零射入基线。

articles.title: Investigating the Impact of Learner Errors on Social Bias in Large Language Models
articles.content: Existing social bias benchmarks evaluate large language models mostly on fluent, well-formed English, reflecting native speaker usage and leaving non-native writers unrepresented. To address this gap, we investigate how grammatical errors by non-native writers affect social bias. We develop a controlled framework that injects common learner errors into prompts and apply it to three bias benchmarks covering stereotype alignment and demographic preference across gender, race, and religion. We find that grammatical errors increase bias, and the effect grows with the error rate. Among the four common error types we consider, preposition errors produce the largest and most consistent increase in stereotype alignment. Our analysis suggests that errors increase bias when they are more likely to interfere with comprehension. Finally, fine-tuning on erroneous texts reduces the bias increase caused by grammatical errors. Our findings show that bias evaluations based exclusively on well-formed prompts may underestimate the bias experienced by users whose English contains grammatical errors.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 调查学习者错误对大语言模式中社会偏见的影响
articles.content_zh: 现有的社会偏见基准主要以流利而成型的英语来评价大型语言模式,反映了母语的使用,使非本地作家无人任职。 为了弥补这一差距,我们调查非本土作家的语法错误如何影响社会偏见. 我们制定了一个控制框架,将共同的学习者错误注入提示,并将其应用于三个偏见基准,包括性别、种族和宗教的定型观念调整和人口偏好。 我们发现语法错误会增加偏差,效果会随出错率而增加. 在我们所考虑的四种常见错误类型中,预置错误产生的最大和最一致地增加的定型比对. 我们的分析表明,错误如果更有可能干扰理解,就会增加偏见。 最后,对错误的文本进行微调会减少由语法错误引起的偏差增加. 我们的调查结果表明,完全基于成形提示的偏见评价可能会低估英语含有语法错误的用户所经历的偏见.

articles.title: Every Part Has Its Role: Part-of-Speech Effects in LLM Post-Training
articles.content: Large language models are typically trained with next-token prediction (NTP), which rewards predicting specific tokens rather than explicitly accounting for the semantic similarities between different words or expressions. Prior work has addressed this limitation by augmenting training data with minimally varying sentences that replace a target word with conceptually related alternatives, e.g., "The tired coach ran home" $\rightarrow$ {"The tired trainer ran home", "The tired instructor ran home", ...}. Such concept augmentation improves performance, but it remains unclear whether its effectiveness depends on where in the sentence the concept is expressed. We reproduce and extend prior work $\textit{beyond nouns}$ to verbs and adjectives, asking whether the part of speech (POS) carrying the concept signal affects perplexity and downstream performance. We find different patterns across evaluation settings: concept augmentation improves perplexity most consistently on news, independent of the POS used, whereas verbs provide the most reliable downstream gains. Despite these behavioral differences, representational analyses using CKA and linear probing show that the conditions yielding the largest downstream gains are not necessarily those that most alter the model's internal representations. Together, these results suggest that the effectiveness of concept augmentation depends on where and how conceptual information is introduced during training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 每一部分都具有其作用: LLM 后培训中的部分语言效果
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型通常通过下接预测(NTP)来训练,它奖励预测具体符号,而不是明确说明不同词或表达方式之间的语义相似性. 先前的工作解决了这一限制,增加了培训数据,用最小的差别句子来取而代之的是用概念上相联的替代词来取而代之,例如"疲劳教练跑回家"($\rightarrow${"疲劳教练跑回家"),"疲劳教练跑回家"("疲劳教练跑回家"). 这种概念的增强能改善业绩,但目前仍不清楚其效力是否取决于该概念在句子中表达的地点。 我们复制和扩展了先前的工作 $\textit{超越名词}$ 到动词和形容词, 询问语言(POS)中带有概念信号的部分是否影响模糊性和下游性能 。 我们发现不同的评价环境有不同的模式:概念增强在新闻上提高了最一致的模糊性,独立于所使用的POS,而动词提供最可靠的下游收益。 尽管存在这些行为差异,使用CKA和线性测试进行的代表分析表明,产生最大下游收益的条件不一定是那些最能改变模型内部表现的条件. 这些结果表明,概念增强的有效性取决于培训期间在何处以及如何引入概念信息。

articles.title: S-EDL: Eliciting Self-Evidence from Sequence Likelihoods for Semantic Calibration of LLMs
articles.content: Calibrating large language models (LLMs) in open-ended generation is uniquely challenging because many distinct token sequences can express the same underlying meaning. Prior calibration techniques target either fixed-set classification confidence or the binary correctness of individual strings, making them inherently ill-suited for the dynamic, multi-string nature of open-ended semantic outcomes. To bridge this gap, we introduce S-EDL, a novel evidential method that natively optimizes LLMs for semantic calibration. By eliciting evidence from the sequence likelihoods of the model itself, S-EDL constructs a differentiable Dirichlet prior over prompt-specific semantic classes. Optimizing the evidential loss under this prior yields a calibration-aware training signal over variable semantic classes, completely bypassing the need for fixed multiple-choice options. Evaluations across four open-ended benchmarks and three models demonstrate that S-EDL substantially reduces semantic calibration error while improving accuracy. By aligning generative likelihoods with semantic correctness, this work establishes a framework for deploying trustworthy LLMs in complex, open-ended applications. Code is available at: https://github.com/sandylaker/s-edl.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: S-EDL:从序列的相似性中获得的关于语义校正的自我证明
articles.content_zh: 无限代中校正大型语言模型(LLMs)具有独特的挑战性,因为许多独特的符号序列可以表达出同一种基本含义. 之前的校正技术既针对固定设置的分类信心,也针对单个字符串的二进制正确性,使其本质上不适合开放式语义结果的动态多弦性质. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了S-EDL,一种新颖的证明方法,在本土优化了LLMs的语义校正. 通过从模型本身的序列可能性中取出证据,S-EDL构建了一个相异的Dirichlet,先于即时特定语义类. 优化此前作下的证据损失在可变语义课上产生校正-意识训练信号,完全绕过固定多选择选项的需要. 对四个开放式基准和三个模型的评价表明,S-EDL在提高准确性的同时会大大减少语义校正错误。 通过使基因概率与语义正确性相匹配,这项工作为在复杂而开放的应用中部署可信赖的LLM建立了框架. 代码见:https://github.com/sandylaker/s-edl.

articles.title: MemoryTax: The Bitter Lesson of Agent Memory
articles.content: Agent memory systems such as Mem0 and Zep decide what to keep before any question arrives; coding agents keep the raw history and let the model search it with its own tools. We ask whether designed memory still helps once the model is strong enough to search for itself. On one LoCoMo conversation (419 turns, 152 questions), we run four memory methods (full context, BM25, Mem0, Zep) and three coding agents (Pi, Codex, Claude Code), each with GPT-4o-mini, GPT-6 Luna and Claude Opus 5.5, and record what every rollout costs. This is a short empirical study, with one conversation and one run per cell. Agent memory is a costly patch for a weak model: Mem0 beats full context only with GPT-4o-mini, and its build alone costs more than a whole full-context rollout. Agent memory also has a ceiling, set by the model that writes it: a stronger reader does not recover what a weaker writer left out. With Claude Opus 5.5, Pi tops the cost-accuracy frontier, scoring 99% for less than half the cost of full context; its one miss is a wrong answer key. Part of that lead comes from photo captions that only the agents could read: on the 88 questions whose evidence has no photo, Pi and full context differ by one answer.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 内存Tax: 代理内存的痛苦课
articles.content_zh: Mem0和Zep等代理内存系统在任何问题到来之前决定保留什么;编码代理保存了原始历史,让模型用自己的工具来搜索. 我们问,一旦模型足够强大,可以自行搜索,设计记忆是否仍然有帮助. 在一次LoCoMo对话(419转,152个问题)上,我们运行了四个内存方法(完整上下文,BM25,Mem0,Zep)和三个编码代理(Pi,Codex,Claude Code),每个代号与GPT-4-mini,GPT-6 Luna和Claude Opus 5.5,并记录每个推出成本. 这是一个简短的经验性研究,每个细胞有一个对话和一个运行. 代理内存对于弱模型来说是一个代价高昂的补丁: Mem0只用GPT-4o-mini来打出完整的上下文,单是它的建设就比整个完整上下文的推出要花费更多. 代理记忆也有一个天花板,由写作它的模型设定:一个更强大的读者无法恢复一个更弱小的作家所遗漏的东西. 与克洛德·奥普斯5.5,Pi在成本准确度前沿上位,得分99%,不足全上下文成本的一半;其一错就是错误的答案键. 部分线索来自只有特工才能读取的照片标题:在证据没有照片的88个问题上,皮和整个上下文因一个答案而不同.

articles.title: Real PMIDs, Wrong Papers: Harness Design for Biomedical Claim-Verification Agents
articles.content: Literature-searching language agents are becoming a standard component of scientific assistants for the life sciences, yet there is little controlled evidence on which parts of their harness matter. We run a controlled ablation on biomedical claim verification (SciFact) with the live PubMed API as the only tool. Holding the backbone and output format fixed, we compare four harnesses: closed-book answering, single-shot retrieval using the claim as the query, a ReAct-style agent that writes its own PubMed queries, and an oracle given the gold abstracts, each with two efficient frontier backbones. Naive single-shot retrieval finds the gold paper for only 6% of claims and turns overconfident errors into abstentions without improving accuracy. Letting the model formulate its own queries triples gold recall and yields the best verdicts (62% accuracy vs. 49-59% for the other realistic harnesses), although these differences are not significant at our sample size and agents use fewer than half of their search budget. With gold abstracts, the same models reach 79-86% accuracy, a significant 17-24 point gap showing that retrieval, not reasoning, is the main bottleneck. Finally, a citation audit shows that closed-book models cite PubMed IDs that almost always exist (327/335) but are almost never relevant: a cross-family LLM judge rates only 3 of 327 existing citations as relevant to the claim, versus 67% for citations produced by the search agent. Existence checks are therefore insufficient safeguards for scientific agents. We release code, prompts, and all cached tool calls at https://github.com/saqlain2204/real-pmids-wrong-papers.

articles.title_zh: 真实的PMIDs,错误的论文:生物医学索赔验证剂的效用设计
articles.content_zh: 文学研究语言代理人正在成为生命科学科学助理的一个标准组成部分,但几乎没有什么可控制的证据可以证明他们掌握的哪一部分很重要。 我们用活生生的PubMed API作为唯一的工具,对生物医学权利要求进行控制性核查。 拥有固定的主干线和输出格式,我们比较了四个取景器:闭门簿回答,单发回取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 直观的一发取回只找到6%的金币,在不提高准确性的情况下,将过度自信的错误变成弃权. 让该模型自己提出三重质询,并得出最佳判断(准确度为62%,其他现实的取材机为49-59%),尽管这些差异在我们样本规模上并不显著,代理商使用的搜索预算不到一半。 有了"黄金摘要",同一种模型达到了79-86%的准确度,一个显著的17-24分差距表明取回而不是推理是主要的瓶颈. 最后,一项引用审计显示,封闭账号模型引用了几乎始终存在的PubMed身份证(327/335),但几乎永远不相关:跨家庭的LLM法官认为,现有327起引用中只有3起与索赔有关,而搜索代理商提供的引用率为67%。 因此,对科学代理人的检查不足。 我们在https://github.com/saqlain2204/real-pmids-wrong-papers发布代码、提示和所有缓存工具呼叫。

articles.title: MAPS: Macro-Adaptive Parallel Reasoning for Regulating Search Momentum in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.content: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) by retrieving external knowledge. Recently, some RAG methods interleave reasoning and retrieval, enabling LLMs to progressively generate sub-queries and retrieve external knowledge. However, these methods may suffer from redundant or ineffective sub-queries and insufficiently diverse query exploration. Moreover, due to the tightly interleaved nature of reasoning and retrieval, it remains unclear how the evolving reasoning process influences query intent. To characterize the evolution of query intent during reasoning, we introduce search momentum, which captures the accumulated retrieval tendency induced by historical changes in generated sub-queries along the reasoning trajectory. Through momentum-based analysis, we find that the query generation process tends to continuously evolve along existing retrieval trajectories. Based on this observation, we propose MAPS, a Macro-Adaptive Parallel Reasoning framework for regulating search momentum and mitigating query-intent drift. MAPS first retains the retrieved knowledge and a refined reasoning state, thereby reducing the influence of historical reasoning trajectories on subsequent sub-query generation. Subsequently, MAPS extends the conventional sequential reasoning process into a parallel reasoning paradigm. At each iteration, MAPS identifies complementary retrieval directions, generates corresponding sub-queries for parallel retrieval, and consolidates the retrieved evidence to update the knowledge and reasoning states. Experiments on six question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that MAPS consistently outperforms representative RAG methods across different backbone models. All code and resources are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/MAPS.

articles.title_zh: MAPS:在检索-增强生成中规范搜索动机的宏辅助并行理由
articles.content_zh: Retrieval-Augmented Crowth(RAG)通过取回外部知识来提高大语言模型(LLM)的性能. 最近,一些RAG方法互出推理和取回,使LLMs逐渐生成子克并取回外部知识. 然而,这些方法可能因多余或无效的分水管和不够多样化的查询探索而受到影响. 此外,由于推理和检索的紧密互不关联的性质,演变中的推理过程如何影响查询意图仍然不清楚. 为了描述推理过程中查询意向的演变,我们引入了搜索动力,它捕捉了推理轨迹上生成的子序列的历史变化所引发的累积检索趋势. 通过以动力为基础的分析,我们发现,查询生成过程往往会沿着现有的检索轨迹不断演变. 基于这一看法,我们提议将MAPS作为控制搜索势头和缓解查询-心跳漂移的宏观辅助并行理性框架。 MAPS首先保留了被检索的知识和精细的推理状态,从而减少了历史推理轨迹对后生子克来电的影响. 随后,MAPS将传统的相继推理过程扩展为平行推理范式. 在每次迭代时,MAPS都会确定互补的取回方向,生成相应的子克来进行平行取回,并整合取回的证据来更新知识和推理状态. 对6个答题基准的实验表明,MAPS在不同的主干模型中一贯优于有代表性的RAG方法. 所有代码和资源均可在https://github.com/NEUIR/MAPS查阅。

articles.title: Where Do LLMs Learn to Recommend AI?
articles.content: Asked what to study, which career to pursue, or what product to build, large language models (LLMs) often recommend AI-related options. We ask where this tendency comes from by comparing models before and after fine-tuning and by varying how questions are asked. First, pretrained models already include explicit AI/ML terms in the recommendations of 27% of their responses, and their released instruction-tuned versions do so in 59%. Second, fine-tuning models ourselves shows that this rise is not inevitable: general instruction tuning leaves the rate unchanged, but removing the 7% of instruction examples that concern AI cuts it by 14 percentage points, below the level of the pretrained models it starts from. Data rewarding helpfulness raise it by 9 points, while data ranked by the preferences of diverse simulated users lower it by 9. Finally, with models held fixed, asking for the "best" option or for what to do "right now" raises the rate by 8 and 18 points, whereas telling the model it is an AI advisor adds 4. Overall, the tendency starts in pretraining, and what models learn afterward, together with how a question is phrased, decides how strongly it appears.

articles.title_zh: LLMs在哪里学会推荐AI?
articles.content_zh: 被问到要学习什么,要追求什么职业,或者要构建什么产品,大型语言模型(LLM)经常推荐AI相关的选项. 我们通过在微调前后比较模型和通过提出不同问题的方式,询问这种趋势从何而来。 首先,经过预先培训的模型已经在27%的答复的建议中包括了明确的AI/ML术语,其发布的指令调整版本则以59%的方式这样做。 第二,微调模型本身表明这种上升并非不可避免的:一般的指令调取率不变,但删除了7%的涉及AI的指令示例将其削减了14个百分点,低于它从预训模型开始的水平. 奖励帮助性的数据将它提升了9分,而数据则根据不同模拟用户的偏好排名将它降低9分. 最后,模型被固定,要求“最佳”选项或“现在”做什么,将费率提高了8分和18分,而模型告诉模型是AI顾问补充说: 4. 总体而言,趋势始于预训,之后哪些模式学习,以及一个问题如何表述,决定了它的出现程度。

articles.title: Evolving with Open Worlds: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Future Forecasting
articles.content: Most contemporary artificial intelligence (AI) systems are released with frozen parameters and improve through external updates, whereas an ideal system would keep improving from its own experience, a capacity we call recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet studying RSI requires an environment that is continuously changing, objectively verifiable, and naturally grounded, posing a fundamental challenge for agent evolution. Here we introduce DeepEvolve, a sustainable evolution agent system grounded in future event prediction, in which agents continuously interact with a dynamically evolving environment and improve by internalizing and externalizing the experience gained through these interactions. A living environment synthesizes verifiable tasks, and a recursive-evolution engine turns the reasoning trajectory behind each prediction back into capability: decoupling search from prediction adapts parameter-level evolution to the contamination-prone live environment, while distilling reusable skills lets the agent evolve from the limited live trajectories such an environment affords. On the external FutureX leaderboard, which evaluates predictions against real-world outcomes and is updated weekly, our self-improved forecaster ranked first across all systems over three consecutive weeks, achieving up to a 195% improvement in rating. On our synthesized evaluation, it ranked among the top three across four base LLMs, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 10.7 Bradley--Terry points. More broadly, these results suggest that a system built for self-improvement is best understood as an agent that co-evolves with a genuinely living, open-ended environment, pointing to a shift in AI from training static models on fixed data toward cultivating agents that grow stronger from their own experience, with such an open world as the indispensable basis of that growth.

articles.title_zh: 与开放世界一起发展:走向未来预测的递减自我改善
articles.content_zh: 多数当代人工智能(AI)系统都以被冻结的参数发布,并通过外部更新得到改进,而理想的系统则会不断从自身经验中改进,我们称之为递归自改进(RSI)的能力. 然而,研究RSI需要一种不断改变、客观可核查和自然基础的环境,对代理人演化构成根本挑战。 在这里,我们引入了DeepEvolve,这是一种基于未来事件预测的可持续演化剂系统,其中物剂不断与动态变化的环境相互作用,并通过将这些相互作用所取得的经验内部化和外部化来改进。 一个活的环境综合了可核查的任务,一个递归式进取引擎将每个预测背后的推理轨迹回向能力:将搜索与预测脱钩,使参数级演化适应易被污染活的环境,而分馏可再利用的技能则让剂从这种环境提供的有限活的轨迹进取出. 在外部FutureX领导板上,它根据现实世界的结果来评价预测,每周更新一次,我们自我改进的预测器连续三周在所有系统中排名第一,在评分上达到195%的提高. 在我们的综合评价中,它排名前三位,分四个基础法学硕士,表现优于最强基线,最高可达10.7个布拉德利-特里分. 更广义地说,这些结果表明,为自我改善而建立的系统最好被理解为一种具有真正活泼、开放环境的共同发展动力,指出AI从固定数据方面的静态模型培训转向培养从自身经验发展而来、以开放世界为增长不可或缺的基础的代理人。

articles.title: ALIAS: Evaluating Performance and Memorization in LLM-Written TLA+ Specifications
articles.content: Memorization inflates the benchmark scores of large language models (LLMs), since a model can reproduce answers it saw in training. Researchers test for it with consistent identifier renaming (CIR), which gives every identifier in a task a new name, and treat a lower score on the renamed task as evidence of recall. We test this method on the Temporal Logic of Actions Plus (TLA+) language, whose model checker acts as an oracle by confirming whether a renamed task preserves the exact behaviors of the original. Across 111 TLA+-Bench tasks, renaming lowers the correctness of Claude Opus 4.8 from 28% to 18% and of GPT-5 from 9% to 7%. Most of this decrease comes from how the test grades, which requires exact names that most descriptions never state. Grading by behavior shrinks the decrease to about 3 percentage points for Opus 4.8 and to 0 for GPT-5. In two model families fine-tuned on disjoint halves of the tasks, renaming removes about half of the training gain in likelihood and costs 4.9 percentage points (Qwen) and 1.3 percentage points (Gemma) on unseen tasks. A lower score after renaming therefore mixes memorization, name-based grading, and the cost of new names.

articles.title_zh: ALIAS:在LLM-Written TLA+规格中评价性能和记忆
articles.content_zh: 记分法夸大了大型语言模型(LLM)的基准分数,因为一个模型可以复制它在训练中看到的答案. 研究人员用一致的标识符重命名(CIR)对其进行测试,使任务中的每个标识符都有一个新名称,并将重命名任务上较低的分数作为召回的证据. 我们在动作加号(TLA+)语言上测试这种方法,其模型检查器通过确认被重新命名的任务是否保留了原作的准确行为而起到神谕的作用. 在111个TRA+-Bench任务中,更名将克劳德·奥普斯4.8的正确性从28%降低到18%,将GPT-5的正确性从9%降低到7%. 这种下降大多出自测试分数的方式,这需要大多数描述从未说明的准确名字. 行为递减使Opus 4.8的下降幅度缩小到约3个百分点,而GPT-5的下降幅度为0个百分点. 在两个模范家庭内,对一半的任务进行了微调,重新命名可能使大约一半的培训收益被取消,在未见任务上花费了4.9个百分点(Quen)和1.3个百分点(Gemma)。 因此,重新命名后的分数较低,会混合记忆、基于名称的分数和新名称的成本。

articles.title: Bridging Foundational and Agentic Capabilities of LLMs
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents, yet it remains unclear how their foundational capabilities translate into agentic capabilities. End-to-end scores leave unresolved whether low benchmark capability or weak deployment drives a failure, limiting actionable diagnosis. We bridge foundational and agentic capabilities through an operation-level measurement framework. We represent each model with a foundational profile derived from capability benchmarks and an operation profile derived from interaction trajectories, and define capability realization gaps as deviations of observed operation performance from predictions based on foundational capabilities. Experiments on fifteen model services in $τ^2$-Bench show that foundational profiles only partially predict agentic operations. Models with comparable profiles can differ substantially in execution, and these gaps remain consistent across task subsets. Operation profiles add information and substantially improve task-score prediction. The framework locates execution departures at the operation level to inform model development and agent evaluation. We will release our code and analysis artifacts.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 法学硕士的基础能力和代理能力
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地被部署为代理,但目前仍不清楚其基础能力如何转化为代理能力。 端到端的分数使基准能力低或部署能力弱都无法解决,这限制了可采取行动的诊断。 我们通过行动一级计量框架,将基础能力和动力能力相接。 我们代表每个模型,其基础剖面取自能力基准,而操作剖面取自相互作用轨迹,并将能力实现差距定义为观测到的操作性能从基于基础能力的预测中偏差. 对15个模型服务的实验(以美元为单位)表明,基础剖面只部分预测了代理操作。 具有可比较特征的模型在执行上可能有很大不同,这些差距在任务子集之间仍然一致。 行动概况增加了信息并大大改进了任务分数预测。 该框架将执行离境定位在业务一级,为模型开发和代理评价提供信息。 我们将公布我们的密码和分析文物。

articles.title: Accept or Repair: Preserving Passage-Supported Answers in Contrastive Decoding
articles.content: Large language models often answer from knowledge learned during training, even when a provided passage contradicts that knowledge. To address this problem, contrastive decoding contrasts the predictions under the full and a modified prompt at every token, but it also alters correct answers that the passage supports. We show that checking answers against the passage removes this trade-off. Based on this observation, we propose Accept-or-Repair (AoR), a training-free procedure. AoR keeps a sampled answer if the passage supports it. Otherwise, it tries up to two replacements with contrastive decoding, returning one as soon as it passes this check. It rejects replacements that repeat the answer generated without the passage when the passage favors another answer. Our experiments show that AoR raises the score over sampling by 12.5 points on counterfactual passages and 2.3 on ordinary ones, surpassing eight contrastive and prompting baselines on both, including when each receives the same rejection rule. Replacing only initial answers that the passage does not support improves the average score of every decoder. These results suggest that models can follow passages that contradict their knowledge while preserving accuracy on passages that agree with it. Code will be released at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/AoR.

articles.title_zh: 接受或修复:在相矛盾的解码中保留通过支持的答案
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型往往从培训期间学到的知识中解答,即使提供的段落与该知识相矛盾。 为了解决这个问题,对比性解码对比了满文下的预测和每个符号上被修改的快取,但也改变了段落所支持的正确答案. 我们显示,通过检查答案可以消除这种取舍。 基于这一看法,我们提议采用 " 接受或重新接受 " (AorR)这一免培训的程序。 如果通道支持, AoR 保留一个抽样答案 。 否则,它会尝试最多两个用对比解码的替换,一旦通过这个检查就返回一个. 它拒绝在通过偏爱另一个答案时重复未通过生成的答案的替换. 我们的实验表明,AoR比采样提高了反事实通道的12.5分和普通通道的2.3分,超过了两者的8个反差和提示性基线,包括每个都得到相同的拒绝规则。 取而代之的只是最初的回答,即通过不支持,可以提高每个解码器的平均分. 这些结果表明,模型可以遵循与其知识相矛盾的段落,同时保留与其一致的段落的准确性. 守则将在https://github.com/js-lee-AI/AoR发布。

articles.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
articles.content: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external knowledge. Modern pipelines combine embedding, chunking, retrieval, reranking, query augmentation, context compression, and agentic verification, yet these techniques are typically evaluated one at a time. It remains unclear whether their isolated gains survive composition, whether retrieval quality and answer faithfulness favor the same design choices, and whether conclusions from small corpora hold at large scale. We pre-declare three hypotheses and introduce LASAGNA, an open-source framework for controlled RAG evaluation. We test 450 configurations across eight benchmarks and corpora ranging from 5K to 200K documents. Three findings emerge. First, individually strong techniques from different phases of a RAG pipeline do not necessarily compose: three retrieval techniques predict a +47% combined improvement but deliver only +17% when used together. Second, component gains stack differently for retrieval and faithfulness, and optimizing one can hurt the other. Third, the best composition changes as the corpus grows: the combination that wins on a small corpus may not remain best at large scale. These findings show that gains measured in isolation are not reliable predictors of realistic performance, and that new RAG techniques should be tested with the full surrounding stack. We call on researchers to do so and supply LASAGNA to simplify these experiments.

articles.title_zh: 检索增生构成
articles.content_zh: 检索增强生成(RAG)将大型语言模型作为外部知识的基础. 现代管道结合了嵌入,分块,取回,再排位,查询增强,上下文压缩,和代理验证,然而这些技术通常一次被评价一次. 仍然不清楚的是,它们的孤立收益是否在组成中存活下来,检索质量和回答忠诚度是否倾向于相同的设计选择,以及小公司的结论是否具有大规模。 我们预先宣布了三个假设,并引入了LASAGNA,一个用于控制下RAG评价的开源框架. 我们通过8个基准测试450个配置,以及5K至200K文件。 得出了三个结论。 第一,来自RAG管道不同阶段的个别强能技术不一定构成:三种检索技术预测一个+47%的综合改进,但在一起使用时只提供+17%。 第二,组件增益堆栈不同,用于取回和取信,优化一个可以伤害另一个. 第三,随着实体的增多,最佳的构成发生变化:在小实体上取胜的组合可能无法保持大规模的最佳组合。 这些调查结果表明,孤立地测量的增益并不是对现实性能的可靠预测,新的RAG技术应该用完整的周边堆栈进行测试. 我们呼吁研究人员这样做,并提供LASAGNA来简化这些实验.

articles.title: Scaling Multilingual Pretraining of Pixel Language Models
articles.content: Pixel language models process text as rendered images instead of a finite vocabulary, which gives them strong cross-lingual transfer abilities. However, not much is known about how these abilities are influenced by larger-scale pretraining. In this paper, we train a family of MPIXEL models along three axes of variation: more languages, more scripts, and larger model capacity under fixed per-language compute. In evaluations on five tasks covering 83 languages, we find that scaling acts locally: each axis improves the added languages and scripts, while increased capacity mitigates the curse of multilinguality from pretraining on more languages. Transfer to unseen scripts improves with multilingual pretraining, but does not further improve with scaling. On typologically distant low-resource languages, our models outperform subword and character-level baselines across many writing systems. We also show that larger pixel models reserve more layers for visual processing, and that cross-lingual alignment weakens as more languages are added. Overall, our findings characterize how multilingual scaling improves pixel language models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 放大多种语言 像素语言模型的预训
articles.content_zh: 像素语言模型处理文本,作为渲染图像,而不是一个有限度的词汇,这使得它们具有强大的跨语言传输能力. 然而,对于这些能力如何受到大规模预训的影响,人们所知不多. 在本文中,我们沿着三个变异轴来训练一族的MPIXEL模型:语言多,脚本多,在固定的每个语言计算下,模型容量多. 在评价涉及83种语言的5个任务时,我们发现,地方的分级行动:每个轴线都改进所增加的语文和脚本,而增加的能力则减轻了多语种的诅咒,即对更多语言进行预训。 转会到看不见的脚本会通过多语种预训来改进,但不会随着缩放而得到进一步改善. 在类型学上遥远的低资源语言上,我们的模型超越了许多写作系统的子词和字符级基线. 我们还表明,更大的像素模型为视觉处理预留了更多的地层,而随着更多的语言被添加,交叉语言对接会减弱. 总体而言,我们的调查结果说明了多语种比例如何改进像素语言模型。

articles.title: Uni-Mem: Learning a Long-Horizon Agentic Memory Manager with Unified Online Policy Optimization
articles.content: Long-term agent memory is shifting from predefined workflows toward learnable policies for memory construction and retrieval. Existing learning-based methods either optimize construction alone or combine retrieval-side online reinforcement learning (RL) with offline construction supervision, limiting co-adaptation between the two stages. In this paper, we explore end-to-end online RL for a unified memory manager (Uni-Mem) that learns both capabilities under a shared policy. However, joint optimization with existing RL algorithms such as GRPO faces confounded group comparisons and sparse feedback over long memory-management trajectories. To this end, we propose Stage-Decoupled GRPO, which alternates construction and retrieval optimization while controlling variation from the other stage within each rollout group, yielding stage-specific learning signals. We further introduce Event-Wise Credit Assignment (ECA), which localizes feedback to responsible events and propagates event-level advantages to their constituent operations. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show that Uni-Mem outperforms the strongest RL-based memory, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly learning memory construction and retrieval via Stage-Decoupled GRPO and ECA.

articles.title_zh: Uni-Mem:学习有统一在线政策优化功能的长视野代理内存管理器
articles.content_zh: 长期代理内存正在从预先确定的工作流程转向可学习的内存构建和检索政策. 现有的以学习为主的方法要么单独优化建设,要么将检索-侧式在线强化学习(RL)与线下建设监理相结合,限制了两个阶段之间的协同适应. 在本文中,我们探索端到端的在线RL为统一内存管理器(Uni-Mem),通过共享政策学习两种能力. 然而,与GRPO等现有的RL算法进行联合优化时,会面临群体比较的混乱和对长期内存管理轨迹的微弱反馈. 为此,我们提议采用 " 阶段十进制GRPO " ,它取代了构建和检索优化,同时控制每个推出组内另一个阶段的变异,产生不同阶段的学习信号。 我们还引入了事件-Wise信贷转让(ECA),它将对负责任的事件的反馈本地化,并将事件层面的好处传播给其组成业务。 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验显示,Uni-Mem比最强的基于RL的内存表现得更好,表明通过Stage-Decouppleed GRPO和ECA共同学习内存构建和取回的有效性.

articles.title: Conflicted Records: Typed Adversarial Contracts for Auditable LLM Output Quality Enforcement
articles.content: LLM-generated records increasingly populate production information systems where they are treated as data assets subject to the same quality expectations as records from operational databases. A single such record can simultaneously satisfy and violate a quality rule: a grounded fact adjacent to a hallucination, a useful answer adjacent to a stereotype. Classical data cleaning cannot resolve this because the two judgments are incompatible over the same span; a single LLM judge cannot either, since it shares the training biases that produced the conflict. Existing interventions such as prompt engineering, chain-of-thought, and RLHF reduce surface error rates but provide no audit trail and cannot distinguish genuine remediation from blanket suppression. The question is whether a deterministic check over structured inter-agent records can catch the defects that referential checks alone miss. We present BiasGuard-D: two adversarial roles drawn from distinct model families exchange typed claim documents, a three-model quorum adjudicates by majority vote, and a combined referential-plus-semantic invariant validates the verdict. The semantic component fires on verdicts referential checks miss; removing the iterative loop drops invariant satisfaction sharply. The deliberation layer transfers from stereotype to hallucination remediation on HaluEval QA with only role-framing changes, raising right-answer recovery by 49 percentage points; the triage gate required a cross-family second auditor to maintain recall on objective hallucination. Every claim, vote, and instruction is stored as a typed record giving operators a provenance trail auditable under emerging AI regulations.

articles.title_zh: 相冲突记录:可审计 LLM 的横向合同类型 产出质量执法
articles.content_zh: LLM生成的记录越来越多地包含生产信息系统,在这些系统中,这些记录被视为数据资产,其质量预期与业务数据库的记录相同。 单一的这种记录可以同时满足和违反质量规则:一个与幻觉相相邻的有根据的事实,一个与一成不变相邻的有用答案. 古典数据清理不能解决这一点,因为两个判决在同一期间不相容;一个LLM法官也不能解决,因为它分担造成冲突的培训偏见。 诸如即时工程、思维链和RLHF等现有干预措施降低了地表误差率,但没有审计线索,无法将真正的补救与全面压制区分开来。 问题是,对结构化的特工间记录进行确定性检查能否弥补特惠检查本身遗漏的缺陷。 我们提出BiasGuard-D:从不同的模范家庭交换打字的索赔文件中抽取出两个对抗性角色,三种模式的法定人数通过多数表决来裁定,以及一种特惠-加-语义上的不一致的组合来验证判决。 语义元件向判决起火 特惠检查失败;去除迭接回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回 考虑层在HaluEval QA上从陈规定型观念转移到了幻觉补救,只有角色花纹变化,将正确答案的恢复提升了49个百分点;分解门要求跨家庭第二审计师在客观幻觉上保持召回. 每项主张、投票和指示都作为打字记录储存,使操作人员能够根据新兴的AI条例进行出处跟踪审计。

articles.title: SPARE: Sparsity Allocation via Routing Entropy for Efficient MoEs
articles.content: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model capacity efficiently, yet their substantial memory footprint poses a major barrier to deployment. Expert pruning reduces this footprint, but most methods focus on which experts to remove and prune every layer equally. We propose SPARE (Sparsity Allocation via Routing Entropy), a training-free, selector-agnostic method that decides how many experts to remove from each layer using routing entropy, the entropy of tokens' normalized Top-K gate weights on calibration data. When a token's gate weight is spread evenly, removing one active expert discards little of it, so SPARE prunes layers with more diffuse routing more aggressively. A perturbation bound under random pruning formalizes this intuition, and controlled interventions with a fixed selector link concentrated routing to larger output changes. With the same selector and budget, SPARE improves average accuracy over uniform allocation on Mixtral, Qwen3, and DeepSeek models, especially at high pruning ratios. At 50% expert pruning, it raises the eight-task average of Qwen3-30B-A3B from 57.2% to 63.8%, and the math, code, and science average of DeepSeek-R1 from 80.1 to 82.8.

articles.title_zh: SPARE: 为高效的教育部通过游走环境进行比例分配
articles.content_zh: Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)架构高效地规模模型容量,然而其实质性的内存足迹对部署构成重大障碍. 专家钻探可以减少这种足迹,但大多数方法都侧重于专家如何同样去除和推倒每一层。 我们提出SPARE(通过Routing Entropy进行平分分配),这是一种无训练的,选择性的,不可知的方法,它决定使用路由式的 en来从每层清除出多少专家,即信使正常化的上-K门在校正数据上的权重. 当一个信使的门重量分布均匀时,去掉一个活跃的专家弃置的几分,所以SPARE用更分散的路由来推倒多层. 由随机冲压所束缚的扰动使这种直觉正式化,用固定的选取器连接的可控干预集中通向更大的输出变化. SPARE使用相同的选取器和预算,比Mixtral,Qune3和DeepSeek模型的统一分配提高了平均准确度,特别是在高出跑率的情况下. 专家出行率达到50%,将"Qune3-30B-A3B"的8个任务平均值从57.2%提高到了63.8%,将"DeepSeek-R1"的数学,代码和科学平均值从80.1%提高到了82.8%.

articles.title: Effects of Model Scale and Quantization on Social Bias and Abstention in Question Answering
articles.content: The deployment of small and quantized language models in resource-constrained settings raises an important fairness question: when a compressed model produces fewer biased responses, does this reflect fairer behavior or greater abstention? We study this problem in Question Answering (QA) using the BBQ benchmark across multiple model sizes and quantization settings from Qwen3, Gemma-3, and SmolLM2. We also examine whether the observed trends remain stable across alternative prompt formulations and when the ``Unknown'' option is removed in a forced-choice setting. Our results show that larger models achieved higher QA accuracy, but bias showed no simple scaling trend and quantization effects varied across configurations. Notably, 20 of the 26 configurations with fewer biased responses also show increased over-abstention, indicating that lower observed bias can partly reflect greater abstention. These findings show that lower observed bias can partly reflect greater abstention, and that fairness evaluation should consider biased responses, abstention, prompt formulation, and answer-option design jointly.

articles.title_zh: 模型规模和量化对社会偏见的影响和在回答问题时置之不理
articles.content_zh: 在资源受限的环境下部署小而量化的语言模型,提出了一个重要的公平性问题:当被压缩的模型产生较少的有偏见的响应时,这是否反映了更公平的行为还是更大的弃权? 我们在问答(QA)中研究这个问题,使用来自Qune3,Gemma-3和SmolLM2的多个模型大小和定量设置的BBQ基准. 我们还审查所观察到的趋势是否在替代的迅速表述中保持稳定,以及当“未知的”选择在强迫选择的情况下被取消时。 我们的结果显示,更大的模型实现了更高的质量保证精度,但偏差没有表现出简单的缩放趋势,而量化效应因配置而异. 值得注意的是,26个组合中,有20个组合的偏颇反应较少,也显示过度参与的情况有所增加,表明观察到的偏差较低,部分反映了弃权率较高。 这些调查结果表明,所观察到的较低偏差可部分反映更大的弃权,公平评价应考虑有偏颇的反应、弃权、迅速拟订和共同的答案选择方案设计。

articles.title: LLMs as survey respondents: Comparison to simple semantic baselines
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) have been explored as surrogates for human survey respondents. A more promising application is data augmentation, where LLMs predict new responses from partial human data. However, the semantic similarity between questionnaire items is a known source of correlation between answers. It is thus unclear whether LLMs actually infer meaningful relationships between question-response pairs, or use surface-level comparison between questions as a heuristic. To assess this, we evaluated how three LLMs can predict responses to held-out items in two surveys measuring attitudes toward automated or light-electric vehicles, based on varying proportions of known responses. Performance was compared to two baselines, where new responses were derived by maximizing embedding-similarity to a prior response. While LLMs mostly predicted human responses better than baselines, their performance consistently declined with a lower share of known responses, even aligning with the baseline in one survey. Our results show that LLMs' capacities for augmenting replies varied across surveys, and can revert to the same levels as simpler embedding similarity baselines when less data is available.

articles.title_zh: 作为调查对象的法学硕士: 与简单的语义基线的比较
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)作为人类调查受访者的代词被探索. 一个更有希望的应用是数据增强,其中LLMs预测从部分人类数据得到新的响应. 然而,调查表项目之间的语义相似性是已知的答案之间相互关系的来源. 因此,目前还不清楚的是,LLMs是实际推断出问题-答复对之间有意义的关系,还是将问题之间的表面水平比较作为高压。 为了评估这一点,我们评价了三个有限责任公司如何根据已知答复的不同比例,在两次调查中预测对搁置项目的反应,这些调查是根据对自动化或轻电车辆的态度进行的。 业绩被比作两个基线,即通过尽可能扩大先前反应的同质性得出新的反应。 虽然有限责任公司大多预测人类答复比基线好,但其业绩却持续下降,已知答复所占比例较低,甚至与一项调查的基线一致。 我们的结果表明,各调查中地方政府加强答复的能力各不相同,在数据较少时,可以恢复到简单嵌入类似基线的水平。

articles.title: Overview of CHIP 2026 Shared Task 1: Patient-Specific Phenotype Concept Recognition in Full-Text Biomedical Literature
articles.content: Automatic phenotype information extraction plays an important role in rare disease diagnosis, genotype-phenotype analysis, and precision medicine. However, accurately identifying phenotype concepts and determining their associations with specific patients remain challenging, particularly in full-text biomedical articles involving multiple patients and complex clinical descriptions. This paper presents an overview of CHIP 2026 Shared Task 1, which aims to promote the development of methods for patient-specific phenotype concept recognition from full-text biomedical literature. The task consists of two subtasks: full-text phenotype concept recognition and patient-specific phenotype association. For this evaluation, we used 200 annotated full-text biomedical articles from the PatientPheX dataset, containing 506 patients, 15,193 phenotype mentions, and 5,656 patient-phenotype associations. A total of 455 teams registered for the competition, with 189 and 103 valid submissions received on the Phase A and Phase B leaderboards, respectively. The best-performing system achieved an overall score of 0.7389 on the final test set, outperforming the baseline by 8.37 percentage points. The top-performing teams explored diverse approaches combining biomedical language models, large language models (LLMs), and ensemble strategies. The evaluation results highlight both the potential of these approaches and the remaining challenges in patient attribution and phenotype normalization from full-text biomedical literature. The post-evaluation phase remains open at https://tianchi.aliyun.com/competition/entrance/532512.

articles.title_zh: CHIP 2026概览. 共同任务1:在全Text生物医学文献中识别患者——特定类型概念
articles.content_zh: 自动苯基信息提取在稀有疾病诊断,基因型-苯基分析,精密医学中起重要作用. 然而,准确确定苯型概念和确定其与特定病人的联系仍然具有挑战性,特别是在涉及多个病人的全文生物医学文章和复杂的临床描述中。 本文概述了CHIP 2026"共享任务一",该任务旨在促进从全文生物医学文献中制定针对患者的苯基概念识别方法. 任务由两个子任务组成:全文phenotype概念识别和患者特有phenotype关联. 在本次评估中,我们使用了来自PatientPhEX数据集的200个注解全文生物医学文章,其中包含506个病人,15,193个phanotype提及,以及5,656个患者-phenotype协会. 共有455支参赛队伍报名参赛,A阶段和B阶段领跑板分别收到189和103份有效出场. 在最终测试中,业绩最佳的系统取得了0.7389的总分,比基准高8.37个百分点。 成绩最好的团队探索了将生物医学语言模型、大型语言模型和综艺战略结合起来的各种办法。 评价结果突出了这些方法的潜力,以及从全文生物医学文献看在病人的归属和酚类正常化方面仍然存在的挑战。 后评价阶段仍在https://tianchi.aliyun.com/competition/entrance/532512上开放。

articles.title: A Diagnostic Study of Faithfulness in Diffusion Language Models for Table-to-Text Generation
articles.content: Diffusion language models generate by iteratively denoising a masked sequence under bidirectional attention, without the strict left-to-right commitment of autoregressive decoding. Whether this difference affects how reliably they remain grounded in structured inputs is largely unexplored. We study this question in table-to-text generation using ToTTo, where highlighted source cells make factual grounding directly testable. We compare the masked diffusion models MDLM and LLaDA with GPT-2 and GPT-Neo under an identical retrieval-based few-shot protocol, together with a QLoRA-adapted LLaDA, and we score reference similarity and source grounding as separate axes. The two pull apart. Within LLaDA, additional demonstrations raise BLEU from 11.3 to 22.0 while NLI entailment against the source table falls from 0.78 to 0.52; QLoRA reaches the best BLEU of the study, 24.15, and grounds no better for it. Manual annotation shows the failure modes differ in kind: the autoregressive baselines tend to wander off the table, while LLaDA-based models more often stay on topic and swap out individual entities. Reference-based metrics alone are insufficient to assess faithfulness in table-to-text generation.

articles.title_zh: 表格到文本生成的传播语言模型中的忠诚性诊断研究
articles.content_zh: 在双向关注下通过迭代去除被遮掩的序列来产生分化语言模型,而无需严格地从左到右地承诺自旋分解. 这一差别是否影响到它们在多大程度上仍然以结构化的投入为基础,这一点基本上没有得到探讨。 我们用TOTTo在表格到文本生成中研究这个问题,其中突出的源细胞使事实可以直接验证。 我们根据一个相同的基于回取的数发协议,将蒙面扩散模型MDLM和LLaDA与GPT-2和GPT-Neo进行对比,加上一个由QLORA适应的LLaDA,我们得分参照相似性和源地基作为独立的轴. 二者相去相去来. 在LLaDA内,其他示威活动将BLEU从11.3提高到22.0,而NLI对源表的影响从0.78下降到了0.52;QLORA达到了研究中最好的BLEU,24.15,而且没有更好的依据。 手动注释显示故障模式在实物上有所不同:自旋基线往往会从表格上走出,而基于LLaDA的模型则更经常地停留在话题上并互换出单个实体. 仅基于参考的衡量标准不足以评估表格到文本生成中的忠诚度。

articles.title: WRDO: Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization in Aligned Language Models
articles.content: Aligned large language models are trained to comply with benign requests while refusing harmful ones. However, recent work shows that this refusal behavior is fragile and can often be disrupted by simple activation- or weight-space interventions. In particular, refusal has been shown to be largely mediated by a single residual-stream direction, typically computed as a difference-of-means vector between harmful and harmless prompts. However, this standard construction aggregates heterogeneous harmful prompts into one uniform average, potentially conflating distinct refusal-related phenomena. In this work, we study whether refusal interventions can be strengthened by learning how to combine prompt-specific refusal directions. We propose Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization (WRDO), a procedure that constructs a composite refusal direction from a bank of per-prompt directions using learned aggregation weights. This approach allows different harmful prompts to contribute unequally to the final intervention direction. We evaluate WRDO against prior single-direction methods on three open-weight language models using three guard judges and HarmBench as an external evaluator. We further measure the effect of the intervention on general model capability through standard utility benchmarks. Finally, we investigate a defense-oriented setting in which the same optimization machinery is used in reverse to restore refusal behavior in an abliterated model checkpoint. Our results show that weighted aggregation provides a more effective and flexible mechanism for manipulating refusal representations.

articles.title_zh: WRDO:对齐语言模型中的加权拒绝方向优化
articles.content_zh: 相适应的大型语言模型在拒绝有害要求的同时,接受培训,以适应良性要求。 然而,近期的研究表明,这种拒绝行为是脆弱的,经常会被简单的激活-或重空干预所打乱. 特别是,拒绝主要通过单一的残余流取向进行调解,这种取向通常被计算为有害和无害的诱因之间的一种不同手段。 然而,这一标准构建将各种有害因素汇总为一个统一的平均值,有可能使与拒绝有关的不同现象相提并论。 在这项工作中,我们研究是否可以通过学习如何结合迅速具体拒绝指示来加强拒绝干预。 我们建议采用加权拒绝方向优化(WRDO)这一程序,利用学到的汇总权重,从每个瞬间方向库中构建一个综合拒绝方向。 这种办法允许不同的有害因素对最后干预方向作出不平等的贡献。 我们利用三名警卫法官和Harm Bench作为外部评价员,对照三个开放量级语言模型的先前单一方向方法来评价妇女权利观察。 我们通过标准公用事业基准,进一步衡量干预措施对一般模型能力的影响。 最后,我们调查一个面向防御的设置,在这个设置中,同样的优化机械被反向地用于恢复被盲目的模型检查站的拒绝行为. 我们的结果显示,加权汇总为操纵拒绝陈述提供了更有效和灵活的机制。

articles.title: PACE: Periodic and Channel-Aligned Encoding of Four-Bit Recurrent States
articles.content: Linear-attention language models keep their context in a recurrent state of fixed size, where an inference system stores one copy of this state for every sequence it decodes at the same time. Storing the state at lower precision therefore lets more sequences share an accelerator. Existing state quantizers round the state after every generated token and report that four bits lose accuracy unless the bit width is raised or the model is fine-tuned.\par We introduce PACE, a post-hoc four-bit state quantizer. PACE rounds the state only once every few generated tokens, as chunked kernels already do once per chunk during prefill, and keeps the tokens generated in between in a small buffer. Rounding less often reduces the error that accumulates in the state. Additionally, we find that the large entries of the gated-delta state gather in columns, because some channels of the update written at each token remain large across many tokens. PACE therefore shares each quantization scale within one column. It also keeps the heads that retain rounding error longest at eight bits. On four hybrid models from 4B to 35B parameters, PACE with mixed four- and eight-bit heads is competitive with eight-bit DAMP on the three larger models at about two thirds of its memory, PACE with four-bit heads throughout scores higher than Q-Mamba at equal memory, and rounding every few tokens preserves the decoding speedup of the buffer.

articles.title_zh: PACE: 四比特经常国家的定期和海峡统一编码
articles.content_zh: 线性注意语言模型将其上下文保存在固定大小的反复出现状态下,一个推论系统为它同时解码的每个序列存储了该状态的一个副本. 因此,以更低的精度来保存状态,让更多的序列共享加速器. 在每个生成的令牌后, 现有的状态量子绕整个状态, 并报告四个比特失去准确性, 除非提高比特宽度或调整模型 。\ par 我们介绍PACE,一个后HOC四位态的分量器。 PACE 只在每一个数个生成的令牌中弹出一次,因为块内核在预填时已经每块一次,并且将生成的令牌保存在一个小缓冲器中. 四舍五入少常能减少在状态下累积的错误. 此外,我们发现,大门-德尔塔州的大量条目聚集在柱子上,因为在每个地标上所写的一些更新渠道在许多地标上仍然很大. 因此,计算机设备行动伙伴关系在一栏内分担每个量化尺度。 也使保留四舍五入误差最长为八位数的头. 在从4B到35B参数的4个混合型号上,混合4位和8位头的PACE在其内存约三分之二的3个较大型号上与8位DAMP相竞争,PACE的4位头在全分上比Q-曼巴在等同的内存高,并四舍五入每个数个符号可以保存缓冲器的解码速度.

articles.title: RCSD: Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Domain-Specific Speculative Decoding
articles.content: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by employing a compact draft model to propose candidate tokens that are verified in parallel by a target model. Conventional training relies on soft-label distillation, which forces the draft model to mimic the target's full output distribution, including high-entropy regions that degrade acceptance rates and increase early rejection risk. We propose RCSD (Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Speculative Decoding), a training framework that aligns draft model optimization with the system-level objective of maximizing acceptance length. RCSD leverages naturally occurring accepted and rejected sequences during speculative inference to construct implicit preference pairs, with masked loss to avoid penalizing target-aligned tokens. Evaluated across multiple benchmarks, RCSD improves average acceptance length by 35% over HASS and achieves 1.35x faster end-to-end inference than HASS on practical workloads, without compromising generation quality.

articles.title_zh: RCSD:加强和持续学习领域特定分型解码
articles.content_zh: 光谱解码通过使用紧凑的模型草案来提出由目标模型平行核实的候选符号来加速大语言模型推论. 常规训练依靠软标签分馏,这迫使模型草案模仿目标的全部出产分布,包括高通域降低接受率并增加早期拒绝风险. 我们提议采用RCSD(加强和持续学习以进行分型解码),这是一个使模型优化草案与系统一级最大接受时间目标相协调的培训框架。 RCSD利用在投机推断中自然发生的被接受和拒绝的序列来构建隐含的偏好对子,并蒙上损失的阴影来避免惩罚与目标相匹配的令牌. 经过多项基准评估,可持续发展中心的平均接受时间比HASS提高35%,并在不损害生成质量的情况下,比HAS对实际工作量的推断快1.35x。

articles.title: pplx-embed-v2-late Technical Report
articles.content: In this report, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-late, a pair of 0.6B and 9B multilingual and multimodal late-interaction models. Both models achieve state-of-the-art results within their respective size classes across a range of text, image, and visual document retrieval benchmarks. On visual document retrieval tasks, pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b is competitive with models several times larger than itself. The models are trained via representation distillation from an 18B teacher. Consequently, they share an embedding space that supports asymmetric deployment: documents can be indexed with the 9B model and queried with the low-latency 0.6B model. Both models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v2.

articles.title_zh: pplx-embed-v2-late 胶片板 技术报告
articles.content_zh: 在本报告中,我们引入了pplx-embed-v2-late,一对0.6B和9B多语种和多模式的后期互动模式. 两种模式都在各自的大小类别内,通过一系列文本、图像和可视文件检索基准,取得最新成果。 在可视化文档检索任务上,pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b与模型的竞争量是自身数倍. 这些模型是通过18B级教师的代理分馏培训的。 因此,它们共享一个支持不对称部署的嵌入空间:文件可以用9B模型编制索引,用低纬度0.6B模型查询。 两种模型均可在https://huggingface.co/collections/perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v2上查阅.

articles.title: Beyond the Vote: When Do LLMs Add Value to Retrieval-Based Tabular Classification?
articles.content: Retrieval-based in-context learning (ICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to predict tabular labels from similar examples, but it remains unclear whether LLM inference improves on direct voting over those same examples. We address this question by comparing four general-purpose LLMs with distance-weighted nearest-neighbor voting (Distance-KNN) using identical retrieved neighbors across 19 tabular classification datasets. With the number of demonstrations fixed, enlarging the retrieval candidate pool improves accuracy for all predictors, yet Distance-KNN achieves the highest mean accuracy at every pool size. More detailed analyses reveal that LLM gains are concentrated where retrieved neighbors exhibit low label consensus and vary across models. These gains further depend on the average feature-space distance to the test query: under low label consensus, some LLMs outperform Distance-KNN in close and intermediate neighborhoods, but all fall behind on average in the most distant group. Complementary experiments on the number of demonstrations, prompt formulation, retrieval representation, and label-balanced demonstration selection largely preserve the overall findings. These results characterize when LLM inference adds predictive value beyond distance-weighted voting in retrieval-based tabular ICL.

articles.title_zh: Beyond the Vote: LLMS 何时将值添加到基于检索的表分类中?
articles.content_zh: 基于检索的内文本学习(ICL)使得大型语言模型(LLMs)能够从类似的例子中预测出表格标签,但LLM推论是否改进了对同一些例子的直接投票,仍然不清楚. 我们利用19个表格分类数据集中相同的检索邻国,将四个通用有限责任公司与距离加权近邻投票(Distance-KNN)进行比较,以解决这一问题。 随着演示次数的固定,扩大检索候选集合会提高所有预测器的准确性,而距离-KNN却在每个集合大小上达到最高的平均值精度. 更详细分析显示,LLM收益集中在回收的邻居表现出低标签共识并因模型而异的地方. 这些收益进一步依赖于测试查询的平均地物-空间距离:在低标签共识下,一些LLMS在相邻和中间相邻的地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地 关于演示次数、即时配制、检索说明和标签平衡的演示选择的补充实验在很大程度上保留了总体结论。 这些结果的特点是,LLM推论在基于检索表的ICL中增加了超出远程加权表决的预测值.

articles.title: Mitigating Query Shortcuts in Chain-of-Thought with Context-Aware Decoding
articles.content: While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), recent studies have shown that final answers do not always depend on the generated rationales. In particular, LLMs may rely on query-specific shortcuts rather than the information provided by their reasoning steps. In this paper, we investigate whether context-aware decoding (CAD), an existing contrastive decoding method, can mitigate such shortcut behavior when applied to CoT reasoning. We study this application as Rationale Contrastive Decoding (RCD), which contrasts the next-token distributions conditioned on the query with and without its rationale, amplifying tokens whose likelihood increases due to the rationale. We provide a theoretical interpretation of this decoding rule via a KL-regularized reward-maximization objective. Experiments across five reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RCD improves answer accuracy over standard CoT. Furthermore, intervention analyses using ground-truth and random rationales reveal that RCD increases the behavioral dependence of final answers on the rationale content. Our findings suggest that contrastive decoding offers a simple, training-free approach to mitigating query shortcuts.

articles.title_zh: 以上下文辅助解码来减轻思维链中的查询快捷键
articles.content_zh: 虽然"思维链"(Cain-of-Thought (COT))的提示提高了大语言模型(LLMs)的推理性能,但最近的研究表明,最终的答案并不总是依赖于所生成的理由. 特别是,LLMS可能依赖特定查询快捷方式,而不是其推理步骤提供的信息. 在本文中,我们调查了上下文感解码(CAD),一种现存的对比解码方法,在应用到CoT推理时是否能够减轻这种快捷行为. 我们研究这个应用是"理性对比解码"(RCD),它对比了以查询为条件的相邻相接的分布,与没有其理由的相去相去甚远,放大了其概率会因理由而增大的符号. 我们通过KL规范化的奖励-最大化目标对这一解码规则提供理论解释. 5个推理基准的实验表明,刚果民盟的回答准确性高于标准COT。 此外,利用地面真相和随机理由进行的干预分析表明,刚果民盟增加了最后答复对理由内容的行为依赖。 我们的研究结果表明,对比性解码为缓解查询快捷键提供了简单、无培训的方法。

articles.title: Keeping Time vs. Understanding Time: Neither Alone Explains Temporal Reasoning in LLMs
articles.content: Temporal reasoning is widely assumed to decompose into two modes: temporal arithmetic (date and time calculations), and temporal semantics (understanding temporal and causal relations). This dichotomy shapes how benchmarks are designed, how models are trained, and how progress is measured, yet its empirical validity has never been directly tested. We provide two lines of evidence that challenge it. First, we test whether tasks labelled as arithmetic or semantic by the benchmarks support transferable gains within their purported mode. Finetuning on these subsets yields predominantly dataset-specific gains ($+6.8$ to $+23.1$ percentage points), while transfer to a different dataset in the same mode ranges from $-3.2$ to $+1.1$ percentage points. Across the two benchmark families used in the transfer analysis, this pattern provides little evidence of coherent, transferable temporal abilities. Second, using cognitive-demand-based model evaluation, we examine which capabilities actually drive performance on these benchmarks. We find that quantitative and logical reasoning, the assumed proxies for temporal arithmetic and temporal semantics, are not the primary drivers; knowledge is. Together, these findings show that current temporal reasoning benchmarks do not cleanly realise the arithmetic-semantics distinction and instead largely reward models for remembering how time typically works.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 保持时间对理解时间:在法学硕士课程中既不单独解释时间原因
articles.content_zh: 时间推理被广泛认为分解为两种模式:时间算术(日期和时间计算)和时间语义(理解时间和因果关系). 这种二分法形状如何设计基准,如何训练模型,如何衡量进度,然而其经验有效性从未被直接测试. 我们提供了两条证据来挑战它。 首先,我们检验这些基准标注为算术或语义的任务是否支持在其预期模式范围内的可转让收益。 这些子集的微调主要产生数据集特定收益(+6.8美元至+23.1美元百分点),而向同一模式下不同的数据集的转移则从3.2美元到1.1美元百分点不等。 在转移分析中使用的两个基准家庭中,这种模式几乎没有提供连贯、可转移的时间能力的证据。 其次,我们利用基于认知需求的模式评价,审查哪些能力能真正推动这些基准的绩效。 我们认为,定量和逻辑推理,即时间算术和时间语义的假定代词,不是主要驱动力;知识是主要的。 这些调查结果共同表明,目前的时间推理基准并没有完全实现算术和语义的区分,而是在很大程度上奖励那些记起时间通常如何工作的模型。

articles.title: A Strong MoE Is All You Need for Process Supervision
articles.content: Process reward models (PRMs) provide fine-grained supervision for multi-step reasoning, yet obtaining reliable process labels remains a central bottleneck. Existing approaches typically rely on human annotation, rollout-based estimation, or auxiliary verification. In this work, we explore a different source of process supervision natively exposed by Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: expert routing. We show that simple routing statistics provide an intrinsic process-confidence signal that is competitive with conventional output-logit confidence. Building on this observation, we construct routing confidence by combining overall routing mass, head routing mass, and within-step routing variation, and introduce RoCo-Rethink, which identifies the least confident reasoning step and selectively regenerates the subsequent trajectory. We further introduce RoCo-PRM, which uses a strong MoE to automatically annotate reasoning trajectories with routing-derived step scores and distills them into a standalone PRM. Across multiple MoE architectures and diverse reasoning tasks, both RoCo-Rethink and RoCo-PRM consistently outperform strong baselines, while RoCo-PRM transfers effectively across both model architectures and tasks. Our findings suggest that expert routing is more than a computational dispatch mechanism: it provides an architecture-native source of process supervision for reasoning.

articles.title_zh: 强有力的教育部是程序监督所需的一切
articles.content_zh: 过程奖励模型(PRMs)为多步骤推理提供了精细的监管,然而获得可靠的过程标签仍然是一个核心瓶颈. 现有办法通常依靠人的注释、以推出为基础的估计或辅助核查。 在这部作品中,我们探索了一种不同的过程监督来源,由Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)模型在本土曝光:专家出行. 我们显示,简单的路由统计提供了一种固有的进程自信信号,与传统的产出-记录信心具有竞争力。 在这个观察的基础上,我们通过结合总体的路由质量,头道质量,以及步内路由变异,构建出出通向信心,并引入了RoCo-Rethin,它确定了最不自信的推理步骤,有选择地再生了之后的轨迹. 我们进一步引入了RoCo-PRM,它使用一个强大的MOE来自动对有路由衍生出步分数的推理轨迹进行注释,并将其分馏成独立的PRM. RoCo-Rethink和RoCo-PRM在多个教育部架构和各种推理任务中,都一贯超越强基线,而RoCo-PRM则在模型架构和任务中有效转移。 我们的研究结果表明,专家的路由不仅仅是一个计算调度机制:它为推理提供了一种结构内在的程序监督来源。
